* Knowledge of CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (GitHub Actions, Terraform, CloudFormation) for deployment automation and platform reliability.
* Experience with API\-based and file\-based integration patterns, including authentication and authorisation mechanisms.
* Nice to have: Exposure to Generative AI technologies including RAG, Agent Development, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication, and prompt engineering.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

**Financial wellness**
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

**Physical wellness**
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

**Personal wellness**
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Production support and reliability** 



* Monitor the health, performance and availability of production services.

* Execute approved operational procedures, recovery activities and service restoration plans.

**Incident and problem management** 



* Manage incidents from initial report through diagnosis, escalation, resolution and closure.

* Track corrective and preventative actions through to completion.

**Database and data investigation** 



* Excellent knowledge of SQL queries, joins, aggregation etc…

**Essential skills and experience** 



* Experience in Operations Engineering, Production Support, Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Support or a similar role.

* Ability to assess impact, prioritise incidents and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A disciplined approach to documentation, risk management and operational controls.
* Commitment to security, resilience, service quality and continuous improvement.

**Desirable skills** 



* Knowledge of ITIL practices and service\-management tooling.
* Familiarity with observability platforms, metrics, dashboards, alerting and distributed tracing.
* Scripting or automation experience using languages such as Bash, Python or PowerShell.
* Experience with deployment pipelines, version control and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Understanding of resilience testing, disaster recovery and capacity management.
* Experience working in regulated, financial\-services or other highly controlled environments.

title: OpenText xECM and SAP InfoArchive Consultant
description:
Our client, a global Healthcare company, is seeking an experienced OpenText xECM and SAP InfoArchive Consultant to support enterprise content management, SAP archiving, legacy data migration, retention, and system decommissioning initiatives. The selected Candidate will design, implement, administer, and optimize OpenText xECM, Content Server, Archive Center, OTDS, and InfoArchive integration within SAP S/4HANA and ECC.  This role will collaborate closely with SAP basis, Functional, Technical, business teams and compliance officers to deliver robust archiving solutions that reduce storage costs, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain high system performance.
   

  

 This is a 6\-month contractual role, with the likelihood of extension. Candidates must be willing to work the Client's preferred CET hours.
   






**Key Responsibilities** 
  




* Lead end\-to\-end implementation and integration of OpenText xECM, Archive Center, and InfoArchive with SAP S/4HANA and ECC.
* Configure and manage SAP ArchiveLink repositories (OAC0, OAC2, OAC3\), archiving objects (AOBJ, SARI), and SAP data archiving using SARA and DB15\.

* Monitor system health, archiving jobs, logs, storage queues, and integrations; troubleshoot performance, connectivity, retrieval, and system issues.
* Define and test backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures for OpenText platforms and archive repositories.
* Collaborate with SAP Basis, Functional/Technical, infrastructure, database, cloud, business, and compliance teams.
* Support AWS, Azure, SAP RISE, system provisioning, upgrades, migrations, and transport management.
* Gather requirements and translate them into functional/technical designs, architecture documents, configuration guides, and SOPs.
* Execute units, integration, regression, and UAT testing, as well as production cutover and post\-go\-live support.
* Support legacy data extraction, transformation, loading, validation, reconciliation, and successful application decommissioning.
* Ensure archived data remains accessible, searchable, retrievable, and compliant with applicable regulations such as GDPR and CCPA.


 Requirements
   

  






* 5–8\+ years of IT experience with strong hands\-on expertise in OpenText and SAP integrations.
* Deep experience with OpenText xECM/Extended ECM for SAP, Content Server, OTDS, Archive Center, and InfoArchive.
* Strong hands\-on experience with InfoArchive configuration, data loading, archiving, administration, and retrieval.
* Strong knowledge of SAP ILM, SAP Data Archiving, ArchiveLink, SAP Content Server, SARA, OAC0/OAC2/OAC3, AOBJ, and SARI.
* Working knowledge of SAP Basis, K\-Pro, and basic ABAP debugging.
* Experience with legacy data migration and system decommissioning.
* Experience administering enterprise applications on Windows/Linux and working with SQL Server, Oracle, and/or SAP HANA.
* Knowledge of XML, JavaScript, shell scripting, and preferably OpenText Object Importer/Blaster tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.



**Preferred Qualifications**



* OpenText certification in Extended ECM, InfoArchive, or related technologies.
* Experience with SAP RISE, cloud\-native/containerized deployments, AWS, or Azure.
* Familiarity with GDPR, HIPAA, SEC, and FINRA compliance requirements.
* Experience with large\-scale SAP S/4HANA migrations, upgrades, archiving, and data lifecycle management.

title: Principal-Security Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

 Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands\-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) \& Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud\-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution\-focused, "hands\-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
* Architecting and optimizing large\-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi\-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low\-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.
* Designing and maintaining optimized data layers using the GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL engine) to support high\-throughput analytics and data consumers.
* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production\-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event\-driven microservices and high\-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long\-term security investments.


**What We’re Looking For...**
* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands\-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands\-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI\-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data\-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands\-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.
* Experience with DevOps CI/CD processes to automate build and deployments.
* Experience mentoring and coaching diverse teams.
* Experience in identifying and analyzing and finding RCA for Errors and working with cross functional teams like SRE and backend team
* Experience with analytical tools and DBs like Postgres, Looker , ELK, ETL tools
* Recognizing, tracking, and communicating issues, accomplishments, milestones to the team and business partners.
* Professional Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.
* Good presentation and communication skills.

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 40

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, regulatory requirements, and platform best practices.

* Data validation and reconciliation
* Defect investigation and resolution
* Ad‑hoc and audit support analysis
* Troubleshoot and support system integrations and interfaces, including:
* PL/SQL‑based inbound and outbound feeds
* High‑volume transactional / EDI‑style data loads and extracts
* Support data fixes, backend loads, and controlled updates across lower and production environments, following established change and governance processes.
* Assist with SIT, UAT, and regression testing, including test scenario creation, execution, and defect triage.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies in reports, extracts, and downstream feeds in collaboration with business, integration, and reporting teams.
* Support platform upgrades and regulatory releases by assessing impact, validating customizations, and ensuring data integrity.
* Collaborate with functional, business, and vendor teams to produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation and define preventive actions.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 10\+ years of experience as a Technical / Techno‑Functional Analyst or Application Support Analyst in enterprise systems.
* Strong hands‑on experience with Model N Revenue Manager, including:
+ Chargebacks
+ Rebates
+ Managed Care
+ Government Pricing
+ Validata
+ MDM

* Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including complex joins, performance tuning, and large‑volume data analysis.

* Exposure to EDI transactions and pharmaceutical gross‑to‑net data flows.
* Familiarity with IT governance, change management, and validation methodologies (SIT/UAT).

**Join us!**

title: Senior Administrator, Corporate Systems
description:
Job Description:
**Job Purpose**


The Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) Corporate Systems Senior Developer will be responsible for the end\-to\-end administration, deployment, and development of the ORMB application built on the Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF). This role combines hands\-on system administration — including fresh installations, environment provisioning, patch management, and release deployments — with Java\-based development of enhancements, integrations, and batch processing solutions.

  

Working under the direction of the Technical Manager, this role requires frequent collaboration with functional business analysts, infrastructure/DBA teams, third\-party vendors, and end users to ensure high availability, compliance, and continuous delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application. The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large\-volume financial systems.  

  

**Responsibilities**

 *System Administration \& Environment Management*

* Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers
	+ Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
	+ Manage multi\-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.
* Apply Oracle\-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.
	+ Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
	+ Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post\-patch environment integrity.
* Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.
	+ Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
	+ Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post\-deployment validation.
* Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
* Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment\-specific configuration documentation.

*Development \& Enhancements*

* Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
* Build and maintain third\-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e\-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file\-based patterns.
* Develop and optimize batch programs for high\-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM\-level tuning.
* Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.

*Production Support \& Operations*

* Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
* Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
* Perform year\-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
* Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform\-level issues.

*Collaboration \& Governance*

* Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
* Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
* Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel\-run testing and validation activities.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 5\+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC\&B, including hands\-on administration of OUAF\-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 5\+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi\-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high\-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors.

**Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8\.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC\&B / ORMB v2\.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

**Qualifications:**

* Management and prioritization skills
* Ability to develop working relationships, manage multiple activities and changing priorities
* Ability to work under pressure and to meet tight deadlines
* Self\-starter with ability to take the initiative and master new tasks quickly
* Methodical, attention to detail


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience


 This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.
   

  

 Couchbase Engineer \- Assistant Vice President
   

  

 A
 **Couchbase Engineer** 
 is a specialized database professional responsible for designing, deploying, managing, and optimizing Couchbase Server clusters. Couchbase is a distributed, high\-performance NoSQL document database that combines a flexible JSON model with a powerful SQL\-like query language (N1QL) and an integrated caching layer.
   

  

 To be successful, a Couchbase Engineer must possess a blend of core database administration (DBA) skills, NoSQL data modeling expertise, system performance tuning capabilities, and modern DevOps/automation skills.
   

  

* Core Couchbase Administration \& Architecture
* Multi\-Dimensional Scaling (MDS): Ability to design and configure clusters where specific services (Data, Query, Index, Search, Eventing, Analytics, Backup) are assigned to dedicated nodes to optimize resource utilization and prevent resource contention.
* Cross\-Datacenter Replication (XDCR): Expertise in setting up, monitoring, and troubleshooting high\-performance, low\-latency replication across geographically distributed clusters (active\-active or active\-passive) for disaster recovery and localized data access.
* Cluster Operations: Proficiency in node initialization, joining nodes to existing clusters, rebalancing data across nodes, and performing rolling upgrades without downtime.
* Security \& Compliance: Implementing Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), configuring TLS/SSL certificates for secure node\-to\-node and client\-to\-node communication, and managing administrative secrets securely.
* Data Modeling \& Query Optimization
* JSON Document Design: Designing efficient document schemas, understanding document keys, sub\-documents, and choosing between referencing (normalization) and embedding (denormalization) based on access patterns.
* N1QL (SQL for NoSQL): Writing and optimizing complex queries using N1QL, understanding query execution plans (using EXPLAIN), and leveraging query parameters.
* Global Secondary Indexes (GSI): Creating and managing indexes, understanding index partitioning, and choosing the appropriate index storage engine (Standard GSI vs. Memory\-Optimized GSI).
* Full\-Text Search (FTS) \& Analytics: Configuring search indexes for natural language queries and setting up the Analytics service for complex, ad\-hoc analytical queries without impacting operational workloads.
* Performance Tuning \& Sizing
* Memory Quota Allocation: Sizing and allocating RAM quotas for different services (Data, Index, Search, Eventing, Analytics) based on workload requirements.
* Eviction Policies: Understanding and configuring bucket eviction policies (Value Eviction vs. Full Eviction) and choosing between Couchbase buckets and Ephemeral buckets (in\-memory only).
* Disk I/O \& Storage Paths: Configuring custom disk paths for data, indexes, eventing, and analytics to optimize disk write queues and read performance.
* Operating System Tuning: Configuring Linux system limits (ulimits), such as soft/hard user processes and soft/hard open files, to handle high concurrent connections and file descriptors.
* DevOps, Automation \& Infrastructure (Enterprise Context)


 Modern enterprise environments require Couchbase Engineers to automate database lifecycles:
   

  

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible:
+ Automating Couchbase installation, cluster initialization, node management, bucket creation, user provisioning, backups, and upgrades.
+ Familiarity with Ansible catalog roles such as couchbase\_install, couchbase\_cluster, couchbase\_node, couchbase\_rebalance, couchbase\_bucket, couchbase\_user, couchbase\_backup, couchbase\_upgrade, and couchbase\_upload\_logs.
+ Managing hosts inventories and group variables (e.g., hosts.yaml, all.yaml, cb\_cluster.yaml) to define cluster topologies and service allocations.

* Containerization \& Orchestration: Deploying and managing Couchbase on Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift using the Couchbase Autonomous Operator (CAO).
* Linux Administration: Strong command of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8\), including package management, systemd service configuration, network troubleshooting, and log analysis.
* General NoSQL \& Distributed Systems Concepts
* CAP Theorem: Understanding the trade\-offs between Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance in distributed databases.
* Consistency Models: Configuring write durability and read consistency levels (e.g., eventual consistency vs. strong consistency).
* ACID Transactions: Implementing multi\-document ACID transactions in Couchbase when strong transactional guarantees are required.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

**Core Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of medallion / lakehouse architecture patterns (Raw / Harmonized / Conformed / Consumption)
* Strong knowledge of data modelling approaches: relational, dimensional, and lakehouse\-oriented
* Experience designing data governance architectures: lineage, data quality frameworks, audit and control patterns, SCD versioning, CDC
* Ability to design for both batch and real\-time data processing at scale
* Experience architecting parallel\-run and phased migration strategies across platforms
* Azure Data Platform Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
* Azure Synapse Analytics (Pipelines, Spark Pool, Dedicated SQL Pool)

* Delta Lake on Azure (Synapse Lakehouse)

* Databricks \& Lakehouse

* Experience designing migration architectures from legacy data warehouse or Synapse environments to Databricks Lakehouse

**Cloud \& Infrastructure**
* Strong Azure cloud architecture skills — security, networking, scalability, and cost optimization
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)
* CI/CD and DevOps practices for data platform delivery (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions)
* Containerization and compute management (Docker, Kubernetes awareness)
* Data Engineering Depth
* Sufficient hands\-on engineering background to engage credibly with senior engineers on implementation decisions

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with monitoring and observability frameworks (e.g., Dynatrace)

**Experience \& Profile**

title: Sustaining and Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
   

  

 We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change.  Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Join us and let’s build the future together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Site Reliability and Forward Deployed Engineer is an individual contributor who supports production operations, incident response, and post\-launch reliability across the Abacus Insights platform. Working with guidance from experienced engineers and technical leaders, this role builds practical skills in troubleshooting, automation, customer support, and reliable system operations.
   

  

**This Role Combines**
* Production operations and reliability engineering fundamentals
* Hands\-on technical troubleshooting during incidents and escalations
* Customer\-facing technical support for deployments and production issues
* Software development and automation to reduce manual operational work


 You will help investigate production issues involving AWS infrastructure, Databricks workloads, and data pipelines. You will partner with senior engineers, platform teams, and customer\-facing teams to resolve issues, improve operational documentation, and turn recurring problems into reusable solutions.
   

  

 You are expected to participate actively in incident response, debug systems using established tools and runbooks, and contribute code and documentation that improve reliability and operability.
   

  

 Success in this role is supported through structured onboarding covering the platform, production support processes, incident response, and customer context; pairing and mentorship from experienced SRE, platform, data, and engineering team members; progressive ownership, beginning with documented and well\-scoped tasks before moving to more complex incidents and customer engagements; and regular feedback focused on technical growth, operational judgment, communication, and automation skills.
   

  

**Your day to day**
* Participate in production incident triage, mitigation, recovery, and follow\-up activities under the guidance of experienced engineers.
* Contribute evidence, technical findings, and follow\-up actions to root cause analyses (RCAs).
* Investigate and resolve well\-scoped production defects and field\-reported issues, escalating complex or high\-risk problems appropriately.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Customer Success, and Support teams during customer\-impacting incidents and escalations.
* Maintain and improve runbooks, troubleshooting guides, monitoring, alerting, and operational checklists.
* Support customer deployments, integrations, and production troubleshooting alongside senior or customer\-facing engineers.
* Write and maintain Python scripts or small services that automate repeatable operational workflows, improve observability, and reduce manual toil.
* Use established tools and procedures to support AWS\- and Databricks\-based production systems, including basic performance, data quality, and job\-failure investigations.
* Document incident learnings and customer issues, and help convert recurring patterns into reusable tools, knowledge articles, and product improvement suggestions.
* Participate in an on\-call or shift\-based support rotation after completing the required onboarding and readiness training.


**What You Bring To The Team**
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, technical support, production operations, data engineering, or a related field. Relevant internships, academic projects, or hands\-on technical training may be considered.
* Understanding of cloud computing and interest in supporting production systems in AWS.
* Basic Python programming skills and the ability to read, troubleshoot, and modify existing scripts or services.
* Familiarity with Linux command\-line tools, logs, APIs, or SQL\-based troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of incident response, root cause analysis, monitoring, alerting, and observability concepts.
* Awareness of distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and Infrastructure as Code concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document findings and provide timely status updates.
* A structured troubleshooting mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to ask for help or escalate when appropriate.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks through resolution with coaching and guidance.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong interest in learning production reliability and customer\-facing engineering practices.
* Bachelors Degree in engineering or related field.


**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**
* Internship, project, or work experience in a cloud, data, DevOps, technical support, or production operations environment.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, data pipelines, or other data platforms and warehouses.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes or EKS, EMR, Lambda, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies.
* Experience using ticketing, monitoring, logging, or incident management tools.
* Exposure to healthcare, regulated data, or security\-conscious environments.
* Experience participating in an on\-call, lab\-support, service\-desk, or operational support rotation.
* Customer\-facing, consulting, implementation, or technical communication experience.


**What You’ll Get In Return**
* Competitive Leave \& Benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth\-focused environment – your development matters here


**Work arrangements**
* Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week
* Location: Pune, 5 Days from the office
* Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9\) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.


**Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 As a mission\-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

 At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.
   

  

**AI Use in Recruitment**
 We use AI\-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job\-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks.

Grow with the best. Your Key Responsibilities

title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI Platform
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Snowflake Engineer
description:
**ole Overview** 




 The Data Warehouse Engineer serves as the primary technical lead for the Snowflake data warehousing ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing scalable data models, managing Snowflake environments, optimizing performance and cost, enforcing security policies, and supporting analytics and enterprise reporting platforms, including Business Objects (BIC), across the organization. The DW Engineer ensures that Snowflake is stable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards, and collaborates with Platform Administrators and third‑party vendors to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of issues impacting reporting availability.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Data Modeling \& Architecture** 



* Design enterprise‑level Snowflake models including conformed dimensions, fact tables, and semantic views.
* Document ERDs, modeling assumptions, and physical/logical architectures.
* Establish and enforce modeling standards, naming conventions, and performance optimization patterns.



**Transformation \& Automation** 



* Build advanced SQL transformations across all Snowflake layers.
* Implement automated workflows using Tasks, Streams, procedures, and time‑based orchestration.
* Support schema evolution and large‑scale data integration patterns.



  





  





**Environment \& Release Management** 



* Coordinate Snowflake schema and object deployments via Git or CI/CD pipelines.
* Own release readiness for Snowflake across Dev, Test, and Prod.
* Ensure new models, views, RBAC changes, and stored procedures are validated prior to promotion.



**Performance Optimization** 



* Conduct performance tuning through micro‑partition analysis, clustering, query plan reviews, and caching strategies.
* Implement Resource Monitors, usage alerts, and proactive performance dashboards.
* Review warehouse utilization to ensure compute resources are right‑sized and cost‑optimized.



**Security, RBAC \& Controls** 



* Design and maintain Snowflake role hierarchies, object privileges, row‑level security, and masking policies.
* Support audit requests, compliance checks, and evidence gathering for reviews.
* Govern secure internal and external data sharing.



**Cost Management** 



* Produce recurring consumption reports to support conduct cost optimization analysis.
* Recommend improvements in warehouse sizing, retention policies, storage optimization, and compute scheduling.



**Cross‑Functional Collaboration** 



* Work with Data Engineers to coordinate ingestion design, transformation logic, and schema updates.
* Partner with BI teams to optimize datasets for Power BI, Qlik, and analytical tools.
* Align with Platform Administrators on environment setup, migrations, and operational readiness.



**Documentation \& Governance** 



* Maintain transformation specifications, lineage, and architectural diagrams.
* Ensure models and pipelines comply with governance policies and development standards.



**Enterprise Operational Reporting Platform (Web Intelligence)** 



* Collaborate with Platform Administrators and the vendor to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of reporting issues.



**Skills \& Tools Requirements** 



* **Snowflake SQL** 
 : 5\+ years of advanced SQL development experience, including complex query optimization, data modeling, performance tuning, and ETL/ELT development within Snowflake environments.
* **Snowflake Administration** 
 : 3\+ years of hands\-on experience administering Snowflake platforms, including security, role\-based access control (RBAC), warehouse management, monitoring, performance optimization, and cost governance.
* **dbt (Data Build Tool)** 
 : 4\+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data transformation frameworks using dbt, including testing, documentation, and CI/CD integration.
* **Git / Version Control** 
 : 5\+ years of experience using Git\-based source control systems (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket) for collaborative development, branching strategies, code reviews, and release management.
* **CI/CD Pipelines \& Deployment Automation** 
 : 5\+ years of experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines for data warehouse and analytics deployments, including automated testing, code promotion, release management, and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent platforms
* **Financial services experience** 
 : Preferred.
* **Business Objects (SAP BO/Web Intelligence)** 
 : Preferred.

title: Data Architect
description:
**About Uplevyl** 




 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women.
 



 Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women).
 



 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent.
 



 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Uplevyl is a data and technology company. What we sell is a knowledge layer: every verified US law on a subject, across every jurisdiction, held as one structured record per law that carries the jurisdiction, the right, the eligibility rules, the citation and the dates.
 



 The first knowledge layer, workplace rights, is built and running. Survivor rights, the hardest subset of it, was built first and is live: four areas of law, sourced and verified across federal, state and local law. The rest of workplace rights is being populated on the same pipeline, wealth life events has a live prototype, and reproductive health is in R\&D.
 



 The platform runs as five layers. The source layer finds, fetches, reads and checks the law. The data layer holds the versioned, jurisdiction\-resolved corpus. The AI layer answers questions from that corpus through a seven\-step agentic workflow. The enterprise layer gives each client its own instance, so the core never knows the tenant. The analytics layer reads all four and writes to none.
 



 Here is the honest version. That diagram is true in production for survivor rights, and it is held together at the seams by spreadsheets and people. Source versions and metadata still move between the legal team and engineering as workbooks. The categories the assistant sorts a question into are fixed in a prompt rather than read from the data, so when the legal team adds one, the system cannot follow. Each layer has an owner. The seams between them do not.
 



 You will own the seams, and the data layer they all run through. Your job is to make the diagram true in the system: one record schema for every law in every subject we build, versioned so the corpus can answer what applied on a given date, resolved to every one of the 91,000\+ US jurisdictions, and served to the AI layer with the metadata it needs to be right.
 



 You will do this hands on. This is a small team, and the person who draws the schema also writes the migration. You will work daily with our AI engineer, our source extraction engineer, the product and engineering pair building the source management portal, and the legal team that verifies every law we hold. You report to the India Team Lead and you will be in the room, on a whiteboard, with our founder when architecture decisions are made.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **The record schema.** 
 One schema for every law in every subject we build: jurisdiction and level of government, category and right, citation and verbatim text, eligibility, enacted, effective and recorded dates, preemption status, provenance and version. You decide what is universal and what belongs to a subject, and you make the legal team's categories, down to the sub\-category, live in the data rather than in a prompt.
* **The versioned corpus.** 
 Raw, cleaned and current, every version kept. Changed laws are re\-fetched on a schedule, diffed line by line, and pass through a review queue and a merge gate before they touch the live corpus. A struck\-down ordinance stays, marked, and is never served as live law.
* **The jurisdiction map.** 
 Every US jurisdiction, federal, state, county and city, resolved to the law that applies there or to an explicit record that says none does. The list of 91,000\+ jurisdictions exists; resolving each one is the work.
* **The contracts between layers.** 
 The source layer releases verified records; you define the shape they arrive in and the quality gate they pass. The AI layer retrieves from the current corpus; you define the index, the filters and the metadata it retrieves on, with our AI engineer. Analytics reads the corpus and the platform's anonymous logs; you define what it reads and make sure it never writes back and never sees a client's records.
* **Tenant and subject inheritance.** 
 One shared record schema across clients, a separate instance and data store per client. A new client is a configuration record and a new subject is a new corpus; you keep both true as they multiply.
* **The end of the spreadsheet as a system of record.** 
 The source management portal exists to check sources in and out, hold immutable versions, and connect straight to the pipeline. Its data model is yours: the schema, the migrations, and the day the last metadata workbook is retired.



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 We hire across levels, but this is not an entry point into data work. Systems you have designed and run in production matter more than years, and we will ask you to design in our process.
 


* **You have designed a data model that other teams built on.** 
 A relational schema (Postgres or equivalent) that survived new domains and new clients, and that you migrated without losing history.
* **You have built versioned, auditable data.** 
 Effective\-dated or bitemporal records, append\-only history, line\-level diffs, review\-and\-merge gates. You know why "what is current" and "what applied on that date" are different questions, and you have made both cheap to answer.
* **You have owned pipelines end to end.** 
 Ingestion with quality gates that catch a false success upstream, transformations that are reproducible, and monitoring that tells you a count is wrong before a user does. Python and SQL are daily tools, not occasional ones.
* **You know what a retrieval system needs from data.** 
 You have worked alongside an AI or search team and understand that chunking, metadata filters and re\-ranking are only as good as the records underneath.
* **You are precise about multi\-tenancy.** 
 Tenant isolation, shared schemas with separate stores, and what must never cross a boundary.
* **You use AI to build, and you check its work.** 
 Claude Code, Cursor, whichever: you use these tools daily, you review what they produce line by line.
* **You write decisions down, plainly.** 
 Schema choices, contracts between layers, what changed and why.
* **High agency.** 
 Nobody has held this role here before. You will find spreadsheets where a system should be, and you will decide the order in which to replace them.



  





**Even better if** 



* You have modeled legal, regulatory or statutory data, or any corpus where jurisdiction and dates decide the answer.
* You have built or run a source\-of\-truth system with human review in the loop.
* You have worked with graph databases, or with graph\-shaped relationships in a relational model.
* You have shipped on Google Cloud or Vertex AI, or a comparable managed cloud AI stack.
* You have worked in mission\-driven, social\-impact, women\-focused or nonprofit ecosystems.
* You have founder or startup operator experience.



  





**Before you apply** 




 You will inherit a live product with real users and real partners, a corpus that a legal team and engineers spent months verifying, and a set of spreadsheets doing jobs that a system should do. The first months are as much archaeology as architecture: finding where the diagram and the database disagree, and choosing what to fix first without breaking what works. If you want a greenfield build with no history, this is not the right fit, and that is fine.
 



 It is a hands\-on role of one, on a small senior team, in our Noida office. The work is demanding, the expectations are real, and the rewards, in compensation, in ownership, and in what you will learn, match them.
 



 If you would read about bitemporal data models on a weekend anyway, you will be at home here. If that sounds like a chore, we would rather you knew now.
 



 If you want to be the reason a system that answers questions about people's rights can prove where every answer came from, we want to hear from you.
 



 Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation.
 



  





**How we work at Uplevyl** 



* **We finish what we start, and we do it well.** 
 We follow through on what we say we'll do, and we care about the difference our work makes.
* **We listen before we decide.** 
 Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve.
* **We move with ownership and urgency.** 
 We don't wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality.
* **We are better together than alone.** 
 We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed.
* **We stay curious and keep learning, including how to use AI well.** 
 We hold ourselves to the bar we're building toward: questioning our own assumptions and using AI to think better and move faster.

 Experience in a 24x7 production support environment.
   

  

 Knowledge of ITIL, Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.

 Experience supporting high\-volume, business\-critical telecom billing operations.

title: Oracle Functional Analyst (Configuration)
description:
**Company Description**
**About Sopra Steria**
 Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end\-to\-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in\-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5\.6 billion.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The world is how we shape it.**
**Job Description – Oracle Fusion Data Migration \& Configuration Specialist**
**Job Title:** 
 Oracle Fusion Data Migration \& Configuration Specialist
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Oracle Fusion Cloud certification in relevant functional modules will be preferred.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Oracle Fusion Functional Configuration
* Configure and maintain Oracle Fusion Cloud applications based on business and functional requirements.
* Perform setup and configuration activities using the Setup and Maintenance work area.
* Support configuration of relevant Oracle Fusion modules, depending on project requirements, such as:
* Financials
* General Ledger
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Cash Management
* Procurement
* Projects
* HCM
* Configure enterprise structures, business units, ledgers, legal entities, reference data sets, approval rules, lookups, value sets, flexfields, and other application setups as applicable.
* Configure and maintain descriptive flexfields (DFF), extensible flexfields (EFF), key flexfields (KFF), value sets, and standard/custom lookups.
* Analyse business requirements and translate them into Oracle Fusion functional configuration solutions.
* Prepare configuration workbooks and maintain complete documentation of setup changes.
* Configuration Migration \& Environment Management
* Manage movement of Oracle Fusion configurations across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments.
* Create, validate, export, import, and deploy Oracle Fusion configuration migration sets.
* Support full and delta migration activities where applicable.
* Validate source and target environment readiness before migration and ensure appropriate release and patch alignment.
* Review configuration differences and support impact analysis before deployment.
* Identify configurations, security changes, roles, or other artifacts requiring manual migration or separate deployment processes.
* Perform post\-migration validation and coordinate functional testing to ensure successful deployment. Oracle recommends validating migration sets, reviewing missing roles, and performing functional testing after configurations are applied.
* Maintain configuration version control, migration logs, deployment records, and rollback documentation.
* Cutover \& Post\-Go\-Live Support
* Develop and maintain detailed data migration and cutover plans.
* Participate in mock cutovers and production deployment activities.
* Coordinate pre\-cutover, cutover, and post\-cutover data validation.
* Provide hypercare support following Oracle Fusion go\-live.
* Resolve high\-priority configuration and data\-related incidents.
* Identify opportunities to automate and improve data migration and configuration processes.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple migration and configuration activities simultaneously.
* Strong stakeholder and business communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross\-functional team.
* Good understanding of ITIL, Change Management, Release Management, and Incident Management processes.
* Strong documentation and governance discipline.


 Total Experience Expected: 04\-06 years
   

  

**Qualifications**
 B.E./ B.Tech./ BCom/MBA
   

  

**Additional Information**
 At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.
   

  

 All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry\-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next\-generation, AI\-powered applications.
   

  

 MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem \- database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
   

  

 Cool things you’ll do
   

  

 You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges \- resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs \- interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
   

  

 What you need
   

  

 You should have 5\+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self\-taught, insatiably curious, and multi\-faceted.
   

  

 The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
   

  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi\-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi\-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission\-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C\+\+, C\#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills


 If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large\-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud\-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
   

  

 You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real\-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
   

  

*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
