title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 30 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department** AMP – Research \& SI

**Location**Bengaluru or Gurgaon, India

**Reports To**Principal Engineer

**Level** 4


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.


As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data\-driven insights, and informed investment decision\-making.


Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi\-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high\-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.


As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI\-assisted software development with AI\-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI\-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.

**About your role**

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands\-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.


Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI\-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.


You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI\-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI\-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.


The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands\-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.


This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open\-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development tools.

**Software Engineering**

* Build complete AI\-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready\-to\-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

**Architecture \& Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI\-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive\-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third\-party model risk.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade\-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI\-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About you**


We’re looking for an experienced, hands\-on AI Engineer who combines strong full\-stack engineering capability with practical experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. You are comfortable taking AI\-powered applications and services through design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support within established architecture and engineering standards.


You are naturally curious about emerging technologies, enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, and apply AI pragmatically to improve business outcomes and developer productivity without compromising software quality, security, governance, or Responsible AI principles.


You are comfortable contributing to architectural and technical discussions with senior engineers, collaborating with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, and engaging with investment stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI solutions.

**Software Engineering Experience**

* 6\+ years experience in software engineering, including experience leading the technical delivery of complex enterprise applications.
* Demonstrable experience building, deploying, and supporting production Generative AI or LLM\-powered applications.
* Strong hands\-on engineering skills in Python and at least one modern frontend stack using TypeScript with Angular / React.
* Experience developing APIs and distributed services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Strong experience with RAG, including embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, citations, and evaluation.
* Experience building AI agents or orchestrated AI workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience with LLM capabilities such as structured output, function or tool calling, conversation state, prompt management, and model routing.
* Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions.
* Excellent understanding of modern software engineering principles and design patterns.
* Experience working within Agile software delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, software quality and secure software development practices.
* Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and engineering automation.

**AI Engineering Experience**

* Practical experience using AI\-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf or similar LLM\-based engineering assistants.
* Experience integrating AI into software engineering workflows including code generation, documentation, automated testing, code review and developer productivity.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and effective techniques for interacting with Large Language Models.
* Familiarity with emerging AI concepts such as AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic development workflows.
* Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI practices and the effective use of AI within enterprise engineering environments.
* Passion for staying current with developments in AI\-assisted software engineering.

**Technical Skills**


Experience with many of the following technologies and practices:

* Python, Angular, Nodejs, TypeScript or similar modern programming languages
* LLM application development and prompt engineering
* Enterprise RAG and vector search
* AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
* Containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
* Git\-based source control and collaborative development workflows
* REST APIs and event\-driven architectures
* CI/CD tooling
* Infrastructure as Code
* Observability and monitoring platforms
* Enterprise architecture principles

**Investment Management Experience**

* Experience delivering technology solutions within Asset Management, Investment Management or Financial Services.
* Strong understanding of front\-to\-back investment management processes.
* Familiarity with technology supporting portfolio management, research, trading, investment risk, investment analytics or asset management operations.
* Experience working closely with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers or front\-office technology teams.
* Understanding of the governance, control and regulatory expectations associated with investment management technology.

**Personal Attributes**

* Passionate about engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Naturally curious about emerging technologies and AI.
* Strong coaching, mentoring and influencing skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Collaborative and delivery\-focused.
* Pragmatic approach to balancing innovation with governance.
* Comfortable working across business and technology communities.
* Enthusiastic about helping others adopt new technologies and ways of working.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Configuration Management Analyst
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  



Could you be the full\-time Configuration and Data Management Analyst in Bangalore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**



Take on a new challenge and apply your configuration management expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates.



You'll play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and governance of our configuration management database (CMDB), which serves as the single source of truth for our global IS\&T operations. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business, including service owners, application owners, architects, and IS\&T Directors, to enhance processes, implement automation, and ensure alignment with Alstom's global strategy. You’ll also drive continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of digital transformation within the IS\&T organization.



You’ll specifically take care of maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, but also defining and implementing a robust configuration management governance model.



We’ll look to you for:


* Supporting the positioning and use of the CMDB as the single point of truth
* Ensuring an end\-to\-end view of the configuration management process for BAU topics
* Driving governance and day\-to\-day activities with a wide network of stakeholders
* Continuously improving the accuracy and completeness of the CMDB and expanding its scope to cover the entire IS\&T landscape
* Advancing the automation of data uploads to the CMDB
* Communicating configuration management strategies, priorities, and projects to both internal and external partners
* Maintaining awareness and alignment with the IT leadership team through regular reporting
* Measuring stakeholder satisfaction and implementing improvement plans
  


  

**All about you**



We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* Graduate with a bachelor’s degree in IT (an advanced degree is preferred)

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact and influence at all levels of the organization

* Result\-oriented with strong attention to detail
* Experience managing multi\-partner teams in complex environments
* Ability to work effectively in virtual, geographically dispersed, and cross\-cultural environments
* Good stakeholder management skills
  


  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our agile and flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs
* Progress towards leadership or expert roles in IT and configuration management

**Tactical Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst**


**EY Technology:**



Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.



At the root of the security offered to EY Technology is Cyber Threat intelligence, the team responsible for identifying, researching, and reporting on the evolving emerging threats facing the firm. Cyber Threat Intelligence prides itself on providing the firm with early warning and predictive analysis to identify and mitigate threats which may otherwise hinder operations.

  


**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:


**Client Technology (CT) \-** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.


**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.


**Information Security (Info Sec) \-** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  




**The opportunity**



As a member in the Cyber Threat Intelligence team in Cyber and Investigative Services, the candidate will identify, research, and report on emerging threats to EY to strategically shape and guide the approach EY takes to protect its people and assets. The position offers a unique opportunity to inform and influence leadership with creative, thought provoking approaches to detect and defeat complex threats facing EY. This position requires technical skills to allow for the candidate to have deep understand of potential threats that may impact EY to achieve the greatest potential for success for the candidate and the team.

This role is responsible for providing technical expertise and threat intelligence insights to help stakeholders understand, assess, and respond to the cyber threats it faces. The analyst will collect, analyze, and produce actionable threat intelligence in support of EY Cyber and Investigative Services, EY Technology, and other business stakeholders. By maintaining awareness of the global threat landscape, emerging threat capabilities, and evolving tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), the analyst will help inform and strengthen EY’s security posture. The role requires the evaluation of open\-source, commercial, internal, and proprietary intelligence sources, enriching threat information with contextual analysis to produce timely and relevant intelligence products. A significant portion of the role is dedicated to researching active and emerging threats, assessing their potential impact to EY, and delivering tactical intelligence to cybersecurity teams, management, and other stakeholders to support proactive decision\-making.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Technical ability to attribute threats and related tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to facilitate defensive actions within an organization.
* Understanding of technical concepts
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams
* Attention to detail

  


**To qualify for the role you must have**


* 5\+ years of experience conducting incident response and triage OR
* 3\+ years of experience directly related to threat analysis, digital forensics, malware analysis, or threat hunting
* Understanding of cyber threats, attack vectors, and common exploitation techniques.
* Understanding of how to apply MITRE ATT\&CK
* Effective written and verbal communication skills

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence
* Exposure to writing tactical intelligence reports for various levels of stakeholders

  


**What we look for**



We are seeking a proactive, self\-driven analyst capable of operating independently in a fast\-paced cybersecurity environment. The successful candidate will continuously advance their understanding of evolving threat tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and apply that expertise to enhance EY’s detection and prevention capabilities. They will foster the growth of others through knowledge sharing while providing timely, actionable insights to stakeholders to ensure informed decision\-making.

  


**What working at EY offers**



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Staff IT Risk Analyst
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
 *all*

 The Third‑Party Cybersecurity Risk Management (TPCRM) Staff Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping, governing, and continuously improving information risk management related to external suppliers. The analyst leads complex and ambiguous third‑party cybersecurity risk issues, advises senior business and security stakeholders, drives program maturity, and supports enterprise‑level decision‑making across Information Security, Privacy, Regulatory Compliance, Procurement, Legal, and Governance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Shape assessment methodology, risk criteria, evidence expectations, and control evaluation practices to improve consistency, scalability, and defensibility of TPCRM outcomes.
* Perform advanced gap analysis against frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, SOX, TISAX, and GDPR, and advise stakeholders on enterprise‑level remediation priorities.
* Lead risk treatment strategy for material supplier findings, including mitigation planning, risk acceptance recommendations, supplier escalations, evidence validation, and closure decisions.
* Develop, revise, and mature third‑party risk management policies, standards, processes, guidelines, and runbooks through formal governance and change management.
* Lead third‑party governance activities, including onsite supplier audits, executive risk reporting, cross‑functional working groups, and escalation of material supplier risks.
* Translate cybersecurity, regulatory, supplier, and threat intelligence insights into actionable risk themes, program enhancements, and supplier risk mitigation strategies.
* Interpret risk tolerance, contractual obligations, control tradeoffs, supplier criticality, and business impact to support informed risk acceptance, mitigation, avoidance, or transfer decisions.
* Partner with procurement, legal, information security, business, privacy, resilience, and vendor management teams to embed TPCRM expectations throughout the supplier lifecycle.
* Advise business‑led initiatives on third‑party cyber risk, due diligence requirements, standards compliance, supplier engagement, and governance escalation paths.
* Mentor senior and junior analysts, lead process improvement initiatives, advance automation and reporting maturity, and help establish consistent TPCRM execution across teams and regions.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Management Information Systems/Business Administration. Master’s degree is preferred.
* Related field of study or equivalent combination of education and experience.


**Experience**
 Analyzing and applying Information Security, Cyber Risk Management, Third‑Party Risk Management, and Privacy practices for a minimum of seven years of experience, with demonstrated ability to lead complex supplier risk issues, influence cross‑functional stakeholders, and improve risk management practices in the following areas:
   

  

* Advanced third‑party / vendor risk management, supplier assessments, external assurance programs, cybersecurity governance, or enterprise risk functions.
* Strong IT business process knowledge, supplier lifecycle understanding, business acumen, and ability to connect supplier risk to operational and enterprise impact.
* Experience influencing procurement, legal, vendor management, privacy, information security, business, and executive stakeholders on risk decisions and remediation priorities.

* Experience developing risk analytics, dashboards, scorecards, executive reporting, metrics, and narratives that communicate third\-party risk posture and program maturity.
* Advanced understanding of threat, vulnerability, business continuity, supplier security, incident response, and third\-party risk assessment methodologies.
* Knowledge of national and international regulatory and security frameworks including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO standards, SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, TISAX, and related supplier security expectations.
* Experience leading risk treatment decisions, remediation governance, supplier escalations, executive briefings, onsite supplier assessments, or high\-risk supplier reviews.
* CRISC, CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISM, or equivalent certifications are preferred.
* Preferred skills in SharePoint, Teams, reporting tools, workflow platforms, AI\-enabled automation, and other collaboration or knowledge management platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to mature cybersecurity risk practices, establish reusable processes, and improve outcomes across third\-party ecosystems and high\-risk supplier relationships.

* Ability to define, communicate, and influence enterprise third‑party cybersecurity risk decisions in business‑relevant language.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to craft and deliver concise executive\-level communications, risk narratives, and decision briefs.
* Ability to lead confidently through ambiguity, competing priorities, sensitive supplier issues, and rapidly changing risk conditions.
* Ability to communicate cybersecurity and third‑party risk concepts clearly to technical, non‑technical, supplier, and executive audiences.

 What you have

* Application Security Vulnerability Engineering Solid understanding of common software weakness classes and the intentional design of vulnerable code patterns to validate static analysis coverage, detection accuracy, and severity classification.
* Multi‑Repository Architecture \& Configuration Delivery Proven ability to architect centralized configuration and workflow distribution models for large repository ecosystems, including reusable workflows, configuration validation, and scalable authentication mechanisms.

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. title: GeoSpatial Analyst MAP
description:
**Job Summary**
 GeoSpatial Analyst MAP will analyze complex geospatial data sets using Splunk Admin capabilities to deliver actionable insights that enhance operational efficiency and strategic planning across the enterprise. The role involves hybrid work in a day shift schedule and focuses on building robust monitoring solutions that improve resilience transparency and data driven decision making for business and society.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze diverse geospatial data sources using Splunk configurations to generate clear operational and strategic insights that help internal teams make timely and informed decisions across regions and functions.
* Develop and maintain Splunk dashboards tailored to geospatial metrics that allow stakeholders to monitor performance trends identify anomalies and track key indicators that support long term organizational objectives.
* Configure Splunk data ingestion pipelines for geospatial feeds to ensure reliable collection indexing and search performance that supports high quality analytics and minimizes downtime across critical business workflows.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to translate complex geospatial and operational requirements into efficient Splunk search queries and visualizations that address real business problems and improve service outcomes.
* Optimize Splunk search performance for large scale geospatial datasets by tuning queries indexes and resource usage to deliver fast accurate results that enable timely responses to emerging risks and opportunities.
* Implement data quality checks and validation routines for geospatial inputs within Splunk to ensure that downstream analyses reports and alerts remain trustworthy and support responsible decision making.
* Support hybrid work collaboration by documenting Splunk configurations dashboards and geo analytics processes in an accessible manner that allows distributed teams to operate smoothly and maintain continuity.
* Integrate relevant external geospatial data sources with internal Splunk environments to expand analytical coverage enrich context for patterns and help the organization understand regional impacts on operations and communities.
* Provide clear analytical summaries and recommendations based on Splunk geospatial outputs that guide business teams toward actions which reduce risk improve resource allocation and strengthen societal impact.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and infrastructure specialists to maintain secure and stable Splunk environments for geospatial analysis ensuring compliance with organizational standards and protecting sensitive information.
* Design alerting mechanisms in Splunk based on geospatial thresholds and trends so that operational teams can respond quickly to incidents service disruptions or emerging demand patterns in specific locations.
* Document repeatable analytic workflows for geospatial investigations in Splunk to support continuous improvement knowledge sharing and scalability of analytical capabilities across the enterprise.
* Participate in periodic reviews of geospatial analytics use cases to refine Splunk configurations and reporting structures ensuring that solutions remain aligned with evolving business strategies and societal expectations.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate practical experience in Splunk administration including index management data onboarding query optimization and dashboard development that supports reliable analytic outcomes.
* Apply working knowledge of geospatial concepts such as coordinates projections and spatial relationships to interpret data patterns and provide context aware insights in day to day analyses.
* Utilize familiarity with GIS tools or mapping platforms to enhance visualization of Splunk data outputs and create intuitive views that make complex spatial information understandable for non technical stakeholders.
* Exhibit strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to transform raw technical data into concise narratives and recommendations that support business decision processes.
* Communicate findings effectively through written summaries and presentations that explain geospatial trends Splunk metrics and their implications for operations customers and communities.
* Manage multiple analytical tasks within a hybrid work model by organizing priorities collaborating asynchronously and maintaining consistent progress across projects with minimal supervision.

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large\-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
   

  

 Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands\-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large\-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.


**What We Need To See**
* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large\-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux\-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi\-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service\-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large\-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.
* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.


 NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High\-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.

description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. **Responsibilities:**

* Lead incident response efforts, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident analysis, collaborating with internal teams and external partners as necessary.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting activities to identify advanced persistent threats (APTs) and sophisticated attack techniques targeting LPL Financial Corp.
* Develop, implement, and maintain security monitoring use cases, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to enhance detection and response capabilities.
* Participate in vulnerability management activities, including scanning, analysis, prioritization, and tracking remediation efforts.
* Evaluate and recommend new security technologies and tools to improve the overall security posture and operational efficiency.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior analysts within the Cyber Security Operations team.
* Generate comprehensive reports on security incidents, trends, and operational metrics for management review.
* Stay abreast of the latest cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices to inform security strategy and operations.
* Participate in on\-call rotations to provide 24/7 security incident response coverage as required.

**What are we looking for?**


We want **strong collaborators who can deliver a world\-class client experience**. We are looking for people who thrive in a **fast\-paced environment, are client\-focused, team oriented**, and are able to execute in a way that encourages **creativity** and **continuous improvement**.

 **Requirements:**

Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. Ability to lead and mentor less experienced team members.

* Experience within the financial or wealth management industry

* Able to make quick decisions and resolve complex technical problems
* Ability to manage through shift changes and effectively transition open and unresolved issues.
* Ability to adapt, learn new technologies, develop new processes, and improve procedures.
* Excellent documentation skills.
* Ability to write, read, interpret, and edit complex documents and correspondence with team members and stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work peak, off\-peak, weekend, and holiday shifts.

**Job Description Summary**


We are looking for a **Lead – Workday Development** to play a hands\-on technical leadership role in enhancing and evolving AT\&T’s established Workday HCM platform. The platform has been in production for the past three years and supports critical HR integrations, workflows, applications, reporting, and automation capabilities across AT\&T’s HR ecosystem.


This role combines **Individual Contributor and Technical Lead responsibilities**. The Lead will actively architect, design, and develop complex Workday solutions while providing technical direction and guidance to the broader development team. The role will be responsible for **solution architecture, hands\-on development, resolving technical blockers, establishing engineering best practices, conducting design and code reviews, mentoring developers, and driving continuous improvement** across the Workday platform.


The ideal candidate is a strong Workday technologist who can operate at both the **architecture and implementation levels**, taking ownership of complex technical problems from solution design through production implementation and support.

* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve **complex technical and cross\-system issues**.
* Experience defining and implementing **technical standards, reusable frameworks, design patterns, and development best practices**.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently drive complex technical issues to resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate and document technical designs and decisions.
* Ability to mentor and influence developers and drive technical decisions **without direct reporting authority**.

title: BTA - Quality Engineer - Hyderabad
description:
As an entry\-level Quality Engineer in the Analytics Horizontal team, you will help ensure the reliability, accuracy, usability, security, and performance of analytics solutions, including reports, dashboards, ETL and data pipelines, APIs, and AI\-enabled applications. Working under the guidance of experienced quality engineers and in collaboration with developers, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders, you will translate requirements and acceptance criteria into structured test scenarios, execute manual tests, validate data across source and target systems, document defects, and support regression and release testing. You will receive training on the team’s applications, analytics platforms, testing practices, and automation tools while building a strong foundation in quality engineering for enterprise analytics.
Key job responsibilities:* Work with quality engineering leads, developers, analysts, and product owners to understand requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Prepare and maintain test scenarios, detailed test cases, test data, requirement traceability, and evidence for analytics solutions.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, retesting, exploratory, user\-interface, API, and end\-to\-end testing across reports, dashboards, data pipelines, and AI\-enabled applications.
* Validate reports and dashboards for data accuracy, calculations, filters, drill\-downs, visual behavior, usability, access controls, exports, and performance.
* Use SQL and source\-to\-target comparisons to verify data completeness, accuracy, consistency, transformations, reconciliations, refreshes, and exception handling across databases and analytics platforms.
* Test ETL/ELT workflows, file and API integrations, scheduled jobs, and cloud\-based data processes, including positive, negative, boundary, and failure scenarios.
* Test AI\-enabled application capabilities for functional correctness, response relevance, groundedness, guardrails, permissions, error handling, and consistent behavior using approved test data and expected outcomes.
* Identify, document, prioritize, track, retest, and report defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, expected results, actual results, and business impact.
* Support test automation by creating or maintaining reusable scripts for API, user\-interface, data\-validation, and regression testing under guidance.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, defect triage, test\-status reporting, release\-readiness activities, and post\-release validation.
* Maintain test suites, test data, quality metrics, and supporting documentation, and contribute ideas for improving test coverage and delivery quality.

Location: Hyderabad  

Shift Timings: 11:00 AM \- 8:00 PM  

Education/Background:* Bachelor’s Degree educated or equivalent in Computer Science or related field

Key skills:* Foundational understanding of software testing concepts, the software development life cycle, and defect life cycle.

* Interest in testing AI and GenAI solutions, including prompt\-based applications, retrieval\-augmented generation, response evaluation, guardrails, and responsible use of test data.

title: Manager, Security Analytics & Operations - SOC (Cyber Security)
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana
**Requisition ID** 2026\-124173 **Category** Technology **Position type** Regular
  
**Your opportunity**
--------------------

  

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
The SOC Team Lead is a tactical leader who bridges technical expertise and leadership within the SOC. Often considered a “player\-coach,” the Team Lead manages the day\-to\-day operations of the SOC team, ensuring that incident response processes run smoothly during their shift. This role involves coordinating analysts’ activities, acting as the primary escalation point for complex incidents, and maintaining quality control over how incidents are handled and documented. The Team Lead still engages in hands\-on incident response when necessary, but also focuses on mentoring analysts and improving operational processes. In a financial industry SOC, the Team Lead pays special attention to adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies in all SOC activities, since consistent process is critical for both security and compliance.  

Key Responsibilities
* Operational Oversight: Manage and oversee real\-time SOC operations during assigned shifts. This includes monitoring the flow of alerts and ongoing incidents, ensuring that all incoming security events are promptly assigned and addressed by the team. Balance workloads among analysts and maintain overall situational awareness of the organization’s security posture at all times.
* Incident Command \& Escalation: Serve as the primary escalation point for incidents that go beyond Tier1 or an individual analyst’s expertise. For high\-severity or widespread incidents, act as the Incident Commander, coordinating response efforts, making real\-time decisions on containment strategies (such as system isolation or shutdowns), and communicating status updates to management. Step in to directly handle or support particularly critical incidents alongside the team.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure quality control of the team’s incident handling and documentation. Review analysts’ incident reports and evidence to verify accuracy, thoroughness, and compliance with SOC procedures. Ensure that all required steps (analysis, containment, notification, etc.) are taken for each incident and that escalations include all necessary information.
* Shift Handoffs: Conduct and document shift handover meetings at the start and end of shifts. Clearly communicate any ongoing incidents, recent critical events, and operational issues to incoming Team Leads and analysts. Make sure there is a seamless transition so that active investigations continue without delay or information loss.
* Performance \& Metrics: Track SOC performance metrics (e.g., Mean Time to Acknowledge/Investigate/Close incidents, number of alerts handled, false positive rates). Use these metrics to identify bottlenecks or areas for improvement. Provide regular updates to the SOC Manager on the team’s performance and any resource or process issues.
* Training \& Development: Mentor and train SOC analysts to improve their skills. Conduct on\-the\-job training sessions, debrief significant incidents to extract lessons learned, and ensure analysts are familiar with new threats, technologies, and changes in procedures. Assist with onboarding new team members and promote knowledge sharing within the team.
* Process Improvement: Update and optimize SOC processes and documentation. Proactively identify inefficiencies or gaps in playbooks and standard operating procedures, and recommend enhancements. Work with the SOC Manager to implement new tools or updated workflows (such as new SOAR playbooks or reporting templates) to increase team efficiency and consistency.
* Tool and Environment Management: Ensure all SOC tools and systems are functional and being effectively utilized by the team. Coordinate with IT or engineering teams to fix any outages or performance issues in monitoring tools (SIEM, EDR, etc.). Verify that data feeds (logs, alerts) are flowing properly and that analysts have the technical resources needed to do their jobs.
* Compliance \& Readiness: Support the SOC Manager in enforcing organizational security policies and regulatory compliance in daily operations. This includes confirming that the team’s incident handling and documentation meet standards required for audits or industry regulations, which is especially critical in financial services. Drive readiness by organizing routine drills or simulations (e.g., incident response tabletop exercises) to ensure the team is prepared for various cyber scenarios.

**What you have**
-----------------

 **Required Qualifications:*** Experience: 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations or incident response, with at least 2–3 years in a senior SOC analyst or similar role. The candidate should have a demonstrated ability to handle high\-severity incidents and lead others. Prior experience in a team lead, technical lead, or supervisory capacity is strongly preferred.
* Technical Proficiency: Advanced hands\-on experience with SOC tools and processes. This includes expertise in using SIEM and EDR tools for analysis and an understanding of SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) platforms for workflow automation. In\-depth familiarity with incident response procedures (containment, eradication, recovery) as formalized in frameworks like NIST or SANS. Able to step in and perform any analyst task (from triage to deep forensic analysis) if needed.
* Leadership Skills: Proven track record of coordinating team activities or leading small teams during critical operations. This could be evidenced by experience as a senior analyst who has taken charge during incidents or mentored junior staff. Strong organizational skills to manage 24/7 shift scheduling and ensure coverage.
* Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Capable of effectively communicating with technical team members, as well as translating technical issues into actionable information for managers. Ability to provide clear guidance under pressure is essential for managing live security incidents.
* Certifications: Recognized credentials demonstrating both technical depth and leadership potential. Examples include advanced technical certs like SANS GCIA, GCIH (or similar) to validate incident handling expertise, and broad security management or professional certifications such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) to indicate knowledge of governance and leadership in security operations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Exposure to IAM domains such as identity governance and administration, access request and approval, access certifications, role management, privileged access management, single sign\-on, multifactor authentication, or directory services.
* Scrum Master, Agile, project management, business analysis, or process improvement certification or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience supporting regulated environments, audit response, control documentation, risk remediation, or compliance\-driven technology initiatives.
* Ability to build structured templates, dashboards, operating procedures, and reporting routines that improve transparency and repeatability.
Experience identifying repeatable work patterns and partnering with technology teams to automate tracking, reporting, intake, follow\-up, evidence collection, or other recurring IAM program management activities.  
*

------------------------

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.

title: Staff IT Risk Analyst
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


The Third‑Party Cybersecurity Risk Management (TPCRM) Staff Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping, governing, and continuously improving information risk management related to external suppliers. The analyst leads complex and ambiguous third‑party cybersecurity risk issues, advises senior business and security stakeholders, drives program maturity, and supports enterprise‑level decision‑making across Information Security, Privacy, Regulatory Compliance, Procurement, Legal, and Governance.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as a staff\-level subject matter expert for third‑party cybersecurity risk management, including enterprise supplier risk governance, regulatory alignment, and assessment quality.
* Lead highly complex third‑party risk assessments involving critical suppliers, high‑risk services, sensitive data, manufacturing dependencies, or material business impact.
* Shape assessment methodology, risk criteria, evidence expectations, and control evaluation practices to improve consistency, scalability, and defensibility of TPCRM outcomes.
* Perform advanced gap analysis against frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, SOX, TISAX, and GDPR, and advise stakeholders on enterprise‑level remediation priorities.
* Lead risk treatment strategy for material supplier findings, including mitigation planning, risk acceptance recommendations, supplier escalations, evidence validation, and closure decisions.
* Develop, revise, and mature third‑party risk management policies, standards, processes, guidelines, and runbooks through formal governance and change management.
* Lead third‑party governance activities, including onsite supplier audits, executive risk reporting, cross‑functional working groups, and escalation of material supplier risks.
* Translate cybersecurity, regulatory, supplier, and threat intelligence insights into actionable risk themes, program enhancements, and supplier risk mitigation strategies.
* Interpret risk tolerance, contractual obligations, control tradeoffs, supplier criticality, and business impact to support informed risk acceptance, mitigation, avoidance, or transfer decisions.
* Partner with procurement, legal, information security, business, privacy, resilience, and vendor management teams to embed TPCRM expectations throughout the supplier lifecycle.
* Advise business‑led initiatives on third‑party cyber risk, due diligence requirements, standards compliance, supplier engagement, and governance escalation paths.
* Mentor senior and junior analysts, lead process improvement initiatives, advance automation and reporting maturity, and help establish consistent TPCRM execution across teams and regions.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Management Information Systems/Business Administration. Master’s degree is preferred.
* Related field of study or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Experience**:


Analyzing and applying Information Security, Cyber Risk Management, Third‑Party Risk Management, and Privacy practices for a minimum of seven years of experience, with demonstrated ability to lead complex supplier risk issues, influence cross‑functional stakeholders, and improve risk management practices in the following areas:

* Advanced third‑party / vendor risk management, supplier assessments, external assurance programs, cybersecurity governance, or enterprise risk functions.
* Strong IT business process knowledge, supplier lifecycle understanding, business acumen, and ability to connect supplier risk to operational and enterprise impact.
* Experience influencing procurement, legal, vendor management, privacy, information security, business, and executive stakeholders on risk decisions and remediation priorities.
* Experience working with and improving third\-party risk management tools such as ServiceNow, Optro, Archer, AuditBoard, SecurityScorecard, BitSight, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience developing risk analytics, dashboards, scorecards, executive reporting, metrics, and narratives that communicate third\-party risk posture and program maturity.
* Advanced understanding of threat, vulnerability, business continuity, supplier security, incident response, and third\-party risk assessment methodologies.
* Knowledge of national and international regulatory and security frameworks including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO standards, SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, TISAX, and related supplier security expectations.
* Experience leading risk treatment decisions, remediation governance, supplier escalations, executive briefings, onsite supplier assessments, or high\-risk supplier reviews.
* CRISC, CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISM, or equivalent certifications are preferred.
* Preferred skills in SharePoint, Teams, reporting tools, workflow platforms, AI\-enabled automation, and other collaboration or knowledge management platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to mature cybersecurity risk practices, establish reusable processes, and improve outcomes across third\-party ecosystems and high\-risk supplier relationships.

**Soft skills requirements**

* Ability to define, communicate, and influence enterprise third‑party cybersecurity risk decisions in business‑relevant language.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to craft and deliver concise executive\-level communications, risk narratives, and decision briefs.
* Ability to lead confidently through ambiguity, competing priorities, sensitive supplier issues, and rapidly changing risk conditions.
* Ability to communicate cybersecurity and third‑party risk concepts clearly to technical, non‑technical, supplier, and executive audiences.
* Strong problem‑solving, analytical, facilitation, negotiation, and risk‑based decision‑making skills.
* Ability to mentor analysts, build stakeholder trust, influence without direct authority, and drive consistent execution across cross‑functional and regional teams.

title: Senior Administrator, Corporate Systems
description:
Job Description:
**Job Purpose**


The Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) Corporate Systems Senior Developer will be responsible for the end\-to\-end administration, deployment, and development of the ORMB application built on the Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF). This role combines hands\-on system administration — including fresh installations, environment provisioning, patch management, and release deployments — with Java\-based development of enhancements, integrations, and batch processing solutions.

  

Working under the direction of the Technical Manager, this role requires frequent collaboration with functional business analysts, infrastructure/DBA teams, third\-party vendors, and end users to ensure high availability, compliance, and continuous delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application. The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large\-volume financial systems.  

  

**Responsibilities**

 *System Administration \& Environment Management*

* Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers
	+ Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
	+ Manage multi\-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.
* Apply Oracle\-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.
	+ Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
	+ Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post\-patch environment integrity.
* Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.
	+ Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
	+ Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post\-deployment validation.
* Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
* Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment\-specific configuration documentation.

*Development \& Enhancements*

* Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
* Build and maintain third\-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e\-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file\-based patterns.
* Develop and optimize batch programs for high\-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM\-level tuning.
* Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.

*Production Support \& Operations*

* Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
* Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
* Perform year\-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
* Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform\-level issues.

*Collaboration \& Governance*

* Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
* Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
* Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel\-run testing and validation activities.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 5\+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC\&B, including hands\-on administration of OUAF\-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 5\+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi\-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high\-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors.

**Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8\.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC\&B / ORMB v2\.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

title: Data Center & Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Alkem:**




  





 Alkem Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, that manufactures and sells pharmaceutical generics, formulations and nutraceuticals in India and globally over 50 countries. We have consistently been ranked amongst the top five pharmaceutical companies in India. Our portfolio includes illustrious brands like Clavam, Pan, Pan\-D, and Taxim\-O, which feature amongst the top 50 pharmaceutical brands in India.
 



  





**Purpose of the Role:**




  





 The incumbent will own the architecture, engineering, operations, security, availability, and lifecycle management of Alkem's on\-premise infrastructure, enterprise networks, SD\-WAN, internet services, remote access, wireless networks, data centers, plant connectivity, and network security platforms.
 



 This role is responsible for ensuring a secure, scalable, resilient, and high\-performing network and infrastructure environment across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, R\&D centers, warehouses, distribution locations, and international operations, enabling seamless connectivity for users, applications, cloud platforms, and third\-party partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





 1\. Enterprise Network Architecture \& Engineering
 


* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise network architecture, standards, reference designs, IP addressing schemes, routing, segmentation, redundancy, and capacity plans.
* Lead engineering and implementation of LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, internet connectivity, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, load balancing, wireless networks, cloud connectivity, and remote access services.
* Conduct technical assessments and reviews for new facilities, plant expansions, data center upgrades, cloud integrations, application onboarding, and network modernization initiatives.
* Maintain current and future\-state architecture documentation, network diagrams, configuration standards, dependency maps, and technology roadmaps.



 2\. Network Operations \& Service Assurance
 


* Manage network availability, performance, utilization, configuration management, backup, patching, and lifecycle management of routers, switches, wireless controllers, access points, and related infrastructure.
* Implement and manage centralized network monitoring, configuration compliance, event management, traffic analytics, log collection, and proactive capacity monitoring.
* Lead resolution of critical incidents, coordinate root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Define, monitor, and report network KPIs including availability, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization, incident response time, change success rate, and recurring fault trends.



 3\. Data Center \& On\-Premise Infrastructure Management
 


* Manage data center and server\-room infrastructure, including racks, power systems, UPS, structured cabling, environmental monitoring, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Coordinate operations of physical servers, virtualization platforms, storage systems, backup appliances, console access, and out\-of\-band management in collaboration with platform teams.
* Ensure resilient connectivity across primary and disaster recovery data centers, manufacturing plants, branch offices, cloud environments, and strategic partners.
* Support capacity planning, infrastructure refresh programs, relocations, consolidations, commissioning, and decommissioning activities while ensuring proper documentation and governance.



 4\. Network Security \& Segmentation
 


* Partner with Information Security teams to implement and manage firewalls, VPNs, SASE, Secure Web Access, Network Access Control (NAC), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), DNS security, and network segmentation controls.
* Maintain appropriate segregation between corporate IT, servers, guest networks, vendor access, laboratories, manufacturing systems, and OT environments based on approved security architecture.
* Manage and periodically review firewall rules, remote access paths, privileged administration access, third\-party connectivity, and network security exceptions.
* Ensure integration of network logs, alerts, and security events with enterprise monitoring and Security Operations processes.



 5\. Plant, OT \& Site Connectivity
 


* Ensure highly available communication services for manufacturing plants, laboratories, warehouses, utilities, serialization systems, automation platforms, and OT environments.
* Coordinate with Engineering, OT, Automation, Quality, Application, and Information Security teams to implement secure connectivity and manage controlled changes in regulated environments.
* Drive last\-mile redundancy, link diversity, failover testing, wireless coverage optimization, and site\-specific capacity planning initiatives.
* Maintain accurate inventories, network diagrams, telecom circuit records, support contacts, escalation matrices, and disaster recovery procedures for all sites.



 6\. Telecom, Carrier \& Vendor Management
 


* Manage relationships with telecom carriers, internet service providers, SD\-WAN partners, OEMs, system integrators, cabling vendors, and managed service providers.
* Oversee circuit procurement, service activation, bandwidth expansion, contract renewals, inventory reconciliation, billing validation, and service credit management.
* Monitor vendor performance against contractual obligations, SLAs, security requirements, incident response commitments, and improvement plans.
* Support vendor evaluation, technical scope definition, bill\-of\-material reviews, proof\-of\-concept activities, and technology selection initiatives.



 7\. Service Management, Governance \& Compliance
 


* Establish and enforce standard practices for solution deployment, hardening, change management, configuration management, backups, access controls, and documentation.
* Support audits, risk assessments, regulatory inspections, evidence collection, remediation planning, and compliance requirements relevant to pharmaceutical operations.
* Maintain infrastructure asset inventory, warranty and AMC records, software versions, licensing compliance, spares management, and end\-of\-life remediation plans.



  





**Educational Qualification:**




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Telecommunications, or a related discipline.



  





**Professional Experience:**




  




* 8\-10 years of progressive experience in enterprise networking and on\-premise infrastructure management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in network architecture, engineering, infrastructure operations, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience managing large\-scale, multi\-site enterprise environments across corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and remote locations.



  





**Preferred Industry Experience:**




  




* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Chemical, Manufacturing, or other regulated industries is highly preferred.
* Proven exposure to supporting business\-critical applications, manufacturing operations, and geographically distributed users.



  





**Technical Competencies:**




  





 The incumbent should possess strong expertise in Routing \& Switching technologies, including TCP/IP, BGP, and OSPF protocols, along with comprehensive knowledge of LAN, WAN, and SD\-WAN environments. The role requires hands\-on experience in Wireless Networking, DNS, DHCP, IP Address Management (IPAM), VPN technologies, Network Segmentation, Security Architecture, Network Monitoring, Performance Analysis, and advanced troubleshooting and incident management. The candidate should also have working knowledge of firewalls, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, cloud connectivity, Operational Technology (OT) networking, data center infrastructure, virtualization dependencies, ITIL\-based service management practices, vendor and contract management, as well as audit, compliance, and regulatory support activities.
