WorkSpan already has seven of the world’s ten largest partner ecosystems on our platform and $50B of customer pipeline under active management. AWS, Google, Microsoft, MongoDB, PagerDuty, Databricks and dozens of others trust WorkSpan to accelerate and amplify their ecosystem strategies.  

With a $30M series C and backing from world class investors Insight Partners, Mayfield, and M12, WorkSpan is poised to drive the future of B2B. Come be a part of it.  

  

**Join our team for the opportunity to:**  

* Own your results and make a tangible impact on the business
* Develop a deep understanding of GTM working closely with leadership across sales \& marketing
* Work with driven, passionate people every day
* Be a part of an ambitious, supportive team on a mission
**Job Brief: Multi\-Cloud SRE / DevOps Engineer**
-------------------------------------------------


We are seeking a versatile Multi\-Cloud Site Reliability / DevOps Engineer to design, automate, and maintain our geographically distributed infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure. In this role, you will champion a true multi\-cloud strategy by avoiding vendor lock\-in, optimizing cloud costs, and deploying highly available, fault\-tolerant systems. You will act as the bridge between software development and IT operations, treating infrastructure as a software engineering problem to eliminate manual toil.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Multi\-Cloud Architecture \& Orchestration: Design, provision, and maintain resilient infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure using cloud\-agnostic Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools to ensure environment parity.
* CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build, automate, and streamline cross\-platform continuous integration and delivery pipelines that seamlessly route workloads to their optimal cloud environments.
* Site Reliability \& Observability: Establish Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Objectives (SLOs). Set up centralized, multi\-cloud logging and monitoring platforms to trace metrics and proactively diagnose bottlenecks before they impact users.
* Incident Response \& On\-Call: Triage production issues, manage incident bridges, and lead blameless post\-mortems to drive continuous systemic improvements.
* Disaster Recovery \& High Availability: Engineer multi\-region and active\-active failover strategies between different public cloud providers to prevent single points of failure.
* FinOps \& Resource Optimization: Monitor utilization patterns, implement automated scaling, and drive cost\-saving initiatives across all three cloud platforms.

**Cloud\-Specific Engineering Duties**
--------------------------------------


As a multi\-cloud engineer, you will be expected to leverage and manage native services across the major providers:


Cloud Platform

  

Key Responsibilities \& Target Services

  

AWS

  

Manage compute and orchestration using EKS, EC2, and Lambda. Configure network topology (VPC, Route53\) and manage access via AWS IAM. Utilize native or agnostic tools (CloudFormation, Terraform) for provisioning.

  

GCP

  

Oversee containerized workloads via GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine). Optimize data pipelines/storage using BigQuery and Cloud Storage. Manage Google Cloud Load Balancing and Anthos for multi\-cloud deployments.

  

Azure

  

Deploy and scale applications using AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service). Automate infrastructure management via ARM templates or Bicep. Ensure tight integration with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) for secure identity management.

  

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* Experience: 1 to 4 years in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering, with hands\-on production experience in at least two of the three major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced proficiency in Terraform (strongly preferred for multi\-cloud parity), alongside familiarity with CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, or Deployment Manager.
* Containerization \& Kubernetes: Deep understanding of Docker and production\-level experience administering Kubernetes clusters (EKS, GKE, AKS).
* Automation/Scripting: Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for automating systemic operations and interacting with various Cloud APIs.
* CI/CD Tooling: Experience with cloud\-agnostic deployment tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Jenkins, or CircleCI.
* Observability Stack: Hands\-on experience configuring Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK/EFK stack for unified multi\-cloud dashboards.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) practices and multi\-cloud governance frameworks.
* Certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert.

title: SUPPLY CHAIN ANALYST III
description:
About TE
  

TE Connectivity is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. Our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, renewable energy, automated factories, data centers, medical technology and more. With more than 85,000 employees, including 8,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 counties, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS.

  

**Job Overview:**

  

  

The Supply Chain Analyst is a key contributor in executing and managing inventory replenishment across a global supply network, ensuring seamless flow from multiple TE manufacturing plants to regional Distribution Centers (DCs). This role is accountable for maintaining optimal inventory levels, driving supply reliability, and ensuring customer orders are consistently fulfilled in full and on time (IFOT).
  

Operating in a complex, cross\-regional environment, the analyst partners with Planning, Distribution Operations, Customer Care, and global stakeholders to monitor supply\-demand alignment, resolve critical exceptions, and mitigate operational risks. While primarily execution\-focused, the role requires proactive problem\-solving, data\-driven decision\-making, and process improvement, enabling continuous enhancements in inventory performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
  

The position demands strong analytical capability, advanced system proficiency, and effective cross\-functional collaboration, with exposure to global supply chain operations and opportunities to take on higher\-level responsibilities and leadership initiatives. This role provides a foundation for progression into senior or strategic supply chain roles within the organization.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**
-------------------------------


* Front\-Side Business Engagement \& Customer Focus

o Act as a key interface across Customer Care, Logistics, and Planning teams to ensure seamless order fulfillment and a consistent customer experience.
  

o Ensure customer orders are delivered in full and on time (IFOT) by actively monitoring order flows, identifying risks early, and executing corrective actions.
  

o Lead resolution of complex supply and order exceptions, minimizing disruption to customer commitments and ensuring proactive risk mitigation.
  

o Serve as an escalation point for critical supply issues, coordinating cross\-functional responses and influencing timely decision\-making.
* Operational Excellence \& Supply Coordination

o Own end\-to\-end replenishment strategy and execution for assigned plants and Distribution Centers across regions, ensuring optimal inventory positioning and service levels.
  

o Drive global supply coordination by partnering with plant planners, regional teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to balance supply, demand, and capacity constraints.
  

o Manage and optimize system utilization (e.g., SAP and planning tools), ensuring master data accuracy and effective MRP signal execution.
  

o Identify and implement process improvements in replenishment planning, inventory positioning, and exception handling to enhance efficiency and scalability.
* Performance Management \& Continuous Improvement

o Analyze supply chain performance trends and provide data\-driven insights to improve inventory health, service levels, and operational efficiency.
  

o Own and continuously improve key KPIs, including On Time Delivery (OTD), Past Due To Target Date (PDTD), Past Due to Request (PDR), Ship To Request (STR), Ship To Schedule (STS) and Inventory, driving accountability across stakeholders.
  

o Prepare and present performance insights and actionable recommendations to stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  

o Lead or contribute to cross\-regional and global initiatives such as process standardization, system enhancements, and supply chain optimization projects.
* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management

o Drive accountability and influence without authority across functions and regions to achieve supply chain objectives.
  

o Provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts or team members, supporting capability development and knowledge sharing.
  

o Lead and contribute to cross\-functional and global initiatives, delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, process optimization, and overall customer satisfaction.
**Mandate Skills:**
-------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA is a strong advantage.
* 5–8\+ years of progressive experience in supply chain operations, with demonstrated growth in scope, responsibility, and impact.
* Proven track record of operating in a global or multi\-regional environment, effectively collaborating with stakeholders across different time zones and cultures.
* Strong expertise in MRP, procurement, inventory management, and end\-to\-end supply planning processes, with the ability to optimize complex supply networks.
* Advanced proficiency in SAP (mandatory); experience with S/4HANA, SupplyOn, and IBP Response preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives or projects, driving measurable improvements in service levels, inventory performance, or operational efficiency.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into strategic insights and actionable decisions.
* Experience in managing ambiguity, resolving escalations, and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both operational teams and senior leadership.
* Proven mindset of continuous improvement, innovation, and ownership, with a focus on delivering business outcomes.
* Ability to mentor junior team members or lead small teams/projects, demonstrating early leadership capability.
* High level of adaptability, resilience, and agility in a fast\-paced, dynamic global environment.
* Willingness to work across time zones and travel as needed to support global operations.

  

**What TE Connectivity offers:**
  

We offer competitive rewards \& compensation. Our commitment to our employees includes offering benefit programs that are comprehensive, competitive and will meet the needs of our employees.

title: SR MGR GENERAL MANAGEMENT
description:
TE has demonstrated significant AI activity, with more than 250 use cases in pilot. The next challenge is enterprise scale: many solutions remain limited to one or two sites. This role is accountable for changing that by replicating proven AI solutions across the enterprise and converting reuse into measurable productivity.The position is an operational scaling and value\-realisation role. It connects the Lighthouse operating model, TEOA Business System, BU AI Product Owner network and AI360 catalogue to accelerate adoption across autonomous business units and sites.The Senior Manager, AI Value Realisation is accountable for converting proven AI solutions into enterprise\-wide productivity. The role works across all five supply chain pillars and all ten business units to ensure that proven solutions are deployed, adopted and delivering value wherever applicable.Success requires strong influence without direct line authority, credibility with plant and operations leaders, disciplined reuse of proven solutions, and rigorous tracking of adoption and financial value.


**Roles \& Responsibility:**
----------------------------


1\. Own Replication Across the Five Pillars of ION (Core Responsibility: Develop \& Source)Identify where a solution proven in one pillar or business unit applies elsewhere and drive replication to the relevant sites and BUs.Apply the appropriate scaling model: Source and Deliver can scale horizontally across BUs, while Make and Develop primarily scale within a BU.Maintain an enterprise view of what exists, what is proven and what is spreading, and identify duplicate problem\-solving efforts across BUs.Chair guardrail reviews for duplicate builds, keeping the review focused on duplication without creating a broad approval gate for innovation.

  

2\.Run the Kaizen Event CircuitLead the structured Kaizen Event circuit at Lighthouse sites within the TEOA Business System.Enforce catalogue\-first discipline: match opportunities against existing assets before any new solution is scoped.Ensure a new build proceeds only when appropriate architecture review confirms that no proven solution covers the need.Ensure each event concludes with a committed portfolio, named BU owner, delivery dates and a within\-BU replication map.

  

  

3\. Build and Lead the BU NetworkEstablish and lead the network of BU AI Product Owners across all ten business units through a matrix leadership model.Run a quarterly cross\-BU forum focused on horizontal reuse and transfer of proven solutions across Lighthouse teams.Assess site AI readiness before Lighthouse confirmation and work with BU and TEOA leadership to close readiness gaps.  



  

4\. Drive Adoption, Not Just DeploymentOwn the people and change\-management aspects of scaling, including site change agents, learn\-do\-teach capability building and locally relevant change narratives.Track functionality usage and user adoption by site and intervene when a deployed solution is not being used or is not delivering intended value.  



  

5\. Own Catalogue QualityBe accountable for the AI360 catalogue being complete, accurately rated and usable, in partnership with the AI360 Product Owner who owns the platform.Ensure replication packs meet the standard required for another site to deploy a solution with minimal central support.Feed learning from every Kaizen Event back into the catalogue so each engagement improves reuse readiness for other business units.  



  

6\. Report and Defend the NumberReport replication and adoption performance monthly by BU and quarterly to the Operations SLT.Partner with Finance to validate TEBIT attribution and maintain disciplined benefit counting, with each benefit booked once by the organization that realises it.


**Desired Candidate Profile:**
------------------------------


Operational credibility: 10\+ years of experience in supply chain, manufacturing or operations, including experience in a plant or distribution environment.Influence without authority: Demonstrated success driving cross\-site or cross\-BU change in autonomous organizations without direct line authority.Lean and continuous improvement fluency: Deep familiarity with a structured business system such as TEOA, TPS, WCM or equivalent, and practical experience using Kaizen as a working method.Technical literacy: Sufficient understanding of AI, analytics and data platforms to evaluate feasibility, challenge recommendations and translate between technical and operational audiences.Ownership of measurable outcomes: Prior accountability for a P\&L, productivity, savings or similar performance target, with evidence of delivery.Execution discipline: Ability to maintain scope boundaries and operating\-model discipline under competing stakeholder demands.


DesirableExperience deploying the same solution across multiple sites and managing the operational challenges of replication.Exposure to product\-management practices including backlogs, releases, configuration and customisation decisions.Experience in a matrix or hub\-and\-spoke organization with strong local autonomy.Multi\-region experience and comfort working across cultures and time zones.

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

title: PKI, HSM & Certificate Services Sr. Engineer
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/
**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

  

*You are a hands\-on cryptography and certificate services engineer supporting a next\-generation Identity and Access Management team. You will help design, administer, automate, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Hardware Security Module (HSM), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic services across Solventum’s global environment.*

*You are excited about strengthening cryptographic foundations in a large global company by supporting secure certificate issuance, lifecycle automation, key protection, and platform resiliency across cloud, on\-premises, third\-party hosted, and co\-location environments.*

*You are a self\-driven, hands\-on individual who enjoys solving complex PKI, HSM, certificate, TLS/SSL, code\-signing, and key management challenges. You bring strong technical depth, operational discipline, and a continuous improvement mindset to critical security services.*

As a PKI/HSM Crypto Sr. Security Engineer you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:  



* Designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise PKI solutions, including Microsoft ADCS and Keyfactor certificate lifecycle automation platforms.
* Managing the full certificate lifecycle, including issuance, renewal, revocation, inventory management, policy enforcement, and automation for internal and external certificates.
* Administering and maintaining Thales Luna HSM platforms, including key generation, backup, recovery, partition management, firmware upgrades, and security compliance activities.
* Managing external public certificate services through Sectigo, including certificate provisioning, domain validation, organization validation, and integrations with enterprise applications and services.
* Developing and maintaining PKI architectures, cryptographic standards, and key management procedures aligned with security and regulatory requirements.
* Troubleshooting complex PKI, certificate, TLS/SSL, code\-signing, and cryptographic issues across enterprise applications, network devices, cloud services, and security platforms.
* Implementing and supporting certificate automation and integrations with web servers, load balancers, network appliances, cloud platforms, DevOps pipelines, and identity solutions.
* Ensuring compliance with industry standards and security frameworks, including NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOX, ISO 27001, and CA/Browser Forum requirements where applicable.
* Performing PKI risk assessments, security reviews, disaster recovery testing, key ceremonies, and operational readiness activities for critical cryptographic infrastructure.
Collaborating with security, infrastructure, application, and cloud engineering teams to design secure cryptographic solutions and support enterprise security initiatives.  
* 

  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:  



* Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND 7 years of enterprise PKI, certificate management, HSM, cryptography, infrastructure security, or related experience
* In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:5\+ years of hands\-on experience administering enterprise PKI or certificate management environments, including certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, inventory, and lifecycle operations.
* Experience supporting Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS), Windows Server environments, and enterprise certificate templates or enrollment workflows.
* Experience with certificate lifecycle automation platforms such as Keyfactor, including certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal, workflow, and integration support.
* Experience administering HSM platforms or secure key management technologies, including key generation, backup, recovery, partition management, and operational controls.Strong understanding of X.509 certificates, CRL, OCSP, PKCS standards, TLS/SSL, code signing, encryption, and cryptographic key management concepts.
* Experience troubleshooting PKI, certificate chain, TLS/SSL, certificate deployment, code\-signing, and cryptographic issues across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
* Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation as an escalation point for high\-severity PKI, HSM, certificate, and cryptographic service issues.
* Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: 10\+ years of experience administering enterprise PKI and certificate management environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Keyfactor, Sectigo Certificate Manager, and Thales Luna HSM platforms
* Experience managing public certificate services, including certificate provisioning, domain validation, organization validation, and externally trusted certificate operations.
* Experience supporting certificate automation through APIs, scripting, ACME, SCEP, ServiceNow workflows, cloud platforms, DevOps pipelines, or enterprise application integrations.
* Experience performing PKI risk assessments, disaster recovery testing, key ceremonies, operational readiness reviews, and audit or compliance support.
Advanced scripting or automation skills, including PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or other automation frameworks.  
* 

  

  

**Work location: Bangalore (Hybrid)**

title: Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform.



We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.


**Role**



We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, of Engineering.


**What you'll do (Role Expectations)**


* Lead ZCC feature design and hands\-on C\+\+ implementation on Linux environment.
* Take full technical ownership of complex projects, from concept to deployment.
* Elevate code quality and enforce best practices to ensure a robust, efficient, and secure client.
* Ability to process packets at both ingress and egress points at very high speed so that client using the system does not perceive any increased latencies.
* To work cross\-functionally with the Quality Assurance team to test the work product, and influence the testing to make the product ready for deployment

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

* You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)**


* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 5\+ years of experience of developing enterprise applications with distributed systems background.
* Strong C/C\+\+ programming, Data structures/Algorithms \& debugging skills in a cloud environment.
* Deep understanding of Operating System principles and OS like Linux/Unix.
* Extensive network programming experience (TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, proxy) with knowledge of kernel\-mode networking or NDIS drivers

* Experience implementing AIOps, AI\-driven predictive scaling, or automated anomaly detection to optimize cloud infrastructure performance and reliability
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, encryption (PKI, TLS/SSL), authentication, endpoint agents, and anti\-tampering
* Experience in Network Data Path \& Socket programming \& POSIX Multi\-thread programming.


\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-GL2

title: High Speed Hardware Design Engineer
description:
**ARQUIMEA**, we are a **technology company** operating globally and providing innovate solutions and products in highly demanding sectors.


Our areas of activity are **Aerospace, Defense \& Security, Big Science, Biotechnology and Fintech.**


**In** **ARQUIMEA AEROSPACE DEFENCE \& SECURITY** develops safer and more reliable defense systems through technology, including **unmanned aerial systems (UAVs), sensing systems, command and control software, and aiming systems**.


We are looking for a **High Speed hardware Desing Engineer** to join our engineering team, working on the development of advanced electronic systems for aerospace, defence and other high\-reliability applications.


The successful candidate will be responsible for the design and development of complex high\-speed digital electronic boards, including systems based on high\-performance FPGAs and adaptive SoCs.

**MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Design complex high\-speed digital electronic boards from requirements definition through schematic design, PCB layout supervision, manufacturing and bring\-up.
* Design FPGA/SoC\-based architectures using devices such as AMD/Xilinx Versal, UltraScale\+ or equivalent high\-performance devices.
* Define and review high\-speed interfaces including DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, Ethernet, JESD204, SerDes and multi\-gigabit transceivers.
* Perform or support Signal Integrity (SI) and Power Integrity (PI) analysis, including impedance control, termination, crosstalk, power distribution networks and decoupling strategies.
* Define PCB stack\-ups, controlled\-impedance structures, differential pairs and high\-speed routing constraints.
* Design power architectures for high\-performance FPGA/SoC devices, including multi\-rail power supplies, sequencing and power monitoring.
* Select electronic components considering performance, availability, reliability and product requirements.
* Work closely with PCB layout engineers to ensure compliance with high\-speed design constraints and manufacturing requirements.
* Support board bring\-up, debugging, integration and functional verification using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and high\-speed measurement equipment.
* Prepare and maintain hardware design documentation, design analyses and verification documentation.
* Participate in technical and design reviews throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with FPGA, software, systems, mechanical, test and manufacturing teams.

**EDUCATION \& COMPETENCES**

* Level – Required education degree:

This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building modern, scalable enterprise applications that work with **large\-scale industrial and time\-series datasets** and deliver rich, responsive user experiences.

  

The role requires strong **full\-stack development expertise with a primary focus on frontend engineering using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS**, along with solid experience in **C\#/.NET, REST APIs, and backend services**.

  

You will design and deliver complex product features across the full stack, contribute to frontend architecture and modernization, and work closely with Product Management, UX, QA, Architecture, and other R\&D teams. You will also help establish frontend engineering practices that improve performance, maintainability, usability, and developer productivity.

**Essential Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

* Strong hands\-on expertise in Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS/SCSS.
* Strong understanding of Angular architecture, component design, services, dependency injection, routing, reactive programming/RxJS, and modern frontend development patterns.
* Experience designing complex, reusable, and maintainable UI components and frontend frameworks.

* Experience developing responsive, accessible, and cross\-browser enterprise applications.
* Good hands\-on experience with C\#/.NET, REST APIs, and backend service development, with the ability to contribute across the full technology stack.
* Strong understanding of API integration, asynchronous programming, error handling, authentication/authorization, and client\-server application architecture.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, design patterns, automated testing, Git, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience with frontend testing frameworks and approaches covering unit, component, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

  

**Desired Skills \& Experience**

  

* Experience building data\-intensive, analytics\-driven, or visualization\-heavy enterprise applications.
* Experience optimizing large\-data workflows across UI rendering, API calls, pagination, caching, lazy loading, virtualization, and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with modern UI component libraries, data grids, charting/visualization frameworks, and complex interactive controls.
* Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, reusable component libraries, and application modernization.
* Experience with web accessibility, responsive design, localization/internationalization, browser compatibility, and frontend security.
* Experience working with modern authentication and authorization patterns such as OIDC and JWT.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native application development, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Azure\-based environments.
* Understanding of backend and distributed\-system concepts including microservices, asynchronous messaging, caching, and resiliency.
* Strong production\-first mindset with experience troubleshooting UI, API, performance, and integration issues in enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and their responsible use for development, testing, documentation, and engineering productivity.
* Experience with industrial analytics, process data, historian platforms, time\-series data, or similar data\-intensive products is an advantage.
* Experience working with geographically distributed Agile/Scrum product development teams.

 **R\&D at AVEVA**

  

Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

  

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

  

You’ll also be joining an award\-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

title: Senior Mobile SDET
description:
**SENIOR MOBILE SDET** **We are looking for a** **Senior Mobile SDET** **to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital \& Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.** **Position Snapshot:**  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

 **The Role:** *As a* ***Senior Mobile SDET****, you will be responsible for the ownership, evolution, and operational excellence of Nespresso’s mobile automation frameworks across Android and iOS platforms. Working under the technical direction of the Automation Engineering Architect, you will ensure mobile automation solutions are scalable, stable, reusable, and fully integrated into DevOps and CI/CD pipelines, enabling consistent adoption across product and project teams.**You will collaborate closely with product teams, mobile developers, DevOps engineers, and fellow Quality Engineering specialists to drive sustainable automation practices and improve automation coverage, reliability, and release confidence. The role plays a key part in reducing automation\-related incidents, unblocking teams facing automation challenges, and enabling self\-service adoption of mobile automation frameworks across the organization.*  

**In This Role, You Will:**  

* Own, maintain, and evolve Android and iOS automation frameworks, ensuring scalability, stability, reusability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Define and implement mobile automation standards, shared libraries, utilities, and execution practices that support consistent adoption across teams.
* Integrate mobile automation frameworks into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows, enabling reliable and efficient automated execution.
* Support execution across BrowserStack, device farms, simulators, and emulators while ensuring secure and stable test execution.
* Leverage AI\-powered capabilities to improve test design, execution optimization, flakiness detection, automation self\-healing, and engineering productivity.
* Support product and project teams by resolving automation challenges, improving automation coverage, and increasing framework adoption.
* Provide coaching and technical guidance to Automation Testing Engineers and contribute to Communities of Practice, standards, documentation, and best practices.
* Evaluate new tools, technologies, and execution approaches through proofs of concept and provide recommendations for adoption.

 **What We’re Looking For:**  

* 7\+ years of experience in Test Automation, Quality Engineering, or Software Engineering, with strong expertise in mobile automation.
* Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation frameworks for Android and iOS applications.
* Hands\-on experience with mobile automation technologies such as Espresso, Compose UI Testing, XCUITest, Appium, or equivalent frameworks.
* Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Fastlane).
* Solid software engineering background, including version control, code reviews, branching strategies, and framework maintainability practices.
* Experience working with cloud\-based mobile execution platforms such as BrowserStack, device farms, simulators, and emulators.
* Strong understanding of Quality Engineering principles, including Automation First, Shift\-Left Testing, Quality by Design, and Product Quality Ownership.
* Experience supporting multiple product teams in federated or product\-led delivery environments.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot automation challenges, improve framework reliability, and reduce flaky test executions.
* Strong communication, collaboration, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered tools and techniques to enhance automation capability.

 **Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**  

* Knowledge of mobile application architecture, API integrations, and backend services supporting mobile ecosystems.
* Experience with observability platforms, quality analytics, or telemetry\-driven testing approaches.
* Experience contributing to Communities of Practice, reusable engineering assets, standards, or automation governance initiatives.
* Knowledge of cloud\-native technologies, containerized environments, and modern DevSecOps practices.

  

**We Offer You:**  

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state\-of\-the\-art campus is equipped with areas to co\-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic \& inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

 **The Hiring Process:*** **Your Application:** Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Initial Screening:** Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.

* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.  

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.  

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net\-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.  

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*

title: Digital Advisory, Senior Manager
description:
Job Description
  
**About Avanade**

At Avanade, we help organizations see the future faster then actually build it. Our Advisory \& Experience practice sits at the intersection of Digital **strategy, experience, and AI** , working with governments, banks, healthcare systems, airports, and global brands across Southeast Asia.


We’re looking for a Consulting Lead who can operate at altitude and ground level — shaping thinking, leading client conversations, and turning ambiguity into momentum.


This role is for someone who feels equally comfortable with clients, on whiteboards, and close to delivery teams.


**Summary:**

We are seeking a Consulting Lead for our Advisory \& Experience team in India – a **digital strategy and transformation leader** who can drive innovation and value for our clients while collaborating with Avanade’s global network.


In this senior role, you will **lead end\-to\-end client engagements** , shape cutting\-edge solutions in areas like **experience design, AI transformation, and large\-scale change** , and ensure flawless delivery of digital initiatives.


This India\-based leadership position is locally focused but truly **part of a regional/global team** – you will co\-create with experts across Southeast Asia and worldwide, bringing the best of Avanade’s global expertise to solve local client challenges.


If you are a visionary consultant with 10–12\+ years’ experience in digital strategy and technology\-led change, excited to work in a high\-impact, collaborative environment, we invite you to join us in **transforming businesses and customer experiences** in the India


**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Leadership \& Engagement**

* Lead client engagements and act as a day\-to\-day trusted advisor.
* Confidently engage senior stakeholders, including **C\-suite and agency leadership** .
* Frame complex problems, guide decision\-making, and build client confidence.

**Strategy, Design \& Problem Solving**

* Apply Design Thinking and human\-centred design to reimagine products, services, and operating models.
* Develop AI\-enabled transformation roadmaps with a focus on automation, productivity uplift and process transformations.
* Translate ambiguous challenges into clear strategies, roadmaps, and action plans.
* Develop compelling, executive\-ready presentations that tell a strong story.
* Balance strategic thinking with practical, buildable solutions with a focus on technology and AI enabled Transformations.
* Shape and sharpen digital products and experiences, working closely with architects and engineers across CRM, AI, data, and cloud platforms — with strong exposure to the Microsoft ecosystem (Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure Infra \& Apps, Azure Data \& AI, Copilot, and OpenAI). Also, exposure to other cloud and data platforms such as Google, AWS could be beneficial.

**Team \& Practice Leadership**

* Actively contribute to practice growth in India, including capability building, talent development, and delivery excellence.

* Lead, mentor, and develop consultants, analysts, and designers across engagements.
* Set and uphold quality standards for storytelling, facilitation, and client deliverables.
* Support sales and presales activities including discovery workshops, proposal shaping, and client pitches.

Qualification
  
* 10\+ years of experience in consulting, digital strategy, experience design, or digital transformation.
* Strong background in a top\-tier or boutique consulting firm preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading client engagements and multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Proven exposure to technology\-enabled solutions, spanning discovery through build and launch (not strategy\-only roles).

**Core Skills**

* Strong design thinking, facilitation, and workshop leadership capability.
* Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
* Structured problem solving with a human\-centric lens.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, make sound judgments, and drive clarity.
* Comfort bridging business, experience, and technology discussions.
* Good understanding of Cloud, Apps, Workplace, Data \& AI and ERP, CRM technologies.

**Mindset \& Attributes**

* Confident, curious, and commercially aware.
* Comfortable challenging clients respectfully and constructively.
* High energy, adaptable, and biased toward action.
* Collaborative leader who raises the bar for others.
* Focus on creating positive client impact not just deliverables.

title: Principal Engineer -Data Engineering
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a highly motivated Principal Engineer to design, architect, and lead Data Engineering initiatives within the HR Information Technology organization. This role requires a hands‑on technologist who can anchor critical initiatives to drive operational excellence and enhance employee and customer experience.


The Principal Engineer will provide technical leadership across the design, development, and operationalization of Data and Generative AI solutions, while shaping the enterprise HR data strategy. This role will oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient data engineering solutions across the HR data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, AI‑driven insights, and next‑generation HR capabilities. The Principal Engineer will also act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing architecture decisions, solution design, and implementation strategies to ensure alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long‑term technology strategy.

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in\-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long\-term, large\-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in\-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of progressive engineering experience with sustained hands‑on expertise in architecture, system design, and end‑to‑end solution development.
* 7\+ years of Data Engineering experience, with strong expertise in driving migration from legacy data platforms to cloud‑native, lakehouse‑based architectures
* 3\+ Years of Hands\-on experience in transformation of legacy data framework to modern stack in private or public cloud.
* Architect and implement modern data platforms using Azure Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Synapse, Real‑Time Analytics, Power BI integration).
* Design and build data pipelines and platforms on GCP using services such as : BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Pub/Sub, Dataproc/Spark, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataplex, Data Catalog
* Deep expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Beam)
* Strong hands‑on background of developing large scale enterprise applications.
* Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT patterns, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Hands on experience in building modernized applications using Microservice architecture.
* Cloud\-native engineering experience — serverless, managed Spark, event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, K8s) and workflow operators.
* Knowledge of data governance platforms (Collibra, Alation, Purview).
* Experience implementing lineage, observability, drift detection.
* Drive innovation by introducing emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices to improve decision‑making, automation, and predictive insights.
* Strong background in AI, Machine Learning, GenAI, including retrieval systems, embeddings, chunking strategies, and agentic AI workflows.

**Job Expectations:**

* Enterprise Technical Stewardship
	+ Act as a Principal Engineer and strategic advisor to senior leadership, shaping technology decisions that impact multiple lines of business and the broader enterprise.
	+ Define and evolve enterprise‑scale architectures for Data modernization ensuring alignment with security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Hands‑On Leadership
	+ Remain deeply hands‑on—designing, reviewing, and occasionally coding critical components to set a high engineering bar.
	+ Lead by example in applying engineering rigor, automation, testing, performance optimization, and secure coding practices.
* Influence \& Thought Leadership
	+ Serve as a visible technical spokesperson internally and externally, presenting ideas, architectures, and innovation narratives with clarity and conviction.
	+ Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising the overall technical maturity of the organization.
	+ Foster a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity, and continuous learning.
* Outside‑In Innovation
	+ Continuously scan the external ecosystem to bring new ideas, technologies, and patterns into the enterprise in a pragmatic, value‑driven manner.
	+ Challenge legacy thinking and advocate for simplification, modernization, and platform thinking.
	+ Balance innovation with operational stability, risk management, and long‑term sustainability.
* Data Engineering
	+ Responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining metadata‑driven, scalable, high‑performance data engineering frameworks that power critical data ecosystem in the HR space.
	+ Define and execute the enterprise data engineering roadmap aligned to business priorities.
	+ Mentor data engineering teams delivering scalable, secure, and high quality data solutions.
	+ Partner with architecture, product, analytics, and risk teams to drive data driven decision making.
	+ Track industry trends, evaluate relevant tools/platforms, and adapt the best practices,
* AI / GenAI Enablement
	+ Drive the strategy, adoption, and governance of AI and GenAI capabilities across HR initiatives.
	+ Partner with product, data, risk, and security teams to ensure responsible, explainable, and scalable AI solutions.
	+ Identify high‑value use cases and guide teams from proof‑of‑concept to production at scale.
* Outcome‑Driven Execution
	+ Measure success through business impact, not just technical delivery—improved time‑to‑market, developer productivity, system resilience, and customer outcomes.
	+ Partner closely with stakeholders to ensure technology investments deliver durable, enterprise‑wide value.

Summary:

Our Technology teams challenge the status quo and reimagine capabilities across industries. Whether through research and development, technology innovation or solution engineering, our people play vital roles in connecting consumers with the products and platforms of tomorrow.


Job Duties and Responsibilities:

As part of the expanding InfoSec Center of Excellence at BTC, DISH is scaling its daily Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VA/PT) operations. The Lead / Staff Operational Security Engineer will serve as the operational backbone and technical authority for the vulnerability lifecycle. This role focuses on maintaining operational excellence across hybrid environments, leading response operations for critical threats, and acting as the primary operational bridge to software and platform teams—defining specific automation requirements and validating automated solutions to scale scanning, triage, and reporting operations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Execution \& Vulnerability Lifecycle Management**

* Oversee and execute day\-to\-day VA/PT operational workflows across hybrid infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, and legacy data centers) to guarantee scanning coverage, accurate triage, and SLA enforcement.
* Lead operational response efforts for emergency vulnerabilities, zero\-day outbreaks, and active exploitation threats, coordinating war rooms and rapid mitigations across IT and Business units.
* Analyze complex vulnerabilities to eliminate false positives, evaluate real\-world exploitability, and establish strict prioritization using threat intelligence (CVE, CISA KEV, IOCs) and CVSS/SSVC metrics.
* Drive end\-to\-end remediation tracking with system, network, and application owners, maintaining tight oversight on vulnerability aging, SLAs, and exception/deferral workflows.
* Establish and monitor daily operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics, delivering actionable reports to operational leadership and audit teams.

**Automation Requirements \& Validation**

* Translate daily operational bottlenecks and manual testing workflows into actionable **automation requirements** for the InfoSec Engineering and DevOps teams.
* Establish test plans and rigorously **validate all incoming automation initiatives**, scripts, API integrations, and CI/CD security gates developed by engineering teams before production rollout.
* Define requirements for automated tool configuration, automated asset discovery, ticket creation workflows, and shift\-left scanning triggers to maximize operational throughput.

**People Leadership \& Operational Governance**

* Lead, direct, and mentor a high\-performing team of operational VA/PT analysts, establishing clear operational playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Manage day\-to\-day operational schedules, workload distribution, shift coverage, and ticket escalation queues.
* Oversee operational relationships with third\-party scanning vendors, external penetration testing teams.


Skills \- Experience and Requirements:
**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* **Operational \& Technical Expertise:** Deep operational mastery of vulnerability scanning engines, threat intelligence feeds, manual verification techniques, and network/application infrastructure protocols.
* **Automation Drive:** Expert ability to analyze operational workflows, author technical requirement documents (PRDs/epics) for tool integration, and perform acceptance testing on delivered automated tools.
* **Tooling Operations:** Hands\-on operational administration of enterprise tools such as Qualys, Nessus, Synk, XSIAM, Invicti/Netsparker, Twistlock/Prisma Cloud, Metasploit, Burp Suite Pro, and ticketing platforms (Jira, ServiceNow).
* **Frameworks \& Compliance:** Strong operational application of NIST SP 800\-53, OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, and regulatory requirements (PCI\-DSS, ISO).
* **Scripting Literacy:** Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to independently verify operational scripts, review automation code, and validate API behavior.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in security operations, vulnerability management, or penetration testing, including 3\+ years in an operational lead or supervisory capacity.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.

title: Application Security Engineer-2
description:
Job Description
**Security Engineer 2 — Application Security**


**Location:** Bangalore/Mumbai


**Function:** Application Security


**Reports to:** Director of Application Security


**Experience:** 3\-5 years


**About the Role**


Upstox is looking for a Security Engineer 2 to join our Application Security team. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for someone who has moved beyond executing assessments to owning the security posture of our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized services — and who can write real production\-quality code to build the internal tools that scale our security program. You'll work closely with engineering, platform, and DevOps teams to embed security into how we build and ship software, while also mentoring Security Engineer 1s and raising the technical bar across the team.


**What You'll Do**


* Own end\-to\-end security architecture reviews for new and changing systems — assessing the application layer, AWS infrastructure, and container/orchestration layer together as one system, rather than reviewing each in isolation, and driving remediation of what you find at scale rather than flagging issues one at a time.


* Embed security checks directly into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, SCA/dependency scanning, container image scanning, secrets detection, IaC scanning) so vulnerabilities are caught before merge, not after deployment.


* Own container and orchestration security — hardening Docker images, reviewing Kubernetes configurations (RBAC, network policies, pod security standards), and closing gaps in how workloads are built and run in production.


* Design, build, and maintain in\-house security tools and automation — think internal scanners, policy\-as\-code checks, dashboards that aggregate findings across systems, Just in time access tools or automation that removes manual steps from recurring assessments. This is a coding role as much as a security one.


* Perform penetration testing across web applications, mobile applications (Android/iOS), and APIs to identify vulnerabilities before they reach production.


* Conduct manual and tool\-assisted source code reviews to catch security issues early in the development cycle.


* Partner with engineering teams to embed security into the Secure SDLC, including security requirements, design reviews, and release gating.


* Drive and participate in threat modelling exercises for new features and systems.


* Configure, tune, and manage WAF rules (Cloudflare/AWS WAF) to protect production applications and APIs.


* Stay current with the evolving threat landscape, new attack techniques, and security tooling.


* Partner with the platform/DevOps team on infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) security reviews before infrastructure changes ship.


* Track and drive remediation of vulnerabilities across applications against SLA, working directly with engineering and platform teams to close gaps.


**What We're Looking For**


* 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in application, product, or cloud security.


* Strong, hands\-on AWS security knowledge — IAM design and least\-privilege policies, VPC/network security, secrets management (e.g., Secrets Manager/KMS), logging and detection (CloudTrail, Guard Duty), and common cloud misconfiguration patterns. This needs to be real operational depth, not just familiarity with the console.


* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to secure them — pipeline\-as\-code, build system trust boundaries, artifact integrity, secrets in pipelines, and where to insert automated security gates (SAST, SCA, container scanning, IaC scanning) without breaking developer velocity.


* Practical container security experience — Docker image hardening, and Kubernetes security fundamentals (RBAC, network policies, secrets handling, pod security standards).


* Strong coding fundamentals in at least one of Python, Go, or Rust, with the ability to design and ship a real tool, not just write one\-off scripts — this role builds security tooling that other engineers will depend on.


* Solid foundation in application security fundamentals: penetration testing across web/mobile/API, manual source code review, Secure SDLC and threat modeling, and authentication/authorization protocols (SAML, OAuth, OIDC).


* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code security review (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).


* Understanding of software supply chain security — dependency risk, SBOMs, and build/artifact integrity.


* Working understanding of AI/LLM security risks — prompt injection, insecure output handling, model/data poisoning, and excessive agency in AI\-integrated systems.


* Strong communication skills — this role influences engineering and platform teams directly and will mentor more junior engineers.


**Good to Have**


* Experience with policy\-as\-code tools (OPA/Rego, Kyverno, or similar) for automated compliance/security checks.


* Exposure to a service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and its security implications.


* Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSWE, OSCE, AWS Security Specialty, CKS) and bug bounty experience are a plus but not mandatory.


* Experience operating or building internal security platforms/dashboards at a previous company.


**Why Join Us**


* Own security architecture decisions for high\-scale, high\-stakes financial products used by millions of users — not just review them after the fact.


* Build real internal tools used daily by the security and engineering teams, with the autonomy to decide how they're designed.


* Work across the full stack of modern cloud\-native security — AWS, CI/CD, containers, and application code — rather than being siloed into one narrow area.


* A collaborative team that invests in your growth, including a path toward technical leadership and mentoring the next generation of AppSec engineers.

title: Lead Engineer WAN & Edge Architect
description:
**About The Role**
 The backbone of TD SYNNEX's global network is routing, switching, and increasingly SD\-WAN. Across more than 100 countries, hundreds of sites, and three distinct regional engineering teams, the decisions made at the routing and switching layer \- how traffic flows, how sites fail over, how edge connectivity is managed \- touch everything. Today, those decisions are made regionally, without a global solutions\-level owner who can set direction, resolve the hardest problems, and ensure consistency.
   

  

 This role is that owner. As our Routing, Switching \& SD\-WAN Solutions Engineer based in India, you will serve as the global technical authority for network infrastructure design across all layers: campus and data center switching, WAN and carrier connectivity, and SD\-WAN edge architecture. You will design solutions for the most complex network challenges in the environment, set global standards, and act as the senior escalation point for routing and switching issues that regional teams cannot resolve on their own.
   

  

 This is a design and architecture role. You should be equally comfortable drawing a network topology, writing a technical standard, debugging a BGP route leak, and presenting a recommendation to leadership. We are not looking for someone who runs tickets \- we are looking for someone who eliminates the class of problem that generates them.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and architect routing and switching solutions for TD SYNNEX's global network \- campus LAN, WAN, data center interconnect, and SD\-WAN edge
* Serve as the global escalation point for complex routing, switching, and SD\-WAN issues \- own the problem, lead the resolution, document the fix as a standard
* Define and maintain global network design standards: topology templates, routing policy, QoS frameworks, VLAN strategy, and SD\-WAN deployment models
* Evaluate and recommend SD\-WAN architecture direction \- provider selection, edge deployment models, application\-aware routing, and zero\-touch provisioning approaches
* Review network designs for new site build\-outs, warehouse deployments, and corporate office expansions across all regions before implementation
* Partner with the Americas Network Lead, Daniel Salamanca in Europe, and the APJ engineer to align regional implementations with global standards
* Collaborate with the India Automation \& Observability engineer to define what network telemetry and alerting looks like for routing and switching infrastructure
* Lead cross\-functional engagement on network requirements for new business initiatives \- acquisitions, new market entries, application migrations


**Qualifications**
**You Must Have:**
* 10\-15 years of enterprise network engineering experience with a strong focus on design and architecture, not just operations
* Expert\-level knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and spanning tree \- including how they interact and where they break at scale
* Hands\-on design and deployment experience with SD\-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela/SD\-WAN, VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet, or similar)
* Deep understanding of enterprise LAN/WAN architecture: campus switching, redundancy design, QoS, and carrier circuit management
* Experience working across a multi\-site, multi\-country network environment and setting standards that regional teams can execute
* Strong written and spoken English; able to document architecture decisions and present recommendations clearly to both engineers and leadership
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy as a global SME with peers across multiple time zones


**Nice To Have**
* CCIE Routing \& Switching or Enterprise Infrastructure (active or prior); CCNP Enterprise at minimum
* Experience with data center switching and fabric architectures (Cisco ACI, VXLAN/EVPN)
* Familiarity with carrier and ISP relationships \- circuit ordering, SLA management, peering
* Exposure to network design in a global IT distribution, logistics, or e\-commerce environment
* Experience with multi\-vendor environments and the ability to design vendor\-agnostic solutions


**What This Role Offers**
* The broadest technical scope on the global network team \- routing and switching touches every site, every region, and every other solution area
* A senior seat in a newly established India Solutions Hub designed to be the technical center of gravity for TD SYNNEX's global network engineering function
* Direct collaboration with the Global Director of Network Engineering and regional leads in the Americas and Europe
* The opportunity to define global network architecture standards from the ground up \- not inherit someone else's decisions
* Clear growth path: as TD SYNNEX expands and the network team matures, this role is positioned to grow into a principal or staff engineer function


**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
* 10 to 15 Years of relevant work experience.
* Bachelor's Degree with Network Engineering or Related field of study required.
* Other Education / Certifications: \- Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) Data Center, CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCIE Enterprise Wireless, CCIE Collaboration, Cisco Certified Design Expert (CCDE), F5 (or other load balancer) Certified Solution Expert, SNIA Storage Networking Certificate.

title: Lead Engineer Data Center Fabric Architect
description:
**About The Role**
 TD SYNNEX's data centers and warehouses run on fabric: spine leaf switching, VXLAN/EVPN overlays, and the segmentation that keeps thousands of connected devices isolated and secure. As the environment grows across Americas, EMEA, and APJ, fabric decisions made at one site, on one platform, by one regional team, increasingly need to line up with decisions made everywhere else. Today there is no single global owner of that consistency.
   

  

 This role is that owner. As our Data Center Fabric Solutions Engineer based in India, you will serve as the global technical authority for data center and warehouse fabric design: spine leaf architecture, VXLAN/EVPN overlays, multi\-tenant segmentation, and fabric platform selection. You will design solutions for the hardest fabric problems in the environment, set global standards, and act as the senior escalation point when a regional team cannot resolve a fabric issue on its own.
   

  

 This is a design and architecture role. You should be equally comfortable drawing a spine leaf topology, writing a segmentation standard, debugging an EVPN control plane issue at 2 a.m., and presenting a platform recommendation to leadership. We are not looking for someone who runs tickets. We are looking for someone who eliminates the class of problem that generates them.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and architect data center and warehouse fabric solutions globally: spine leaf switching, VXLAN/EVPN overlays, and multi\-tenant segmentation
* Serve as the global escalation point for complex fabric issues; own the problem, lead the resolution, and document the fix as a standard
* Define and maintain global fabric design standards: spine leaf templates, VXLAN/EVPN policy, segmentation models, and platform selection guidance
* Evaluate and recommend data center fabric platform direction across Arista, Cisco ACI, and NSX\-T, including where each fits and where it does not
* Review fabric designs for new data center builds, warehouse deployments, and site refresh projects across all regions before implementation
* Partner with the Routing, Switching \& SD\-WAN Solutions Engineer to keep fabric and edge designs aligned end to end
* Work with the EMEA, Americas and APJ regional teams to align local fabric implementations with global standards
* Define fabric telemetry, health checks, and alerting requirements and work with the NOC to operationalize them
* Lead technical engagement on fabric requirements for new business initiatives: acquisitions, new site build outs, and warehouse expansions


**Qualifications**
**You Must Have:**
* 10 to 15 years of enterprise network engineering experience with a strong focus on data center fabric design and architecture, not just operations
* Expert level knowledge of VXLAN, EVPN, and BGP as used in a data center underlay/overlay, including where they break at scale
* Hands on design and deployment experience with at least one enterprise fabric platform: Arista, Cisco ACI, NSX\-T, or comparable
* Deep understanding of spine leaf architecture, DC interconnect, and multi\-tenant or micro\-segmentation design
* Experience setting fabric standards that regional teams can execute consistently across a multi\-site, multi\-country environment
* Strong written and spoken English; able to document architecture decisions and present recommendations clearly to engineers and leadership
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy as a global SME working across multiple time zones


**Nice To Have**
* CCIE (Data Center or Enterprise Infrastructure), JNCIE\-DC, or Arista ACE Expert; active or prior, or in active pursuit
* Deep, provable expertise in large scale, multi\-site EVPN and DC interconnect at production scale
* Experience across more than one fabric platform, for example Arista and Cisco ACI, or Arista and NSX\-T, with the judgment to compare trade offs
* Network automation and scripting (Python, Ansible) for fabric provisioning, validation, and drift detection
* Familiarity with NetBox, CloudVision, or similar network source of truth and telemetry tooling
* Experience with fabric design in a distribution, warehouse, or logistics environment
* Prior experience in a large scale, multi region enterprise or service provider network


**What This Role Offers**
* Ownership of the fabric layer everywhere it exists: every data center, every warehouse, every region
* A senior seat in the India Solutions Hub, established as the technical center of gravity for TD SYNNEX's global network engineering function
* Direct collaboration with the Global Director of Network Engineering and the peer solutions engineers in the India Solutions Hub
* The opportunity to define global fabric standards from the ground up, not inherit someone else's decisions
* Clear growth path: as TD SYNNEX expands and the network team matures, this role is positioned to grow into a principal or staff engineer function


**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
* 10 to 15 Years of relevant work experience.
* Bachelor's Degree with Network Engineering or Related field of study required.
* Other Education / Certifications: \- Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) Data Center, CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCIE Enterprise Wireless, CCIE Collaboration, Cisco Certified Design Expert (CCDE), F5 (or other load balancer) Certified Solution Expert, SNIA Storage Networking Certificate.
* Able to execute instructions and to request clarification when needed.
* Able to perform basic mathematical calculations.
* Able to recognize and attend to important details with accuracy and efficiency.
* Able to communicate clearly and convey necessary information.
* Able to create and conduct formal presentations.
* Able to interact effectively with all levels of management.
* Able to negotiate skillfully, promote/sell ideas persuasively, and close transactions with mutually beneficial results.
* Possesses strong multi\-cultural interpersonal skills.
* Possesses strong leadership skills with a willingness to lead, create new ideas, and be assertive.
* Possesses strong organizational and time management skills, driving tasks to completion.
* Able to constructively work under stress and pressure when faced with high workloads and deadlines.
* Able to maintain and promote social, ethical, and organizational standards in conducting internal and external business activities.
* Able to work independently with minimum supervision.

* Able to build solid, effective working relationships with others.
* Able to exhibit ability to be sensitive to the needs, concerns, and feelings of others.
* Able to quickly learn new systems and technology.
* Able to use relevant computer system applications at an advanced level.


**Working Conditions**
* Consistent non\-standard work or overtime as business requires.

* Professional, office environment.

 This role supports a geographically distributed organization and requires the ability to manage IT teams and service providers across multiple locations and time zones.
