title: Client Implementation & Service - Team Lead
description:
Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and delivery\-focused Team Lead to manage end\-to\-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
   

  

 What you will be responsible for
   

  

* Lead assigned onboarding projects from requirement gathering through solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Manage, coach, and develop onboarding specialists; allocate work, set priorities, monitor progress, and provide timely guidance.
* Establish project plans, roles, milestones, dependencies, controls, and success criteria for each implementation.
* Lead discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to confirm reconciliation requirements, scope, assumptions, and delivery approach.
* Review and approve fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee analysis and validation of cash, position, transaction, and market\-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Direct data analysis and mapping for non\-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL, technology, and deployment teams to establish scalable processing solutions.
* Oversee account, reconciliation shell, lead\-account, match\-rule, workflow, and static\-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Plan and oversee functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go\-live readiness reviews.
* Act as the escalation point for complex reconciliation exceptions, configuration issues, delivery risks, client concerns, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and coordinate sustainable corrective and preventive actions with business, operations, and technology partners.
* Maintain oversight of project plans, open\-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, status reports, decisions, and implementation documentation.
* Provide concise reporting to management and stakeholders on delivery status, milestones, risks, controls, capacity, and critical decisions.
* Ensure procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, control evidence, and handover documentation are complete, current, and audit\-ready.
* Oversee post\-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues, risks, and actions are tracked through closure.
* Maintain a robust operational\-risk and control environment, including adherence to maker\-checker controls, information\-security standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor workload, quality, productivity, service levels, project capacity, and delivery performance; implement corrective action where required.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, strengthen controls, improve client experience, and reduce manual effort through automation and workflow improvements.
* Lead team training, cross\-skilling, succession planning, knowledge management, and continuous capability development.
* Support system enhancements, strategic initiatives, operating\-model improvements, audit activities, and management reporting as required.


 What we value
   

  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation, investment operations, and the investment\-management lifecycle.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows, and administrative functions.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT\-message validation, file analysis, ETL data mapping, and production implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end onboarding projects while managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Proven people\-leadership capability, including work allocation, coaching, performance support, knowledge development, and quality oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to lead root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.
* Effective stakeholder\-management, influencing, negotiation, and escalation skills across global teams.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with experience maintaining audit\-ready evidence and addressing operational or implementation risks.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive\-reporting skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical and operational matters into clear decisions, actions, and status updates.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on delivery quality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and working knowledge of project\-tracking, workflow, data\-visualization, and process\-documentation tools.


**Education And Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 or more years of relevant experience in middle office, reconciliation, investment operations, client onboarding, system implementation, or a related function.
* Prior experience leading a team, workstream, or complex implementation within a high\-volume, global operating environment.
* Practical expertise using TLM/TLP or another recognized reconciliation platform.
* Experience managing relationships with custodians, investment managers, fund administrators, technology teams, and global operations stakeholders.
* Experience managing implementation risks, testing governance, production readiness, stabilization, and operational handover.


**Additional Skills**
* Experience with JIRA, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, or related workflow and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Agile or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Demonstrated involvement in automation, system enhancements, process transformation, or operating\-model improvement initiatives.
* Experience preparing management information, capacity views, performance metrics, and executive\-level project updates.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 Job Overview
   

  

 Join Qualcomm’s Multimedia Systems Group as a Voice AI Systems Test Engineer, responsible for end\-to\-end validation of Voice AI features, Model evaluation, and quality KPIs sign\-off for on\-device Voice AI features for next\-generation multimedia platforms.
   

  

 In this role, you will focus on validation, benchmarking, data\-driven evaluation, competitive analysis of Always\-On AI and Agentic AI voice use cases, which includes ASR, TTS, multilingual translation, and intelligent voice assistants. Your work will ensure that Qualcomm’s Voice AI solutions meet and exceed market expectations by matching or outperforming reference implementations and competing solutions across performance, quality, latency, power, and robustness.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Voice AI Validation \& System Testing
   

  

* Perform system\-level validation and testing of Voice AI features, with emphasis on Always\-On AI and Agentic AI use cases.
* Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans for Voice AI pipelines including ASR, TTS, NLP, Translation, Summarization, and Language Models.
* Validate functional correctness, latency, power, memory, and long\-run stability of Voice AI systems on embedded hardware (NPU, GPU, CPU).
* Maintain Performance dashboard
* Detect regressions
* Identify quality gaps
* Predict performance trends across releases


**Performance, Quality \& Competitive Benchmarking**
* Compare performance and perceptual quality of Qualcomm Voice AI solutions against:
* Internal reference implementations
* Customer baselines
* Competing open\-source solutions in the market
* Conduct objective and subjective quality analysis for Voice AI features (accuracy, intelligibility, naturalness, latency perception, robustness).
* Drive validation with the goal to meet and beat market expectations, using measurable KPIs and user\-experience metrics.
* Perform competitive benchmarking of open\-source and proprietary models from a system\-level quality and performance standpoint.


 Hardware Acceleration \& System Integration Validation
   

  

* Validate HW AI acceleration paths, ensuring correct and efficient offload across NPU, GPU, CPU, and DSP.
* Evaluate end\-to\-end voice AI pipelines, which includes low power modes, and realtime inference behavior in batch mode and streaming mode.
* Verify correct interaction across application, framework, DSP, and hardware layers.


 Automation, Debug \& Cross\-Team Collaboration
   

  

* Develop and maintain automated test suites, regression frameworks, and evaluation pipelines for Voice AI and Agentic AI workflows.
* Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and dumps to perform root\-cause analysis of functional, performance, or quality issues.
* Collaborate closely with R\&D, Systems, Platform, Product, and Customer teams to drive fixes, improvements, and release readiness.
* Document test methodologies, KPIs, validation results, and competitive insights for internal and external stakeholders.


**Requirements**
* Strong programming and scripting skills in C/C\+\+ and Python, with focus on test automation, data analysis, and evaluation tooling.
* Experience in system\-level testing and validation of ML or AI workloads on embedded platforms.
* Solid understanding of Voice AI domains: ASR, TTS, NLP, multilingual translation, and voice assistants.
* Hands\-on experience validating ML inference performance and quality on NPU/GPU/CPU.
* Working knowledge of deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX from a testing and inference evaluation perspective.
* Understanding of ML architectures (Transformers, LSTM, GRU, diffusion models) for validation, benchmarking, and analysis.
* Experience validating model quantization, compression, and hardware acceleration techniques.
* Strong debugging skills for embedded systems, DSP pipelines, and AI accelerators.
* Experience with AI\-assisted test data analysis, model\-based evaluation, and KPI\-driven benchmarking is a strong plus.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work across global, cross\-disciplinary teams.


**Behavioral \& Professional Expectations**
* Strong quality and customer\-experience mindset with attention to detail.
* Self\-driven engineer capable of handling complex system\-level validation challenges.
* Ability to translate test data and metrics into actionable insights.
* Excellent verbal and written communication for clear reporting and cross\-team alignment.
* Team player who collaborates effectively with R\&D, platform, and product organizations.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, continuous learning, and innovation.
* Actively supports diversity and inclusion within the team and company.


**Educational Qualification**
* Bachelor’s / Master’s / in Engineering, Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, or related fields.
* 2\+ years of experience in Voice AI testing, Audio/AI system validation, ML inference evaluation, or related domains.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1\+ year of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
   

  

 OR
   

  

 PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.


**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Conducts log analyses to identify where an issue has occurred and makes recommendations for how to address the issue.
* Understands basic features of the system.
* Collects information (e.g., logs, requirements) and identifies basic patterns/trends related to systems testing.
* Manages individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables with minimal supervision.

* Resolves straightforward technical issues and escalates to technical leads as necessary.
* Adapts to significant changes and setbacks in order to manage pressure and meet deadlines.
* Gathers, integrates, and interprets information from a variety of sources in order to troubleshoot issues and find solutions.
* Detects bugs in the "system under test" and resolves issues using more advanced debugging approaches.

title: Operational Compliance Specialist
description:
Imaging Endpoints (IE) is an Imaging Technology and Imaging Clinical Research Organization (iCRO). We are passionately focused on our vision to
 *Connect Imaging to the CureTM* 
 . Everything we do is aligned with this singular purpose. We work every day excited to advance imaging science, technology, and services to bring curative technologies to humankind. We have supported many of the most impactful new drug approvals in oncology, and we are seeking the most talented individuals globally that are passionate in their desire to assist us in our mission to customize each clinical trial’s imaging to optimize the opportunity to demonstrate efficacy.
 



  





 Imaging Endpoints is based in Scottsdale, Arizona, with offices in Cambridge, Massachusetts; London, UK; Leiden, Netherlands; Basel, Switzerland; Hyderabad, India and Shanghai, China. We are an affiliate of HonorHealth, one of the largest healthcare systems nationally, and Scottsdale Medical Imaging Limited (SMIL/RadPartners), the largest private radiology group in the United States. We are recognized as the world’s largest and most preeminent iCRO in oncology.
 



  





 The Operational Compliance Specialist is primarily responsible for assisting Operational Compliance Management in executing day\-to\-day tasks associated with managing, maintaining, and continually improving Imaging Endpoints’ Operational Compliance processes. This individual interfaces with Compliance and Regulatory Affairs and Imaging Operations teams at all levels, with support activities provided in areas including, but not limited to, document change control, proposal, and document review, administering of training, inspection readiness assessments, and nonconformance file (CAPA and Deviation) management. The Operational Compliance Specialist is a compliance and solutions oriented individual, facilitating timely management quality decision making. This individual is key in achieving business and stakeholder needs with respect to quality assurance principles and practices.
 



  





**OPERATIONAL COMPLIANCE SPECIALIST**




  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Provide quality system management assistance within the regulations of investigational products and quality standards, specifically: 21 CFR Part 312, 21 CFR Part 211, ICH E6 and ISO standards.
* Provide direct QA support related to Imaging Endpoints’ training programs and nonconformance management (deviation program and CAPA program).
* QA responsibilities include, but are not limited to, documentation creation, editing and/or review for procedures related to operations, QMS, etc.
* Assist in document control responsibilities for study related documents.
* Assist in proposal review.
* Responsible for creating and fostering mutually beneficial intradepartmental, cross\-functional and organizational relationships to drive compliance to specified program objectives.
* Interface with Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Management to implement quality system strategies and plans, relevant to the defined role, which then facilitate continuous QMS improvement.
* Interface with other areas of the organization to provide sound QA decision\-making in operational processes.
* Assist in responding to operational issues to prevent deviation and CAPA occurrence.
* Assist in the management, maintenance, and reporting of IE’s CAPA and Deviation systems, including discrepancy investigation, reporting, and tracking and trending activities.
* Assist Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Management during Study Audits, Internal Audits, Sponsor Audits, or Regulatory Inspections, including the effective preparation of related documentation, training of staff, providing accurate information and tracking of audit responses.
* Assist Operational Compliance Management in managing Inspection Readiness Assessment and/or audit activities.
* Evaluate the state of compliance regarding study set\-up and close out activities including remediation and reconciliation of TMF documentation.
* Assist the Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Management in establishing and reporting quality metrics.
* Ensure proper control, retention, and archival of documentation.
* Assist in implementing and maintaining QA procedures and controls to ensure the IE QMS is compliant to current industry requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned by Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Management.
* Act in a supporting role to other Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Specialist positions.



  





**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**



* Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical sciences or other related scientific disciplines.
* Minimum five (5\) years of experience in a regulated industry with at least three (3\) years of experience in pharmaceuticals, clinical research, and/or medical device.
* Prior experience of development and maintenance of a QMS system and operational experience.
* Prior experience in Imaging Core Lab and/or Contract Research Organization preferred.
* Knowledge and understanding of 21CFR Part 211, 21CFR Part 312, ISO standards, and Good Clinical Practices (ICH E6 GCP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* Good working knowledge of CAPA/deviation processes, investigational methodologies and procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Office and internet applications.
* Prior experience with training, deviation and CAPA document administration.



  





**SKILLS**



* Superior attention to detail, particularly in written documentation
* Service oriented approach, flexible, and proactive
* Self\-driven, ability to get the job done with little supervision, can\-do positive attitude
* Ability to excel in a team environment
* Ability to work in strict compliance with all procedures, rules, and regulations
* Ability to manage projects and deliverables with a high level of accuracy and completeness
* Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive data, records, files, conversations, etc.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to grasp new concepts quickly
* Excellent hands\-on computer skills with thorough knowledge of Microsoft Office to include Word, Excel, and Power Point



  





**IMAGING ENDPOINTS’ TEAM CHARACTERISTICS**



* Passion to
 *Connect Imaging to the CureTM* 
 and pursue a meaningful career by improving the lives of cancer patients through imaging
* Strong desire to be part of a dynamic, global team working closely together and growing year after year in a rewarding environment to help humanity through imaging
* Commitment and caring for our fellow team members, their families, and the communities IE serves \- see Caring Endpoints https://caringendpoints.org/
* Integrity and high ethical standards; we always do the right thing
* High intellect and ingenuity; we enjoy solving problems, finding a better way, and the challenge of making a difference by improving lives
* Structured, organized, detail\-oriented, and self\-motivated; we approach each day with a detailed plan and excitement to accomplish the day’s objectives while striving to improve ourselves and IE everyday
* Accountable; we do what we say and communicative effectively to meet deadlines; we enjoy advancing clinical trials, helping patients, and celebrating success
* High standard for excellence; we proof our own work, hold high standards for ourselves and our team, and always prioritize quality above all else








**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**




 While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, ability to adjust focus.
 



 Travel: Estimated 10% travel (domestic and international)

title: Senior Analyst Revenue Mgmt CFS TT
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Techno Functional Analyst with strong hands on experience in Model N Revenue Manager and Oracle Database to support and enhance critical Revenue Management processes, including Chargebacks, Rebates, Managed Care, Government Pricing, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.
   

  

 This role requires deep technical and functional expertise, advanced SQL/PLSQL skills, and a proven ability to analyze and resolve complex data, batch processing, and integration issues within a regulated enterprise environment. The role also includes ownership of AMS coordination and close collaboration with business and delivery teams.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Partner with business users and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and non‑functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into solution designs, functional specifications, and implementation plans.
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, regulatory requirements, and platform best practices.
* Coordinate closely with onsite leads, offshore AMS teams, and external vendors to ensure timely incident resolution and service continuity.
* Provide functional and delivery oversight of the AMS L2/L3 support teams for the Model N application landscape.
* Analyze and resolve batch job failures, performance bottlenecks, and Oracle Scheduler–based processing issues.
* Perform advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL analysis for:
* Data validation and reconciliation
* Defect investigation and resolution
* Ad‑hoc and audit support analysis
* Troubleshoot and support system integrations and interfaces, including:
* PL/SQL‑based inbound and outbound feeds
* High‑volume transactional / EDI‑style data loads and extracts
* Support data fixes, backend loads, and controlled updates across lower and production environments, following established change and governance processes.
* Assist with SIT, UAT, and regression testing, including test scenario creation, execution, and defect triage.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies in reports, extracts, and downstream feeds in collaboration with business, integration, and reporting teams.
* Support platform upgrades and regulatory releases by assessing impact, validating customizations, and ensuring data integrity.
* Collaborate with functional, business, and vendor teams to produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation and define preventive actions.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 10\+ years of experience as a Technical / Techno‑Functional Analyst or Application Support Analyst in enterprise systems.
* Strong hands‑on experience with Model N Revenue Manager, including:
+ Chargebacks
+ Rebates
+ Managed Care
+ Government Pricing
+ Validata
+ MDM

* Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including complex joins, performance tuning, and large‑volume data analysis.
* Experience supporting Oracle Scheduler jobs, batch frameworks, and high‑volume data processing.
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical Revenue Management and gross‑to‑net processes.
* Hands‑on experience with system integrations and data interfaces.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a production‑support, ticket‑driven environment.


**Qualifications**
* Experience with Model N SaaS / AWS‑based deployments.
* Exposure to EDI transactions and pharmaceutical gross‑to‑net data flows.
* Familiarity with IT governance, change management, and validation methodologies (SIT/UAT).
* Experience working with cross‑functional stakeholders and external vendors.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**

title: Senior Administrator, Corporate Systems
description:
Job Description:
**Job Purpose**


The Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) Corporate Systems Senior Developer will be responsible for the end\-to\-end administration, deployment, and development of the ORMB application built on the Oracle Utilities Application Framework (OUAF). This role combines hands\-on system administration — including fresh installations, environment provisioning, patch management, and release deployments — with Java\-based development of enhancements, integrations, and batch processing solutions.

  

Working under the direction of the Technical Manager, this role requires frequent collaboration with functional business analysts, infrastructure/DBA teams, third\-party vendors, and end users to ensure high availability, compliance, and continuous delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application. The ideal candidate brings both deep administrative experience with ORMB/OUAF environments and strong Java development skills in large\-volume financial systems.  

  

**Responsibilities**

 *System Administration \& Environment Management*

* Plan, execute, and document fresh installations of ORMB/OUAF across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments on Linux/Unix servers
	+ Configure WebLogic application server, Oracle database connections, batch frameworks, and OUAF environment properties (ENVIRON.INI, SPLEBASE).
	+ Manage multi\-environment topology including environment cloning, refresh, and rollback procedures.
* Apply Oracle\-released CPU patches, SPU patches, and product fix packs to ORMB/OUAF environments following change management procedures.
	+ Coordinate patch testing in lower environments before promoting to Production; maintain patch inventory and compliance registers.
	+ Use Oracle OPatch / OUAF patch utilities (e.g., FW patch scripts) and validate post\-patch environment integrity.
* Execute and oversee application deployments and release promotions across all environments using OUAF deployment utilities.
	+ Manage Configuration Migration (CM) packages, migration plans, and controlled rollouts via the OUAF Migration Assistant.
	+ Coordinate with DBAs for schema scripts, data migrations, and post\-deployment validation.
* Monitor application health, JVM performance, batch throughput, and WebLogic thread pools; tune configurations to meet SLA targets.
* Maintain and update installation guides, runbooks, patch procedures, and environment\-specific configuration documentation.

*Development \& Enhancements*

* Design and develop custom ORMB components — algorithms, service scripts, BPA scripts, business objects, business services, and portal zones — using Java and the OUAF framework.
* Build and maintain third\-party integrations (e.g., tax engines, payment gateways, e\-invoicing, ticketing systems) using REST/SOAP APIs and batch file\-based patterns.
* Develop and optimize batch programs for high\-volume billing and financial transaction processing, including performance profiling and JVM\-level tuning.
* Collaborate with functional analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements, propose solutions, and deliver enhancements aligned with business capabilities.

*Production Support \& Operations*

* Provide Tier 2/3 production support for ORMB including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of batch failures, data anomalies, and integration errors.
* Run and schedule production batch jobs; maintain and modify interfaces, reports (BI Publisher), and scheduled tasks.
* Perform year\-end processing support, system upgrades, and general technical modifications with minimal business disruption.
* Liaise with Oracle Support (SR management), infrastructure, and DBA teams to resolve platform\-level issues.

*Collaboration \& Governance*

* Work with external vendors and internal teams to evaluate system changes; participate in design reviews, propose solutions, and document outcomes.
* Ensure all deployments and patches comply with change management, security, and audit policies.
* Support the ORMB V8 upgrade and other strategic migration initiatives, contributing to parallel\-run testing and validation activities.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science or Information Systems required.
* 5\+ years of experience with Oracle ORMB or CC\&B, including hands\-on administration of OUAF\-based environments (installations, patching, deployments).
* 5\+ years of strong Java development skills with demonstrated ability to build and extend OUAF/ORMB framework components.
* Experience installing and patching ORMB/OUAF on Linux/Unix servers; familiarity with WebLogic administration and JVM tuning.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database / SQL; ability to write and optimize queries against ORMB billing schema.
* Experience managing OUAF Configuration Migration (CM) packages and multi\-environment promotion workflows.
* Ability to work independently and thrive in a high\-profile environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical peers, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors.

**Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Familiarity with Oracle patch delivery mechanisms (My Oracle Support, OPatch) and WebLogic patching procedures.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines or scripted deployment automation for Java/OUAF applications.
* BI Publisher and/or Tableau experience is a plus.
* Financial industry experience with finance and/or accounting knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with ORMB V8 (v8\.x) and knowledge of differences from legacy CC\&B / ORMB v2\.x.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or Jira integrations in enterprise environments.
* Ability to liaise with and build effective relationships with global teams across time zones.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Interior Company, a subsidiary of Square Yards, operates across multiple locations in India and the UAE, focusing on home construction and interior design. The team is composed of skilled professionals who are passionate about construction, interior aesthetics, and functional design. The company aims to deliver a seamless and hassle\-free experience by combining client preferences with expert guidance. Interior Company is committed to creating living spaces that reflect each client’s personality and style while maintaining high standards of quality and craftsmanship.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai for Drawing Quality Check in Interior Fit\-out projects, with compensation up to 6 LPA. The role involves reviewing and verifying interior fit\-out drawings for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with design standards and client requirements. The team member will check dimensions, materials, and specifications, identify inconsistencies, and coordinate with designers and project managers to resolve discrepancies. Daily responsibilities include maintaining quality documentation, ensuring compliance with internal quality guidelines, and supporting smooth execution of projects by providing clear, timely feedback on drawings. The role also requires collaboration with cross\-functional teams to ensure that approved drawings are ready for implementation on site.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret technical drawings, identify errors, and assess design feasibility.
* Candidates should possess Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills to ensure drawings meet company standards, client specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Candidates should possess Quality Auditing skills to systematically review drawing sets, document findings, and recommend corrective actions.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with designers, project managers, and site teams, and to clearly report quality issues and solutions.
* Relevant experience in interior fit\-out, architecture, or civil/interior design projects, especially in drawing review or design coordination, is highly beneficial.
* A diploma or degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Civil Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency in design and drafting tools (such as AutoCAD or similar software) and familiarity with industry standards and building codes are advantageous.
* Attention to detail, ability to work to deadlines, and commitment to maintaining high quality standards are essential.

 The candidate will act as a strategic partner to business leadership, driving enterprise\-wide excellence by enabling:
   

  

* Scalable and resilient process ecosystems
* Data\-driven and insight\-led decision\-making
* Adoption of digital, AI, and automation\-led improvements where required
* A culture of continuous improvement, ownership, and accountability


 The role requires balancing governance with agility, ensuring that processes evolve with business growth without creating complexity or operational friction.
   

  

 The job requires the candidate to use a combination of logic, analysis, experience and wisdom to provide overall direction and effective solutions for ensuring compliance and leveraging best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The candidate would be responsible for identifying and driving improvement initiatives across the organization in line with business requirements. This would require demonstration of results in terms of cycle time reduction, reduced costs and improved quality.
   

  

 The candidate will also verify that Quantitative Goals are set for various projects and functions are met, report deviations and identify areas of improvement. At the organization level, the candidate will review \& approve the baseline reports / improvement plans and ensure effectiveness of process improvement plans.

This will also involve prioritizing process changes, planning for release and deployment and institutionalization of processes and best practices as per the organizational direction and road map.
   

  

 The job would require regular analysis of training needs on various aspects of process frameworks and other business needs and that these are planned and conducted to meet business objectives.
   

  

 Excellent communication, interpersonal and leadership skills are essential for this role as the candidate would be mentoring/training other members of the team, interacting with People Managers and People Leaders. The candidate should be proficient in generating and delivering effective training programs, client presentations and reviewing process documentation.

 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Good understanding of industry standards like ISO models (9001, 14001, 45001\) and project governance/ execution processes
* Process definition, deployment and institutionalization

* Data, analytics and decision intelligence

title: Performance Engineer -  Performance Testing, JMeter, Load Runner, API Performance & Java/JVM
description:
**Scope**
* We provide 3PL customers with the integrated supply chain solution for planning, TMS, OMS \& WMS.
* The 3PL PSR team works closely with QA, Development, DevOps, DBA, Solution Architect and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications meet performance and scalability requirements.
* The role requires both hands\-on performance engineering and architectural understanding, ensuring scalable and future\-ready implementations.
* The individual will be responsible for designing, planning, and executing performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing for enterprise applications.
* Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers.


**Technical Environment**
* Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
* API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
* Scripting \& Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application \& JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools
* Infrastructure \& Monitoring: Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, OCI/Azure, CPU/Memory/Disk/Network monitoring, Grafana, OEM
* DevOps/Agile: Git, Jenkins
* Cloud: OCI/Azure integrations
* Others: RDP/SSH, Linux command\-line utilities, log analysis, performance profiling, capacity planning, and production performance monitoring.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios.
* Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers.
* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response\-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root\-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Work closely with Developers, QA, DBAs, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning, scalability assessment, and production\-readiness reviews.
* Identify opportunities to automate performance testing, monitoring, and reporting to improve efficiency and repeatability.
* Participate in release planning and provide performance assessment and recommendations for production deployment.
* Communicate performance findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 1\-3 years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with JMeter and performance test scripting.
* Good understanding of load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.
* Strong experience in API performance testing using REST/HTTP, JSON/XML, and Postman.
* Good understanding of Java/JVM, including heap, threads, GC, and JVM tuning.
* Experience with JProfiler, Eclipse MAT, thread/heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Experience with Linux/Unix, shell scripting, and application/log analysis.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database performance, preferably Oracle, including AWR/ASH and execution plan analysis on OEM.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, InfluxDB, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Understanding of Kubernetes/containerized environments and exposure to OCI/Azure is preferred.
* Strong performance troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple performance testing activities within timelines.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) who views testing as an engineering problem waiting to be solved. In this role, you won't just be executing
   

  

 tests; you will design, build, and maintain the automated testing frameworks, infrastructure, and tooling that allow our engineering teams to ship high\-quality code at speed. **What You’ll Do**
* A minimum of 8 years of work experience is required.

* Code Quality \& Testing: Write clean, high\-quality automation code (e.g., using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript) and participate in developer code reviews.

* CI/CD \& DevOps : Hands\-on experience with Docker, gitversion control, and pipeline tools like GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* Database \& API : Proficiency in querying SQL/NoSQL databases and testing RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
* Mindset : Strong debugging skills, a knack for breaking things, and a "shift\-left" testing philosophy.


**Bonus Skills**
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Performance and load testing experience using tools like JMeter or K6\.
* Background in Unit Testing frameworks (TestNG, JUnit, PyTest) and working alongside developers to improve unit test coverage.

title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Uplevyl** 




 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women.
 



 Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women).
 



 We work with mission\-driven partners to turn complex, high\-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact.
 



 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent.
 



 AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train.
 



 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper.
 



 That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 A Forward\-Deployed Engineer (FDE) is an engineer who works where the product meets the client.
 



 You are the partner's point of contact and the person who makes our AI work in their world.
 



 At Uplevyl, our partners are mission\-driven organizations deploying UpGenie into domains where accuracy carries real consequences. Someone acting on one of our answers may be making a decision about their safety, their job, or their rights.
 



 The FDE owns that last mile: you sit in partner calls, understand what they actually need, configure and validate the system for their domain, and carry their feedback back into the product as clear engineering priorities.
 



 This role is equal parts technical depth and client trust. You will read the system well enough to debug it, and read the room well enough to run it.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Partner Relationship, End to End** 



* Be the named point of contact for a partner deployment.
* Run the delivery loop: UAT cycles, release notes, working sessions, and honest conversations when something needs more time.



**Deployment \& Configuration** 



* Stand up UpGenie for a partner's domain: their data, jurisdictions, and workflows.
* Own the gap between a working product and a working deployment.



**Answer Quality the Partner Can Trust** 



* Design and run testing that proves the system is right.
* Build structured test frameworks, error categorization, root\-cause analysis, and validation loops over underlying sources.
* When quality slips, identify why and drive the fix.



**Translation in Both Directions** 



* Turn a partner's ask into a specification and estimate that engineering can build against.
* Turn technical decisions into language a partner understands and agrees with.



**Delivery Workflows, Automated by You** 



* Build AI tooling that removes manual work from delivery.
* Create validation pipelines, testing harnesses, and reporting systems.
* Build these yourself rather than waiting on the core team.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We hire across levels. A track record of building, shipping, and holding client trust matters more than years of experience, though real client\-facing engineering experience helps.
 


* **High Agency** 
 – You unblock yourself. When a deployment stalls or a partner escalates, you work out the next move and make it.
* **Technical Range** 
 – You can read a production AI system end to end: query the data, trace a wrong answer to its cause, script your own tooling, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You use AI daily to build.
* **Client Presence** 
 – You are calm and credible in the room, including when something has gone wrong. Partners trust you because you are straight with them and you deliver.
* **Rigor Under Pressure** 
 – You test before you claim. In our domains, a wrong answer reaching a user is a serious failure, and you treat it that way.
* **Sharp Writing** 
 – Your release notes, status updates, and client emails are clear, honest, and tight.
* **A Builder Who Ships** 
 – You have things live that prove it: tools, integrations, internal systems. You follow the frontier and form your own view on what is useful versus hype.
* **Judgment** 
 – You know what to surface to a partner, what to resolve quietly, and when to pull in leadership.



  





**Even Better If** 



* You have worked as a Solutions Engineer, Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or Technical Consultant.
* You have deployed or operated LLM or RAG systems in production.
* You have worked with legal, regulated, or otherwise high\-stakes data.
* You have worked in mission\-driven, social\-impact, women\-focused, or nonprofit ecosystems.
* You have founder, startup operator, or early\-employee experience.



  





**Before You Apply** 




 We want to be direct about what this is.
 



 This is a high\-bar role on a small, senior team. The work is demanding, the expectations are real, and the rewards—in compensation, in ownership, and in what you will learn—match them.
 



 If you want a defined lane and a slow ramp, this is not the right fit, and that is fine.
 



 If you want to be the person a partner calls first, and the engineer who makes an AI system trustworthy where it matters most, we want to hear from you.
 



 Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation.

* **We Finish What We Start** 
 – We follow through on what we say we'll do, and we care about the difference our work makes.
* **We Listen Before We Decide** 
 – Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way—by consistently showing up for people.

 – We don't wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality.
* **We Are Better Together Than Alone** 
 – We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed. Leadership here is measured by the impact you create.
* **We Stay Curious \& Keep Learning** 
 – We keep learning, including how to use AI well. We hold ourselves to the bar we're building toward: questioning our own assumptions and using AI to think better and move faster.

title: Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialist - Video RL
description:
**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for Spatial Reasoning Evaluation Specialists to support a Video Reinforcement Learning (Video RL) program focused on AI\-generated videos, autonomous agents, physical\-AI simulations, and spatial reasoning. The role involves reviewing AI\-generated video outputs and evaluating whether the AI is performing actions correctly, logically, and realistically.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Review AI\-generated videos frame\-by\-frame and evaluate the correctness of actions and movements.
* Check temporal sequence, action order, and cause\-effect relationships in videos.
* Evaluate whether AI\-generated actions are aligned with the intended goal or task.
* Identify spatial, physical, visual, and motion\-related errors in AI outputs.
* Review video segmentation, bounding boxes, masks, object boundaries, and avatar/character movements.
* Identify issues such as visual hallucinations, unnatural physics, clipping, incorrect movements, and inconsistencies.
* Provide clear, structured and evidence\-based feedback explaining why an AI output is correct or incorrect.
* Support the creation and validation of ground\-truth datasets and edge\-case scenarios.



  





**Mandatory Requirements:** 




 Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in STEM \- Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Data Science or related field.
 



  





**Relevant exposure to at least one of the following:** 



* Video Analysis
* Computer Vision
* AI/ML
* Reinforcement Learning
* Robotics / Simulation
* Video/Data Annotation
* AI Model Evaluation
* Strong spatial and temporal reasoning skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when analyzing visual content frame\-by frame.
* Ability to identify logical, physical and visual inconsistencies in videos.

 The team is looking for Associate\-level investment data specialists to support the delivery and expansion of Aladdin’s data capabilities across a growing client base. **Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client investment, technology, and data teams to support data mapping, normalization, and implementation activities.
* Learn and apply Aladdin data conventions and target\-state data management workflows, assist with client walkthroughs as needed.
* Use standard interfaces and configurable tools to onboard client data from clients and/or third\-party data providers.
* Assist with configuring analytics jobs and deliverables by supporting the setup, validation, and troubleshooting of analytics workflows to ensure accurate and timely outputs in collaboration with senior specialists.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks; help investigate data issues and support resolution with internal teams, vendors, or clients.
* Support business and technical analysis by documenting client requirements and translating them into clear inputs for data stewards, production solutions, and engineering teams.
* Participate in client UAT activities by executing test cases, validating results, and documenting findings.
* Prepare and maintain client\-facing documentation using standard templates and support the transition of new clients into production support in partnership with Data Operations.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization efforts, and internal initiatives aimed at improving data onboarding efficiency and quality.


**Qualifications And Skillsets**
 We are looking for quick learners, independent thinkers with new perspectives to challenge the way we operate and help prototype new solutions we can ultimately deploy to a standard implementation playbook. Individuals with strong technical and analytical interests and skills would find the data implementation practice best in supporting their continuous developments through the ownership of critical client project elements as well as organizational initiatives to constantly evolve the platform and best\-practice, leveraging data and technology.
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree is required, with preference to business, technology, or engineering focus.
* 4\+ years of experience either as an investment/data technology implementation specialist or with direct relevant user, development, service, or operation experiences.
* Familiarity with investment data and analytics is required; Private markets or derivative knowledge is a plus.
* Strong attention to details and focus on high quality delivery.
* Comfortable working with clients and partners at all levels of the business.
* Relentless desire for understanding how processes work and entrepreneurial drive to learn new skills and technologies.
* Strong track record of successfully handling and completing large and complex projects. Critical thinking and demonstratable experience using technology to solve problems at scale.
* Shown ability to work well independently or as part of a team in an innovative, ambitious, and fast\-paced environment, run multiple tasks, adapt to change, and work well under tight time restraints.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, collaboration, and relationship\-building skills
* Working experience with SQL preferred. Knowledge of UNIX/Linux, Python or Java is a plus.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).

title: Historian & IT-OT Functional Manager (Manufacturing Function – IT)
description:
We are looking for a Historian \& IT\-OT Functional Manager who will serve as the
 **voice of manufacturing within the IT organization** 
 . The role is the bridge between plant operations and technology.
 



  





**Job Description:** 




**Role: Historian \& IT\-OT Functional Manager (Manufacturing Function – IT)** 




**Designation: Manager** 




**Experience:** 
 12–18 years total, with at least 6 years in pharmaceutical manufacturing operations or manufacturing IT/OT, and at least 4 years in a functional lead or manager role
 



**Education:** 
 B. Pharm, M. Pharm/ B. E, M.E / B. Tech, M.Tech \- Chemical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines.
 



**Location** 
 : Ahmedabad (The position follows plant operating schedules and a 6\-day working week.)
 



  





**Role Summary:** 
 The ideal candidate has
 **worked in or closely with pharma manufacturing** 
 , understands unit operations, batch lifecycle, equipment, and shop\-floor workflows, and also understands how historians, automation, MES, LIMS, and ERP integrate. The individual will own the functional side of historian and IT\-OT solutions from requirement to go\-live and beyond, working with architects, developers, system integrators, and site teams. Also, will understand how the plant runs, translate manufacturing and quality needs into clear IT and OT requirements, and lead implementation through to adoption and measurable business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Manufacturing Business Partnering** 



* Act as the primary IT point of contact for Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams at plant and corporate levels.
* Understand plant priorities such as throughput, yield, right\-first\-time, batch cycle time, deviation reduction, compliance, and cost, and align IT\-OT initiatives to them.
* Spend regular time on the shop floor to observe processes, identify pain points, and uncover digital opportunities.
* Build trusted relationships with plant heads, production managers, QA heads, and engineering leads.
* Maintain a prioritized demand backlog and business\-aligned roadmap for historian and IT\-OT solutions.



**2\. Business\-to\-IT Requirement Translation** 



* Lead requirement workshops with manufacturing and quality stakeholders to capture business needs, current\-state (as\-is) processes, and desired future state (to\-be).
* Map manufacturing processes end to end, for example process order release, material dispensing, batch execution, in\-process checks, equipment cleaning and status, batch record review, and batch release.
* Translate business needs into structured deliverables:
 **business requirements, User Requirement Specifications (URS), functional specifications (FS), use cases, user stories, process flows, data mapping, and acceptance criteria** 
 .
* Conduct fit\-gap analysis against standard product capabilities and recommend configuration over customization wherever possible.
* Define which process parameters, alarms, events, and batch context need to be captured, contextualized, and reported, and why they matter to the business.
* Clearly explain technical constraints, options, and trade\-offs back to business users in plain language.



**3\. Historian Functional Ownership** 



* Own the functional design of the process historian (e.g., AVEVA PI System, AspenTech IP.21, Honeywell PHD, Proficy) across sites.
* Define with process and engineering teams which tags, critical process parameters (CPPs), critical quality attributes (CQAs), and utilities data must be collected.
* Drive the design of asset hierarchies, templates, batch and event frames, and calculations based on actual equipment and process structure (ISA\-88 / ISA\-95\).
* Specify dashboards, trends, reports, and alerts for production, QA, engineering, and management users.
* Enable business use cases such as:
* Batch trending and golden batch comparison
* Continued Process Verification (CPV) and Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) data support
* Deviation and investigation support with process data
* OEE, downtime, and equipment performance
* Environmental monitoring (HVAC, cleanrooms, differential pressure, temperature, humidity)
* Utilities and energy monitoring (WFI, purified water, steam, compressed air, HVAC)
* Cold chain and storage condition monitoring



**4\. IT\-OT Integration Functional Leadership** 



* Define functional requirements for integration between shop\-floor systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA, BMS, EMS, standalone equipment) and enterprise systems (MES, LIMS, ERP/SAP, QMS, CMMS, WMS).
* Specify business data flows, for example process order download from SAP to MES, material consumption and goods movement back to ERP, equipment status to MES, process data to eBR, and results from LIMS to batch release.
* Work with the IT\-OT Integration Architect and Historian Architect to confirm that technical designs meet business needs.
* Ensure consistent master data and naming across equipment, materials, recipes, and sites.
* Support Pharma 4\.0 initiatives including analytics, AI/ML use cases, digital twins, and predictive maintenance by clearly defining business context and data needs.



**5\. Implementation and Delivery Ownership** 



* Lead the functional workstream of historian and IT\-OT projects from initiation through design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Plan functional activities, milestones, resources, and dependencies in coordination with project managers, architects, and system integrators.
* Guide developers and integrators on business logic, configuration, and process understanding.
* Lead
 **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** 
 : prepare test scenarios with business users, coordinate execution, and track defects to closure.
* Prepare cutover and go\-live plans with site teams, carefully planning around production schedules, campaigns, and shutdowns.
* Provide hypercare support after go\-live and ensure smooth handover to support teams.
* Manage scope changes through a structured change request process.



**6\. GxP Compliance, Validation and Data Integrity** 



* Ensure all solutions meet
 **21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, and ALCOA\+** 
 requirements.
* Author or own functional validation documents: URS, FS, functional risk assessments, requirements traceability matrix, UAT/PQ protocols, and validation summary inputs.
* Work closely with QA and CSV teams on validation strategy, including CSA risk\-based approaches.
* Ensure changes follow site change control, impact assessment, and periodic review processes.
* Represent historian and IT\-OT systems during regulatory inspections and audits (USFDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO\-GMP, and local authorities), explaining business use and data flows.



**7\. Change Management, Training and Adoption** 



* Drive user adoption through training programs, SOP updates, work instructions, and user guides.
* Identify and develop super\-users and site champions.
* Collect user feedback after go\-live and drive continuous improvements.
* Track and report business benefits and value realization, such as reduced investigation time, improved OEE, and reduced manual data collection.



**8\. Operations and Continuous Improvement** 



* Act as the functional escalation point for historian and IT\-OT application issues.
* Work with support teams on incident, problem, and change management, and help define business\-aligned SLAs.
* Periodically review system usage and data quality with site teams.
* Standardize solutions and templates across sites to support faster, consistent rollouts.



**9\. Team and Vendor Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor functional analysts and business analysts within the manufacturing IT team.
* Manage system integrators and vendors on functional scope, quality, and timelines.
* Coordinate with global and site IT, OT, automation, cybersecurity, and quality teams.



  





**Required Manufacturing Knowledge** 




 The candidate must have solid, practical understanding of:
 


* **Pharma manufacturing types:** 
 API (chemical synthesis), oral solid dosage (OSD), sterile/injectables, and/or biologics.
* **Unit operations and equipment** 
 , for example dispensing, granulation (RMG, FBD), blending, compression, coating, capsule filling, packaging, reactors, centrifuges, dryers, distillation, filtration, fermentation, chromatography, lyophilization, and aseptic filling, depending on site type.
* **Batch lifecycle:** 
 process order, recipe, BMR/BPR and eBR, in\-process controls, equipment cleaning and status logs, yield reconciliation, batch record review, and batch release.
