title: Senior SDET
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats and reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI\-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud\-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats.
   

  

 Recognized as a five\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award\-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of “hot” data for rapid search and investigation, threat content\-as\-a\-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud\-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.
   

  

 Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and to be featured in CRN’s 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100\. Our network of 150\+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.
   

  

 At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes.
* Customer\-Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers.
* Agility in Action: We embrace change and remain unified in our purpose and objectives.


 We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP), and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end\-to\-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in Python, hands\-on experience with Pytest and Playwright, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Python and Pytest.
* Build and maintain modern UI and end\-to\-end automation using Playwright.
* Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Drive an API\-first automation strategy for microservices and platform capabilities.
* Validate REST APIs, service\-to\-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed workflows.
* Validate data\-processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API\-based validation.
* Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test\-data management, and reporting capabilities.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing.
* Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product quality.
* Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes.
* Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices.
* Explore AI\-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.


**Required Technical Skills**
* 5–8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles.
* Strong programming experience in Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Pytest, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright for UI and end\-to\-end automation.
* Strong experience in REST API automation and testing.
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks—not only individual test scripts.
* Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.
* Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.
* Experience testing complex integration and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect\-management tools such as JIRA.
* Strong understanding of software\-testing principles, test\-design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile development practices.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of quality for a feature or product area.
* Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies.
* Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams.
* Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering.


 Why Join Securonix?
   

  

 Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large\-scale data platforms while building quality\-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. title: Performance Engineer -  Performance Testing, JMeter, Load Runner, API Performance & Java/JVM
description:
**Scope**
* We provide 3PL customers with the integrated supply chain solution for planning, TMS, OMS \& WMS.
* The 3PL PSR team works closely with QA, Development, DevOps, DBA, Solution Architect and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications meet performance and scalability requirements.
* The role requires both hands\-on performance engineering and architectural understanding, ensuring scalable and future\-ready implementations.
* The individual will be responsible for designing, planning, and executing performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing for enterprise applications.
* Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers.


**Technical Environment**
* Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
* API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
* Scripting \& Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application \& JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools
* Infrastructure \& Monitoring: Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, OCI/Azure, CPU/Memory/Disk/Network monitoring, Grafana, OEM
* DevOps/Agile: Git, Jenkins
* Cloud: OCI/Azure integrations
* Others: RDP/SSH, Linux command\-line utilities, log analysis, performance profiling, capacity planning, and production performance monitoring.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios.
* Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers.
* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response\-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root\-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Work closely with Developers, QA, DBAs, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.

title: Research Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Engineer, AI** 
 to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.
   

  

 You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.
   

  

**The Job**
* Build AI systems that do real work by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* Push the frontier of document intelligence by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* Define how we measure AI quality by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* Run experiments that change decisions by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* Own systems end to end by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.
* Have hands\-on experience with LLMs in practice, including prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, tool use and evals, and understand where each approach works and where it breaks.
* Bring a research mindset with a bias to ship: you form hypotheses, run clean experiments, read papers when they help, and turn results into systems people use.
* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here's What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.
   

  

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

description:
**Opportunity:**

title: Sr. Technical Lead - Game Testing
description:
At Aristocrat, we build the world’s greatest gaming experience every day! As a world leader in gaming entertainment, our mission is to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and technology. Joining our team means becoming part of a diverse, passionate group of experts dedicated to delivering outstanding gaming experiences. Our culture emphasizes quality, individual ownership, and collaboration, making it an exciting place to grow your career.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop, maintain, and complete comprehensive manual test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on functional specifications and user stories for slot games.
* Conduct detailed manual testing of slot games, including gameplay mechanics, bonus features, animations, and audio\-visual elements.
* Diagnose and resolve code errors to determine the underlying causes of problems, offering thorough details to the development team.
* Modify game code to trigger features required by testing objectives to achieve desired test coverage.
* Ensure games meet industry standards and regulatory requirements, including RNG testing and certification processes.
* Generate game builds on production media with platform and core code for debug and production environments, and configure the EGMs without supervision.
* Identify, document, and track defects using bug tracking systems such as Jira.
* Collaborate closely with the Game Development team, including Game Designers, Artists, and Software Development Engineers, to resolve issues found during execution of SIT test cycles.
* Follow guidelines set by SIT management to plan and complete tests that support business objectives.
* Suggest improvements to the overall testing process in terms of tools, processes, and test cases.
* Mentor new or junior\-level test engineers on the processes, game setup, and understanding of overall testing objectives set for the SIT team.


**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or its equivalent.
* A minimum of 8\+ years of experience in software test engineering, with a focus on Casino/Slot games or related industries.
* Knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance standards in various jurisdictions.
* Understanding of slot game mechanics, RNG, and dynamic/bonus systems.
* Demonstrated experience in planning and accomplishing testing activities for gaming products.
* Basic understanding of automation tools or scripting languages is a plus.
* Familiarity with UNIX/Linux.
* Experience with C/C\+\+ programming desired.
* Analytical approach with the ability to identify root causes and propose solutions.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.


 This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI\-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.
   

  

**Compensation Philosophy**
 We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay\-for\-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
   

  

 Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
   

  

 Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Uplevyl** 




 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women.
 



 Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women).
 



 We work with mission\-driven partners to turn complex, high\-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact.
 



 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent.
 



 AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train.
 



 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper.
 



 That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 A Forward\-Deployed Engineer (FDE) is an engineer who works where the product meets the client.
 



 You are the partner's point of contact and the person who makes our AI work in their world.
 



 At Uplevyl, our partners are mission\-driven organizations deploying UpGenie into domains where accuracy carries real consequences. Someone acting on one of our answers may be making a decision about their safety, their job, or their rights.
 



 The FDE owns that last mile: you sit in partner calls, understand what they actually need, configure and validate the system for their domain, and carry their feedback back into the product as clear engineering priorities.
 



 This role is equal parts technical depth and client trust. You will read the system well enough to debug it, and read the room well enough to run it.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Partner Relationship, End to End** 



* Be the named point of contact for a partner deployment.
* Run the delivery loop: UAT cycles, release notes, working sessions, and honest conversations when something needs more time.



**Deployment \& Configuration** 



* Stand up UpGenie for a partner's domain: their data, jurisdictions, and workflows.
* Own the gap between a working product and a working deployment.



**Answer Quality the Partner Can Trust** 



* Design and run testing that proves the system is right.
* Build structured test frameworks, error categorization, root\-cause analysis, and validation loops over underlying sources.
* When quality slips, identify why and drive the fix.



**Translation in Both Directions** 



* Turn a partner's ask into a specification and estimate that engineering can build against.
* Turn technical decisions into language a partner understands and agrees with.



**Delivery Workflows, Automated by You** 



* Build AI tooling that removes manual work from delivery.
* Create validation pipelines, testing harnesses, and reporting systems.
* Build these yourself rather than waiting on the core team.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 We hire across levels. A track record of building, shipping, and holding client trust matters more than years of experience, though real client\-facing engineering experience helps.
 


* **High Agency** 
 – You unblock yourself. When a deployment stalls or a partner escalates, you work out the next move and make it.
* **Technical Range** 
 – You can read a production AI system end to end: query the data, trace a wrong answer to its cause, script your own tooling, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You use AI daily to build.
* **Client Presence** 
 – You are calm and credible in the room, including when something has gone wrong. Partners trust you because you are straight with them and you deliver.
* **Rigor Under Pressure** 
 – You test before you claim. In our domains, a wrong answer reaching a user is a serious failure, and you treat it that way.
* **Sharp Writing** 
 – Your release notes, status updates, and client emails are clear, honest, and tight.
* **A Builder Who Ships** 
 – You have things live that prove it: tools, integrations, internal systems. You follow the frontier and form your own view on what is useful versus hype.
* **Judgment** 
 – You know what to surface to a partner, what to resolve quietly, and when to pull in leadership.



  





**Even Better If** 



* You have worked as a Solutions Engineer, Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or Technical Consultant.
* You have deployed or operated LLM or RAG systems in production.
* You have worked with legal, regulated, or otherwise high\-stakes data.
* You have worked in mission\-driven, social\-impact, women\-focused, or nonprofit ecosystems.
* You have founder, startup operator, or early\-employee experience.



  





**Before You Apply** 




 We want to be direct about what this is.
 



 This is a high\-bar role on a small, senior team. The work is demanding, the expectations are real, and the rewards—in compensation, in ownership, and in what you will learn—match them.
 



 If you want a defined lane and a slow ramp, this is not the right fit, and that is fine.
 



 If you want to be the person a partner calls first, and the engineer who makes an AI system trustworthy where it matters most, we want to hear from you.
 



 Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation.
 



  





**How We Work at Uplevyl** 



* **We Finish What We Start** 
 – We follow through on what we say we'll do, and we care about the difference our work makes.
* **We Listen Before We Decide** 
 – Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way—by consistently showing up for people.
* **We Move With Ownership \& Urgency** 
 – We don't wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality.

**Job Description**
* Execute CSV activities for SAP implementation, enhancement, upgrade, integration, and support projects.
* Participate in validation planning and determine validation requirements based on system criticality, intended use, GxP impact, and risk.
* Support preparation, review, and approval of validation deliverables such as:
+ Validation Plan / Master Validation Plan inputs.
+ GxP and system impact assessments.
+ Computerized System Risk Assessments.
+ User Requirements Specifications (URS).
+ Functional and Design Specifications, where applicable.
+ Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
+ Test plans, test scripts, test protocols, and test evidence.
+ Installation, Operational, and Performance Qualification documentation, where applicable.
+ Validation Summary Reports.
+ Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions.

* Review SAP business and functional requirements to ensure applicable GxP, quality, regulatory, and data integrity requirements are adequately addressed.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, traceable, and appropriately linked to business and regulatory risks.
* Support risk\-based validation and testing strategies to avoid unnecessary testing while ensuring adequate control of GxP\-critical functionality.
* Review SAP configuration, custom developments, workflows, reports, forms, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and integrations from a CSV/GxP perspective.
* Participate in SAP testing activities including:
+ Functional testing.
+ System Integration Testing (SIT).
+ User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
+ Regression testing.
+ GxP/validation testing.

* Review executed test evidence for completeness, accuracy, traceability, objective evidence, and compliance with validation procedures.
* Ensure test deviations, incidents, and defects are documented, investigated, resolved, and appropriately assessed for GxP impact.
* Support validation of SAP interfaces with external or third\-party applications and ensure appropriate controls for data transfer, reconciliation, error handling, and audit trail.
* Assess and document data integrity controls including ALCOA\+ principles, audit trails, electronic records, electronic signatures, access controls, and record retention.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:
   

  

 –Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
   

  

 –Optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to support hyper\-scale systems.
   

  

 –Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
   

  

 –Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
   

  

 –Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
   

  

 –Design performance and load testing.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design:
   

  

 –Build and design fault\-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
   

  

 –Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
   

  

 –Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting.
   

  

 –Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance:
   

  

 –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
   

  

 –Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability:
   

  

 –Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
   

  

 –Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness.
   

  

 –Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
   

  

 Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management:
   

  

 –Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
   

  

 –Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
   

  

 –Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
   

  

 –Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
   

  

 –Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
   

  

 Compliance \& Security:
   

  

 –Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
   

  

 –Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
   

  

 –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
   

  

 Automation \& Change Management:
   

  

 –Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 –Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Planning \& Execution:
   

  

 –Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately\-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
   

  

 Collaboration \& Partnership:
   

  

 –Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
   

  

 Problem Solving:
   

  

 –Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
   

  

 Continuous Learning:
   

  

 –Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
   

  

 Continuous Improvement:
   

  

 –Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
   

  

 Performance and Development:
   

  

 –Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute.  We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. **Description**
 The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self\-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.
   

  

 As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross\-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high\-quality, simple products, features, and applications. You will identify opportunities to make FC operations more efficient, and drive the design and development of software features to address them — leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization.

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.

* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond, including defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on performance metrics and customer feedback.

* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, improve decision\-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.

 AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware — these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non\-sort buildings, traditional sort and non\-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a
 **Product Manager\-Platform** 
 to be part of making this/that happen.
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 You'll join a team shaping the frontier of how AI and automated systems reach Arctic Wolf's platform. This posting covers two related focus areas: permissioning and access\-control systems (how system roles and access models work across single\-tenant and multi\-tenant/MSP customers), and developer platform and MCP (the public developer experience for discovering and adopting access to the platform). Through the interview process, we'll work with you to identify which focus area best fits your background and interests, so you don't need to know which one you are before applying.
   

  

 Both areas are technical and platform\-facing, and both will involve partnering closely with engineering on system design, including reviewing high\-level design documents (HLDs) and building prototypes or proofs of concept to validate direction before committing to full engineering investment. Depending on focus area, your work may be primarily internal\-facing (systems used by internal teams and technical partners) or may extend to a public\-facing surface, where developers and technical evaluators can explore and adopt platform capabilities before they're a customer at all.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and prioritize product requirements for new programmatic and AI\-driven access capabilities (API, protocol\-based, or natural\-language interfaces), or for the systems and roles that govern access to them.
* Partner with engineering on technical design and tradeoffs, including reviewing HLDs and providing product input on technical approach.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering and business stakeholders to ensure new capabilities are properly scoped, tested, and governed before release.
* Represent the needs of the people and systems that depend on your area, whether internal technical partners, external developers, or both.
* Track adoption, usage, and technical health metrics to guide roadmap decisions.


**Experience \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally with technical, platform, or developer\-facing products.
* Experience in one or more of the following: role\-based access control (RBAC), identity, or permissioning systems across single\- or multi\-tenant models; or API/protocol design, developer platforms, and public/self\-serve product experiences.
* Comfortable partnering directly with engineers on technical specifications and tradeoffs, including reviewing and giving product input on technical design documents.
* Experience building prototypes or PoCs to validate product direction ahead of full engineering investment.
* Strong communicator able to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Thrives operating in an evolving architecture with real ambiguity, and is comfortable with scope shifting as the space matures.


**Why This Role**
 This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. You'll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. You'll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI\-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart.
   

  

**What You Get**
 Arctic Wolf is recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100, Fortune Cyber 60, and named a Top Workplace across multiple regions, backed by a platform trusted by 7,000\+ customers worldwide. In Bangalore, that comes with flexible annual leave and paid volunteer days, training and career development programs, comprehensive private medical coverage for you and your family, life insurance at 3x compensation, personal accident insurance, and fertility support and paid parental leave.
   

  

**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
   

  

 We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
   

  

 We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
   

  

 All
 **India** 
 wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
   

  

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave
* Employee Assistance Program


 Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.
   

  

**Security Requirements**
* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

title: Sr Product Manager  - Media Measurements
description:
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end\-to\-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day\-to\-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well\-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
 We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement \& Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
   

  

**Measurement – Must Have**
 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
   

  

 The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
   

  

 A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
   

  

 Analytics \& Data Fluency — Must Have
   

  

 Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
   

  

* Customer\-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers


 Building data products with Data Engineering
   

  

 You work hand\-in\-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade\-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
   

  

 Platform \& ecosystem stewardship
   

  

 Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
   

  

 Trust, governance \& data quality — critical
   

  

 Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* 10\+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands\-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross\-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

title: Principal Product Management
description:
**Overview**
 The Windows Enterprise and Security (ENS) team is building a new product and engineering presence in Microsoft's India Development Center (IDC) to deliver the foundational Windows capabilities that enterprises depend on every day.
   

  

 TPM(Trusted Platform Module) is how millions of Windows users securely store biometric data (like fingerprints or facial recognition) and PINs, providing a secure and convenient way to sign into Windows without having to use a password. TPM technology helps organizations establish a tamper resistant, hardware root of trust that’s at the hear of computing confidential data as well as establishing consistent security access and control.
   

  

 As the
 **Principal Product Manager** 
 for TPM/Attestation, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Windows TPM stack in partnership with internal and external partners such as hardware, OEM vendors, Microsoft cloud services like Intune, Azure Attestation and Azure Entra. You will engage directly with enterprise IT admins and IT leadership, and translate customer needs into roadmap and feature decisions spanning the Windows client, services, and cloud control plane.
   

  

 This is an individual\-contributor role based in Bangalore alongside the broader ENS IDC team.
   

  

 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the product roadmap and execution for the Windows TPM platform and Azure attestation stack, including the enrollment, credential storage, firmware upgrades, TPM deployment scenarios as Pluton as well as discrete chips.
* Driving relationships, alignment and delivery across internal partners as well as external Hardware/OEM partners.
* Partner with Software Engineering across client, service, and cloud control plane teams to design and ship end\-to\-end enterprise scenarios (onboarding to policy to compliance to remediation).
* Engage directly with enterprise IT admins, IT leadership, and field teams; communicate the Windows manageability value proposition (security, compliance, cost reduction, modern management) and run customer feedback loops into product requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement of platform fundamentals \-\- security, performance, automation, quality, and validation \-\- including investments that improve Intune service scalability.
* Define success criteria, ship plans, and data\-informed metrics (policy success rates, deployment friction, usage) for cross\-functional projects and ensure alignment across organizations.
* Partner with support, field, and engineering teams on customer issues and feedback, and represent Windows manageability in cross\-team and partner forums.


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree AND 8\+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
+ OR equivalent experience.


**Other Requirements:** 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
   

  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree AND 10\+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development.
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 5\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.
* Experience defining and shipping enterprise software, manageability, device management, or platform capabilities.
* 6\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional and/or cross\-team projects.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows TPM, Attestation, MDM, Group Policy, provisioning, update/compliance flows, Autopilot, or Intune (or an equivalent MDM platform).
* Experience driving enterprise customer feedback loops into product requirements and translating customer pain points into shipped product changes.
* 5\+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).


 Deep Technical Foundation
   

  

* Solid grounding in Windows OS architecture \+ security model.
* Expertise or exposure to hardware/firmware trust stack:
+ TPM, secure boot, attestation, measured boot.
+ Device identity, key protection, root of trust.

* Ability to reason across HW ↔ FW ↔ OS boundaries.


 Ecosystem \& Partner Engagement
   

  

* Experience working with OEMs, ODMs, silicon vendors.
* Comfortable driving alignment with:

title: Product Lead
description:
**About Digantara:** 




  





 Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on ensuring orbital safety and sustainability. With expertise in space\-based detection, tracking, identification, and monitoring, Digantara provides comprehensive domain awareness across various regimes, allowing end\-users to gain actionable intelligence on a single platform. At the core of its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned with the key principles of situational awareness: perception (data collection), comprehension (data processing), and prediction (analytics). This holistic approach empowers Digantara to monitor all Resident Space Objects (RSOs) in orbit, fostering comprehensive domain awareness.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for a Product Lead to own Digantara's SDA and conjunction\-analysis product line — from problem definition through global rollout. You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with algorithms, data science and engineering teams to turn hard orbital and sensor\-fusion problems into product decisions that customers will pay for and rely on.
 



  





 You do not need to understand the underlying physics or astrodynamics. You do need to get to first principles fast, translate customer and business context into ruthless, defensible prioritisation, and own outcomes with real independence. You will be the primary product voice in front of defence, government and commercial customers worldwide, and you will largely determine not just execute — the roadmap and strategy for one of Digantara's most important products.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Strategy \& Prioritisation** 




  




* Own the vision, strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for STARS Intelligence products, and defend it independently to leadership, customers and engineering.
* Drive prioritisation using customer needs, business impact and first\-principles reasoning — not engineering interest or research novelty alone.
* Make explicit trade\-off calls between depth (algorithmic sophistication) and speed\-to\-value for customers and be accountable for the outcomes of those calls.



  





**Customer \& Market Engagement** 




  




* Serve as the primary product interface to global customers — defence and government agencies, commercial satellite operators, and insurers/regulators — running discovery, validating problems, and shaping scope directly with them.
* Partner with Sales and Business Development on positioning, pricing and packaging of Intelligence products across government/defence and commercial segments, including support for proposals and technical/commercial conversations.



  





**Working With Algorithms \& Engineering** 




  




* Partner day\-to\-day with algorithms and data science teams to scope SDA capabilities into shippable product increments — asking the right questions without needing to derive the underlying models yourself.
* Write clear PRDs and specs that translate complex technical trade\-offs into unambiguous customer and business requirements.
* Define success metrics (accuracy, latency, coverage, customer outcomes) jointly with engineering and hold the roadmap accountable to them.
* Run planning and prioritisation forums, track delivery against roadmap, and unblock cross\-team dependencies.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 6\+ years in product management, having owned a product's strategy and roadmap (ideally 0\-to\-1 or through a major scale\-up) in a technical, data\- or analytics\-heavy domain serving enterprise, government or defence customers.
* Roadmap and prioritisation: A demonstrated ability to drive prioritisation from customer and business impact and first\-principles reasoning, without needing subject\-matter depth (physics, orbital mechanics) to do it credibly.
* Stakeholder management: A track record of earning trust and driving decisions with highly technical teams — scientists, algorithm engineers, PhDs — as an equal partner rather than a backlog administrator.
* Real autonomy in prior roles: comfortable setting direction, making the call, and owning the outcome rather than waiting for it to be handed down.



  





**Location: Hebbal, Bangalore** 




**WFO 5 days from office.**

 The Innovation team is seeking a Senior Manager, Product Development, for the Firm's Innovation Department, based out of our Bangalore office. This is a technology leadership role accountable for the engineering organization that builds, maintains, supports, and automates the Firm's portfolio of custom products and solutions. The Senior Manager owns execution of engineering strategy, delivery, and run\-state health across that portfolio, and partners with product management and Firm leadership to ensure technical direction is inseparable from business outcomes.
 



  





 Withum’s brand is a reflection of our people, our culture and our strength. Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, easy to work with a sense of purpose and caring for their co\-workers and whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive.  This role operates with authority over engineering priorities, release cadence, platform standards, and team capacity, and with a mandate to raise the quality, reliability, and consistency of engineering practice across product teams. The Senior Manager serves as the people leader for engineers, automation developers, and technical leads — coaching them, setting the technical bar, and holding accountability for what the team ships and for how well it runs once it is live.
 



  





  





**How You’ll Spend Your Time:** 




 Technology Vision and Engineering Strategy
 



 · Craft and communicate an inspirational technical vision for the product portfolio, articulating clearly how individual products, platforms, and services come together into one coherent engineering estate.
 



 · Partner proactively with Firm leaders to define and evolve the end\-state architecture, ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, performant, and scalable.
 



 · Translate the portfolio vision into a 18\-to\-24\-month engineering roadmap, clearly mapped to business outcomes, value creation, and technical risk reduction.
 



 · Drive the platform and data architecture roadmap, eliminating non\-strategic connections, brittle integrations, and manual batch handoffs.
 



 · Model adaptability by continuously evolving the technology stack in response to industry trends, emerging platforms, new insights, and shifting business needs — challenging current thinking, testing theories, and iterating rapidly.
 



  





 Product Development and Delivery
 



  





 · Lead the engineering team in designing, building, testing, and deploying new products and solutions across cloud\-native, AI, and automation technologies, including Microsoft Azure, the Power Platform, and modern AI services.
 



 · Partner with product management on prototyping and MVP development, providing technical subject matter expertise and ensuring proposed solutions are buildable, supportable, and aligned to practice requirements.

title: Director, Software Engineering - Agentic AI
description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: a fleet of specialized AI agents, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. Someone has to own the product, the roadmap, and the team behind it. That is this role.
   

  

 You will lead the engineering pods that build the orchestration layer, the persona consoles, and the agents themselves, and carry the roadmap from first MVP to organization\-wide scale. This is a player\-coach role for a leader who can hold a product vision, an architecture, an executive audience, and a hiring plan in their head at the same time.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Own the Product and the Roadmap
   

  

* Define and drive the delivery\-engine roadmap: orchestrator, agent fleet, consoles, dashboards, and enterprise integrations, sequenced for value
* Make the build\-measure\-learn loop real: ship in sprints, pilot with live delivery teams, and let adoption and telemetry reshape the plan
* Own trade\-off decisions across scope, quality, cost, and speed, and defend them with data in front of senior leadership


 Build and Lead the Pods
   

  

* Hire, grow, and retain a small, exceptional team of agent engineers, platform engineers, and delivery talent across the UK and India
* Run lean pods where agents do the routine work and people do the judgment work; model that way of working yourself
* Set a high, kind bar: clear expectations, honest feedback, and career growth in the most modern engineering discipline there is


 Prove the Value
   

  

* Own the value story: cycle time, throughput, quality, adoption, and realized business value, instrumented and reported without drama
* Keep the economics honest: agent cost, platform cost, and capacity unlocked, treated as first\-class engineering metrics
* Turn pilot wins into an expansion case that finance and function leaders believe


 Set the Operating Standard
   

  

* Establish how agent\-first engineering is done: evals as release gates, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, and responsible AI governance with InfoSec and the AI council
* Represent the platform in architecture and governance forums, and keep the roadmap aligned with enterprise platform and data strategy
* Share patterns, standards, and playbooks so other teams can adopt what your team proves


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* The delivery engine is in daily use by live delivery teams, with measurable cycle\-time and quality gains that survive finance scrutiny
* You have built a team people want to join, with a hiring record and retention that show it
* Executives trust your roadmap because what you commit to ships, and what ships gets measured
* The operating standards your team set are being adopted beyond your team


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years leading engineering teams or engineering\-led products
* A record of shipping and scaling platforms or products in an enterprise, from first release through adoption
* Hands\-on fluency with modern AI: LLM\-powered applications, agentic systems, and what it takes to make them production\-grade
* Strong architectural judgment across APIs, event\-driven systems, cloud platforms, and enterprise integration
* Proven hiring and talent development record, including building distributed teams
* Executive\-grade communication: you can carry a room of senior stakeholders with a clear, honest narrative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering AI or automation platforms into regulated or security\-conscious enterprises
* Experience with agent frameworks and protocols such as MCP or A2A, and with eval\-driven quality practices
* Experience running product operating models: roadmaps, funding cases, value realization
* 
* Background in developer platforms, SDLC tooling, or engineering productivity


 Core Competencies
   

  

 Product \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Roadmap ownership; architectural judgment; trade\-off decision\-making; systems thinking


 People Leadership
   

  

* Hiring and talent development; lean pod design; coaching; distributed team leadership


 AI\-First Operating Model
   

  

* 
* Agent\-first ways of working; evals and governance; human\-in\-the\-loop design; value instrumentation


 Executive Influence
   

  

* Narrative and communication; stakeholder alignment; funding and value cases; calm under scrutiny


 Why This Role
   

  

 Incubation is a durable capability, not a project team: the team persists, and the product rotates. Agentic delivery is product one; the next incubation bets follow. You will define how AI\-first engineering works at Equinix and build the team that proves it. Few director roles come with a mandate this clear and a canvas this open.

description:
**Job Title: Associate – Founders’ Office** 




**Experience: 3 \- 4 Years** 




**Location: Bengaluru, India (On\-Site)** 




**Type: Full\-Time** 




**Compensation: ₹7 to ₹10 LPA (CTC)** 




  





**About Stance Health** 





 Stance Health is an evidence\-backed physiotherapy and performance healthcare company focused on injury prevention, pain management, movement optimization, rehabilitation, and performance enhancement.
 





 Through technology\-backed assessments, evidence\-based treatment protocols, and long\-term strength programs, we help individuals recover better, move better, and perform at their highest potential.
 





 We currently operate 5 centres across Bengaluru — HSR, Whitefield, Indiranagar, JP Nagar and Koramangala — delivering 5,000\+ sessions every month.
 





 As we continue expanding across Bengaluru, we are building the systems, growth engines, partnerships, and operating capabilities required to scale Stance into a leading high\-performance healthcare brand.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 We are looking for an Associate – Founders’ Office to work closely with the founding team on high\-priority business initiatives across growth, revenue, partnerships, expansion, and operations.
 
 ﻿
 






 This is a high\-ownership role with significant exposure to the business. You will be expected to take initiatives from problem identification through execution and measurement, working across functions and directly with external stakeholders where required.
 





 The role will involve both strategic problem\-solving and hands\-on execution. Depending on the initiative, your work could range from identifying a new growth opportunity and developing the approach to executing a partnership, supporting a new centre launch, running an on\-ground activation, or analysing the performance of an initiative and determining the next course of action.
 





 This role requires someone who is comfortable operating in an environment where the problems are not always clearly defined and where ownership extends beyond a fixed functional responsibility.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 1\.
 
**Growth \& Revenue** 



* Work with the founders to identify and execute opportunities to drive revenue and customer growth.
* Develop and execute initiatives across customer acquisition, retention, referrals, partnerships, and new revenue channels.
* Support the development and execution of go\-to\-market strategies for new services, programs, and offerings.
* Evaluate pricing, packaging, and monetization opportunities.
* Track the performance of growth initiatives and identify opportunities for improvement.




 2\.
 
**Partnerships \& Business Development** 



* Identify and evaluate potential partnerships across relevant businesses, institutions, communities, corporates, and other external stakeholders.
* Initiate conversations, manage follow\-ups, and drive partnerships through to execution.
* Build and maintain relationships with external stakeholders.
* Develop partnership proposals and support commercial discussions.
* Measure partnership performance and identify opportunities to scale successful initiatives.



**3\. Expansion \& GTM** 



* Support the expansion of Stance across Bengaluru through market research, location evaluation, and launch execution.
* Conduct on\-ground research to assess potential locations, customer segments, competitors, and market opportunities.
* Support new centre launches across planning, partnerships, local activation, and execution.
* Assist in evaluating new business opportunities and expansion initiatives.
* Coordinate across internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely execution of launches and pilots.



**4\. On\-Ground Execution** 



* Plan and execute events, activations, campaigns, and other customer\-facing initiatives.
* Coordinate with vendors, partners, institutions, and other external stakeholders.
* Conduct centre visits and on\-ground market assessments as required.
* Identify execution gaps and resolve operational issues independently.
* Ensure initiatives are executed within defined timelines and objectives.



**5\. Business Operations** 



* Identify operational bottlenecks and work with relevant teams to implement solutions.
* Translate business priorities into structured execution plans.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through.
* Support the implementation and improvement of processes as the business scales.
* Monitor execution against agreed objectives, timelines, and performance metrics.



**6\. Data \& Business Performance** 



* Track key business metrics across revenue, growth, customer acquisition, partnerships, and centre performance.
* Analyse business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for business reviews.
* Evaluate the performance of experiments and initiatives and recommend next steps.
* Present findings and recommendations to the founding team in a clear and structured manner.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 





 We are looking for someone who has demonstrated ownership of business initiatives and the ability to take them from planning to execution.The ideal candidate will have experience in areas such as:
 



* Business growth and revenue
* Business development and partnerships
* Startup or business operations
* GTM and expansion
* Project or initiative ownership
* On\-ground execution
* Events, launches, campaigns, or activations
* Cross\-functional business initiatives




 Your previous job title is less important than the scope of work you have actually handled and the outcomes you have delivered.
 




**We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in environments where they were required to operate independently, manage multiple stakeholders, solve ambiguous problems, and take responsibility for outcomes.** 




  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3–4 years of relevant professional experience in business growth, business development, operations, partnerships, GTM, or similar execution\-oriented roles.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Strong commercial and business understanding.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage and execute cross\-functional initiatives.
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong stakeholder management and follow\-through.
* Comfortable with regular on\-ground work and travel across Bengaluru as required..
* Comfortable working 6 days from the office.



**Note: No postgraduate qualification is required or preferred. Business Analyst roles would not be the right fit.** 




  





**Who Will Succeed in This Role \-** 

 The role is suited to someone who:
 



* Takes ownership without requiring constant direction.
* Can move comfortably between analysis, decision\-making, and execution.
* Is commercially minded and understands the connection between initiatives and business outcomes.
* Can work with founders as well as internal and external stakeholders.
* Is comfortable dealing with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can structure an unclear problem and independently determine the next steps.
* Has a strong bias towards execution and measurable outcomes.
* Is comfortable working across functions rather than operating within a narrowly defined role.



  





**What This Role Is Not** 





 This is not a pure analytics, reporting, recruitment, product management, or coordination role.
 





 The position requires meaningful involvement in business execution, growth, partnerships, expansion, and operations. Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to analysis, reporting, functional support, or specialist responsibilities may not be the right fit.
 




  





**Why Join Stance Health** 



* Work directly with the founding team on high\-priority business initiatives.
* Exposure across growth, revenue, partnerships, operations, and expansion.
* Opportunity to contribute to new centre launches and business\-building initiatives.
* High level of ownership and visibility into business decisions.
* Opportunity to work in a rapidly expanding healthcare and performance business.
* Direct exposure to the process of scaling a multi\-centre healthcare brand.



  





**If you are interested in building businesses, solving complex problems, and taking ownership of execution, we would like to hear from you.**

**Company Description**
**ServiceNow**
 It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Our intelligent cloud\-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
   

  

 Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.
   

  

 Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.
   

  

 Moveworks is trusted by over 5\.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.
   

  

 In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.
   

  

 By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high\-growth company. We are looking for world\-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.
   

  

 Come join us!

 As an Engineering Manager on the Product and Platform org at Moveworks, you will lead a team of strong engineers. The team will focus on developing user facing product features that leverage our advanced Machine Learning platform. In addition, you will design scalable frameworks to support rapid feature development and deployment. You will be working cross\-functionally with other teams regularly to design and deploy features and tools that our customers use every day. Your role is absolutely critical here at Moveworks, and you will see the immediate impact of your work on both customers and other engineers.
   

  

 If you are passionate about full\-stack product development, curious about machine learning, enjoy working alongside equally driven colleagues, and are an experienced engineer looking for a new challenge, we should have a conversation!
