title: Product Consultant - CS
description:
**Product Consultant** 




 Customer Success · Individual Contributor
 



  





**About Superset** 




 Superset is India's largest campus recruitment platform. We help large enterprises run end\-to\-end fresher hiring outreach, applications, assessments, interviews, hiring ops, and analytics at scale. Beyond hiring workflows, we power candidate engagement programs, competitions, hackathons, and learning journeys that make Superset the platform of choice for enterprises that want to build a brand on campus, not just fill seats. Our clients include marquee names across BFSI, IT, consulting, and manufacturing. You'll work directly with hiring and talent acquisition teams at large companies and own outcomes that impact thousands of candidates.
 



  





 Working at Superset means operating in a high\-engagement, high\-variety environment. Every week brings new client contexts, new problem shapes, and new stakeholders. If you're someone who learns fastest when thrown into the deep end and likes to make sense of complexity on the fly, this is your kind of place.
 



  





 We invest continuously in internal learning through peer sessions, structured capability\-building, and cross\-functional exposure. As a Product Consultant, you're expected to be both a practitioner and a multiplier: someone who raises the bar for the team around them, not just someone who delivers for their own portfolio.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Enterprises don't buy "a product". They buy a result: smoother hiring, faster closures, fewer ops headaches, and a confident team on the other side.
 



  





 This role owns that result. You step in when client situations need expert judgment, strategic solutioning, or delivery ownership that goes beyond day\-to\-day account management. You will work alongside CSMs (
 *who handle daily client relationships* 
 ) and serve as the escalation and solutioning layer that the person the team calls when things get complex.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Understand client hiring workflows and tailor Superset to their needs—owning post\-sales delivery with a hands\-on, customised approach (
 *not a generic walk\-through* 
 ).
* Go beyond surface requirements: identify the actual bottleneck, the hidden constraints, and what "success" truly means for each client.
* Lead implementations and POCs: scope, plan, execute, and make sure the client sees value fast.
* Own complex escalations solutioning, delivery decisions, and edge cases that the CSM layer escalates upward.
* Run client conversations with confidence even when the room is sceptical, confused, or unconvinced. Keep the ball in your court.
* Storyboard the solution: stitch a clear narrative for why the approach works and how the rollout will happen.
* Manage senior stakeholders (TA, HRBP, business leaders, ops, IT) across the client org align them, handle objections, move things forward without harming trust.
* Treat internal teams as customers too: validate asks, prioritise correctly, and sell the right work internally to get things done.
* Solve problems by connecting dots use existing tools and processes first; when enhancement is needed, articulate impact on business and other clients.
* Support pre\-sales on enterprise deals: solutioning conversations, SOW reviews, and client presentations alongside the sales team.
* Own outcomes end\-to\-end: adoption, usage, renewals (where applicable), and overall project success. No handoff and disappear.
* Mentor the CSM team set escalation standards, review their work, and be the person they turn to when a situation gets tough.
* Write approach notes and solution documents: structured thinking on paper that a client or internal stakeholder can act on without a follow\-up call.
* Deeply understand customer problems before jumping to solutions diagnosis first, prescription second.
* Run internal upskilling sessions with the team: share learnings from complex engagements, build playbooks, and raise the average capability of the CS function.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Core requirements:** 



* 7–10\+ years in consulting, enterprise SaaS, HR tech, or client\-facing implementation roles.
* Sharp requirement discovery you get to the crux quickly and ask the uncomfortable but necessary questions.
* Strong product understanding: you can translate features into real business workflows, not just talk about them.
* High EQ and executive communication you can build comfort and trust with senior stakeholders, fast.
* Storytelling ability: you can structure messy inputs into a clear plan and narrative.
* Ownership mindset: end\-to\-end accountability, not task completion.
* Bias for action fail fast, learn fast, iterate fast.



  





**Strong signals:** 



* Exposure to recruitment, HR tech, assessments, or workforce solutions.
* Comfort holding a room recovering a drifting call, de\-escalating tension, and still driving to a decision.
* Track record of being trusted with client relationships that required more than relationship management.
* Having experience working in fast\-paced and fast\-growing organisations



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




 We want to be direct so there are no surprises:
 


* Not a daily account management role CSMs own that layer.
* Not a traditional people manager role but you will mentor and guide the team on complex situations, run upskilling sessions, and set the standard for how the CS function operates.



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)** 



* You independently run client discovery and implementation calls without hand\-holding.
* Pick a project, deliver it end\-to\-end yourself, and ensure it creates a “wow” outcome for the customer with clear business impact and problem resolution.
* You've built strong relationships with key client stakeholders and become their go\-to person.
* You've improved at least one internal playbook docs, process, or templates based on real learnings.

title: Software Development Manager, AWS DynamoDB
description:
**Description**
 AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
   

  

 Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission\-critical workloads operating at more than 100 million requests per second? Let's take its speed and efficiency to the next level!
   

  

 Amazon DynamoDB is a key\-value and document database that delivers single\-digit\-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast\-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission\-critical workloads.
   

  

 We are looking for an engineering leader eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB.
   

  

 As a software development manager on the DynamoDB team, you will lead a team of passionate engineers to build reliable and highly scalable distributed systems. This is a good opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of cloud database services, grow as a technology leader, and work with some really smart people. To succeed in the role, you must be passionate about both solving deep technical challenges and being a great people manager. You must care deeply about system availability and reliability, and understand what it means to own a mission\-critical service that handles hundreds of millions of requests per second, with sub\-millisecond latencies and eight 9s of availability. You must be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. The right candidate will be smart, ambitious, love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun. Building, motivating and mentoring a world\-class systems \& software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day\-to\-day people and performance management tasks.
   

  

 You must have a strong Agile product management and delivery experience. The successful candidate will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Agile methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value\-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross\-team projects. You will set the vision of how to evolve DynamoDB going forward.
   

  

 You must have a strong operational experience, with a track record of operating highly available fault tolerant systems. The right candidate will want to measure everything and be very data driven. They will excel at using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of their team. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment.
   

  

 If you want to test your limits, build a world\-class team, and tackle challenges at a scale and level of impact rarely seen, join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Brand Manager
description:
Role : Brand Manager

Location : Bangalore

About Arkahub

Arkahub is a funded residential rooftop solar company, founded in May 2025 by Manish Pansari (ex\-CXO, Myntra) and Kaustabh Chakraborty (scaled Wakefit; founding team at Urban Ladder). Backed by Kae Capital, Sparrow Capital and Antler. Live in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune and Nagpur, with Chennai and Dehradun launching soon.

We position ourselves as a home energy company, not a solar installer. Homeowners are making a 25\-year decision, and our brand promise, Engineered to Keep Going, is built on products that are engineered and proven to perform, backed by honest advice.

Why this role exists

The brand function is being built from scratch. This person will own the day\-to\-day running of the brand across every customer touchpoint. We need someone who can own a campaign or a city launch end to end, not just coordinate agencies.

What they will own

* Brand consistency: One look and voice across ads, website, landing pages, sales material, site branding, WhatsApp,

Google Business Profiles and on\-ground assets.

* Briefing: Clear briefs for the in\-house creative team and external partners; turn insights into creative direction.
* Sales enablement: Pitch decks, spec sheets, rate cards, flyers, objection\-handling content and proof assets.
* City launches: Run brand launches for new cities using a repeatable launch kit, with sales, ops and local teams.
* Campaigns and content: Plan and run brand campaigns; support organic content (YouTube, Instagram, blog) and creator partnerships.
* Customer proof: A steady supply of reviews, testimonials, case studies and referral stories.
* Insight and tracking: Support consumer research; track share of search, reviews and brand\-driven leads.

What we're looking for

Must have

* 3–5 years in brand management, ideally in D2C, consumer durables, home improvement, FMCG or another considered\-purchase category
* Strong writing and briefing skills; can define good creative and give sharp feedback
* Has run campaigns or launches end to end, with clear examples of outcomes
* Comfortable in a fast, unstructured startup; takes ownership without waiting for process
* Works well with sales and ops teams, not only creative teams

Good to have

* Experience with high\-ticket, long\-consideration or trust\-led purchases
* Exposure to performance creative (Meta / YouTube) and its effect on cost per lead
* Regional or multi\-city marketing, or influencer and creator work
* Kannada, Telugu, Marathi or Hindi (useful for city launches)

Not a fit

* Candidates who have only coordinated with agencies and not owned output
* Pure social media managers or designers

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

* Provident Fund

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox** .


**Senior Enterprise AI Analyst**

We have an opportunity for a Senior Enterprise AI Analyst to join our IT Cloud Applications team in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager of Enterprise AI Practice. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. You will build AI solutions hands\-on, translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions, and act as a mentor and lead for the Enterprise AI team. You will help drive prototypes through to production\-ready capabilities, manage delivery dependencies, guide best practices, and partner with stakeholders to ensure AI solutions deliver measurable business value. **Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Lead end\-to\-end design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions, agents, automation workflows, and intelligent applications, from discovery and prototyping through production implementation

* Produce high\-quality deliverables that move work forward, including working prototypes, technical documentation, dependency plans, process flows, executive\-ready presentations, adoption reports, and shared standards

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 8\+ years of experience in a hands\-on delivery role such as solutions analyst, software engineer, technical lead, ideally in technology, SaaS, Enterprise applications, or consulting environments
* Strong techno\-functional background with the ability to understand complex business problems and translate them into practical, scalable, and measurable technical solutions
* Hands\-on experience configuring, prototyping, and deploying AI or automation solutions using platforms such as Glean, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, AWS AI, or similar technologies
* Genuine fluency in LLMs, prompt design, AI agents, agentic workflows, enterprise AI adoption patterns, and responsible AI practices
* Strong Python development experience with the ability to build backend applications, integrations, automation scripts, and AI\-enabled services
* Experience designing and integrating RESTful and GraphQL APIs, including asynchronous request handling, performance optimization, error handling, and secure integration patterns
* Solid understanding of backend systems, distributed architectures, microservices, event\-driven design, domain\-driven design, and cloud\-native application principles
* Hands\-on experience with AWS cloud services and DevOps practices, including API Gateway, Lambda, S3, ECS, RDS, GitHub, Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment governance
* Ability to mentor team members, review solution designs, improve delivery practices, manage dependencies, and raise overall execution quality across the Enterprise AI team
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, technical teams, and business users effectively
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

**Be Successful — Your Path**

**First 90 Days:** Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.


**Six Months:** Develop and deploy several feature\-rich web applications with Python/JavaScript and build applications using AI as a service. Collaborate closely with the team to optimize application performance, ensuring fast load times and smooth user interactions across various devices and browsers.


**One Year:** Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of our Backend\-end development practices, sharing your expertise and insights to elevate the skill set of the team and foster a culture of learning and growth. Own custom a AI application and keep enhancing it to get a feasible product for users.


**Belong —** Your Community


Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career\-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy

* We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications

title: Product Manager III, Technical, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self\-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.  

As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross\-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.  

A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high\-quality, simple products, features, and applications. You will identify opportunities to make FC operations more efficient, and drive the design and development of software features to address them — leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration with engineering, design, science, finance, and operations partners to deliver products on time and with high quality, aligning stakeholders and making smart trade\-offs when data is incomplete.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond, including defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on performance metrics and customer feedback.
* Evaluate technical proposals and participate in architecture discussions, understanding how technical choices influence customer outcomes and balancing feature delivery with long\-term system health and scalability.
* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, improve decision\-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.

  

About the team  

AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware — these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non\-sort buildings, traditional sort and non\-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. AFT also owns and operates the FaaST WMS that runs in Vendor Flex buildings, India Mini\-FCs (small footprint, manual buildings in IN), and select Seller Flex locations (3P Sellers who are Prime\-enabled leveraging the FaaST WMS). AFT also owns the External Fulfillment Platform (EFP), which integrates 3P WMSes to the Amazon Supply Chain. AFT owns network infrastructure and devices in all building types including Sort Centers and Last Mile sites, and owns labor planning and scheduling technology leveraged for Fulfillment Centers in NA and EU and Sort Centers in NA.  

  

AFT General Summary  

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon's global fulfillment network. We invent and deliver software, hardware, and data science solutions that orchestrate processes, robots, machines, and people. We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high\-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.  

You will lead the team to conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing and site merchandising efforts, to include marketing campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also you will look into strategic and operational aspects of their business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**Director, Product Management – Core Data and Decision Intelligence**

**Target in India \| L7**

**About Us**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.


Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.


Target is investing in the next generation of **intelligent store experiences** that connect operational, digital and physical environments to create smarter outcomes for guests, team members and the business.


Our Core Intelligence Product teams are building the foundational capabilities that enable Target’s stores to **understand what is happening, anticipate what matters, recommend the right actions, and continuously learn from outcomes**.

**About the Job – Director, Product Management, Core Data and Decision Intelligence**


As Director of Product Management for **Core Intelligence**, you will help define and build the intelligence foundation powering the future of Target’s store operations and experiences.


You will lead a portfolio of highly technical products that bring together signals from operational systems, store environments and enterprise platforms; transform those signals into trusted context; and use data science, AI and intelligent systems to generate actionable recommendations at scale.


Your work will enable Target to move beyond static rules and fragmented signals toward **context\-aware, continuously learning intelligence** that can power multiple Store products, workflows and experiences.


Based in Target in India, you will lead Product Managers and partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams to identify high\-value problems, develop reusable intelligence capabilities and translate technology investments into measurable outcomes for Target’s stores.

**Intelligence Product Vision \& Strategy**

* Define and execute the product vision and strategy for a portfolio of foundational Core Intelligence capabilities.
* Shape how operational and physical signals are transformed into trusted context, insights and recommendations that power Store experiences.
* Build scalable, reusable intelligence capabilities that can serve multiple products, workflows and operational domains.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI/ML, predictive intelligence, recommendation systems, simulation and emerging technologies to solve complex Store problems.
* Translate enterprise and Stores priorities into clear product strategies, investment choices, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Balance near\-term business value with development of durable intelligence capabilities that can scale across Target.

**Product Discovery \& Intelligence Capability Development**

* Develop a deep understanding of Target’s store operating environment and identify opportunities where intelligence can meaningfully improve decisions and experiences.
* Establish strong discovery mechanisms across Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations to move from problems to hypotheses, experiments and scalable solutions.
* Drive rapid experimentation, simulation and learning to validate opportunities before scaling investments.
* Build feedback loops that allow intelligence capabilities to learn from outcomes and improve over time.
* Ensure intelligence products are designed for trust, explainability, interoperability, scalability and long\-term extensibility.

**Product \& Organizational Leadership**

* Lead and develop Product Managers across a portfolio of highly technical intelligence products.
* Create clear product ownership, accountability, success metrics and decision rights across the portfolio.
* Build a strong Product organization in Target in India with deep technical, strategic and business acumen.
* Coach Product Managers to lead through customer problems, discovery, evidence and outcomes rather than requirements and delivery.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, ownership and continuous learning.
* Establish product operating mechanisms that enable empowered teams while maintaining alignment across a complex ecosystem.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Influence**

* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams.
* Influence senior leaders and partners across geographies without relying on direct authority.
* Translate complex technical and intelligence concepts into clear product and business narratives.
* Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities to create alignment around strategic investments.
* Help establish clear boundaries and interfaces between reusable Core Intelligence capabilities and the experiences they power.

**About You**

* 4\-year college degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree in technology, engineering, data science, business or a related field is a plus.
* 8\+ years of Product Management experience, preferably across highly technical, data\-intensive, AI/ML, platform or enterprise products.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and leading complex product portfolios.
* Experience leading and developing Product Managers.
* Strong understanding of data\-driven products, AI/ML concepts, recommendation systems, intelligent platforms or related technology domains.
* Proven ability to translate complex technology into customer and business outcomes.
* Strong systems thinking and ability to connect multiple capabilities into a coherent product strategy.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influence skills.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and solving problems where neither the solution nor the path is obvious.
* Experience working across global Product and Engineering organizations is strongly preferred.

**Company Description** 




  





 Electronics Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (ELCOT) is a Government of Tamil Nadu undertaking under the Information Technology and Digital Services Department.  Domain \& Solutioning Leadership

 Pre\-Sales \& Bid Support

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**About Workhall** 




 Workhall is a bootstrapped low\-code / no\-code enterprise workflow platform. We help large organisations model complex operations as configurable data structures, workflows, and reports, without the cost and drag of bespoke custom development. Today we serve 20\+ enterprise customers across India, Australia, and the Americas, in industries ranging from manufacturing, food and beverage, construction, trade, and private capital.
 



**About the role** 




 You will be the technical backbone that turns the Workhall platform into a working enterprise application. Sitting inside the professional services team, you own requirements gathering, solution design, solve the hard data\-modelling and integration problems that complex customers bring, and act as the deep technical reference point for our implementation partners.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on solutioning role for someone who is equally comfortable whiteboarding an architecture and configuring the platform themselves. You are not just advising from the sidelines. You design, you build, and you set the standard others follow.
 



**What you will do** 





 Solution design and architecture
 



* Own end\-to\-end solution design on the platform: datalists, workflows, roles and permissions, reports, and the expression logic that ties them together.
* Translate ambiguous enterprise requirements into robust, scalable, maintainable configurations rather than one\-off hacks.
* Make and defend data\-modelling decisions, including denormalization and relationship patterns, with an eye on performance and long\-term maintainability on a document\-database platform.




 Build and delivery
 



* Configure and build complex applications.
* Design and implement integrations between Workhall and external enterprise systems.
* Own the hardest technical parts of an implementation, and unblock delivery teams when they hit the limits of the platform or the data model.




 Customer and stakeholder engagement
 



* Run technical discovery workshops with enterprise customers, shape the application, and communicate trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor through an implementation, from design through go\-live and stabilisation.




 Partner enablement and quality
 



* Enable, review, and raise the quality bar for implementation partners so delivery stays consistent as we scale.
* Define reusable patterns, templates, and technical standards that the wider delivery ecosystem can adopt.




 What we are looking for
 



* Experience. 3 to 6 years in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, or technical delivery, including meaningful time on low\-code / no\-code, BPM, or workflow automation platforms.
* Data modelling. Strong data\-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases; MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
* Platform depth. Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
* Communication. Customer\-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision, manage expectations, and say no well.
* Ownership. A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.




 Nice to have
 



* Familiarity with LCNC platform, API design, scripting, or integration middleware.




 Why join us
 



* Ownership. Real ownership. We are a lean, bootstrapped team, so your work ships and your judgement counts from week one.
* Depth. Hard, interesting problems. Modelling messy enterprise operations into clean, reusable software is genuinely difficult and genuinely rewarding.
* Range. Breadth of exposure. You will work across regulated industries and global markets, not a single narrow use case.
* Leverage. A platform with leverage. What you build once serves many customers and many verticals.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program \& Timeline Management**
* Own end\-to\-end program tracking for accessory parts and systems, maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date timelines.
* Compile, manage, and report program schedules, identifying milestone risks proactively.
* Escalate late parts and programs to the appropriate stakeholders; support (but not necessarily lead) recovery plan execution.


**Liaison \& Communication**
* Act as the primary interface between Accessories and Vehicle Teams, ensuring alignment on program requirements and deliverables.
* Author, track, and coordinate responses to technical Bulletins issued to or from Vehicle Teams.
* Write, manage, and follow up on Engineering Requisitions (ERs) throughout the program lifecycle.


**Budget \& Economic Management**
* Compile and track budgets at vehicle, part, and system levels.
* Manage economic follow\-up covering engineering costs, tooling and means, and part pricing.
* Perform global synthesis of costs and risks; report critical financial risks to OEM management with a defined action plan.


**Technical Coordination**
* Coordinate all technical activities from program kick\-off through SOP, including technical specification, validation plan definition and follow\-up.
* Manage supplier engagement: selection, follow\-up, TKO (Tool Kick\-Off), and part approval processes.
* Oversee fitting instruction documentation and distribution to relevant teams.


**Risk, Governance \& Reporting**
* Drive project progress across accessory and service parts projects; proactively identify risks and issues.
* Define and implement mitigation strategies to protect program delivery commitments.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure project dependencies are delivered on time and in scope.
* Provide structured status reporting to internal leadership and client program teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Automotive, or related Engineering discipline (mandatory).
* 12\+ years of experience in automotive program management, preferably in accessories, service parts, or OEM delivery.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is a strong added advantage.
* Prior exposure to OEM programs


**Essential Skills**
**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* 
+ Strong program and project management skills, including timeline management, budget control, and risk mitigation.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills – ability to work across OEM, supplier, and internal teams.
+ Solid automotive engineering background with understanding of accessory and service parts development processes.
+ Familiarity with Engineering Requisition (ER) processes, technical bulletins, and supplier management in an OEM environment.
+ Experience managing cross\-functional technical teams and vendor/supplier coordination.
+ Strong analytical skills for budget tracking, risk synthesis, and reporting.
+ Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Project); PLM/PDM tools knowledge is an advantage.


**Experience**
**Total Experience**
 12 TO 15 Years in Program Management

title: Channel Development Manager - Agency - Business Partner (Channel Development Manager)
description:
### **What are we looking for?**


The Channel Development Manager is responsible for expanding, nurturing, and driving productivity across partner\-led distribution channels. The role focuses on developing strategic alliances, improving partner capability, ensuring compliance, and driving consistent business growth through partner networks.


### **What does the job entail?**


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **1\. Partner Acquisition \& Onboarding**


* Identify and acquire new partners (agencies, brokers, corporate partners, financial distributors).
* Conduct due‑diligence checks and ensure smooth onboarding as per company guidelines.
* Deploy partner launch plans including initial training, product familiarization, and operational setup.

### **2\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth**


* Drive sales targets through partner channels by creating monthly and quarterly business plans.
* Monitor partner performance, productivity ratios, and sales KPIs (case count, ANP, product mix).
* Implement partner‑specific business development strategies to maximize potential in assigned geography.

### **3\. Relationship Management**


* Ensure strong engagement with key stakeholders at partner organizations (owners, branch heads, senior management).
* Conduct periodic business reviews to analyze performance, gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Address partner escalations promptly and maintain a healthy working relationship.

### **4\. Channel Training \& Capability Building**


* Deliver structured training programs on products, sales processes, compliance norms, and customer service standards.
* Strengthen partner advisor/agent capability through continuous coaching, workshops, and field support.
* Support partners in their recruitment of advisors/agents and enable their productivity ramp\-up.

### **5\. Compliance, Governance \& Quality**


* Ensure 100 percent adherence to regulatory requirements (IRDAI standards, company policies, documentation compliance).
* Monitor partner sales practices to mitigate mis‑selling risks and uphold quality business.
* Conduct periodic audits and compliance checks across partner locations.

### **6\. Market Intelligence \& Strategic Inputs**


* Track competitor activities, emerging channel opportunities, and market trends.
* Provide data\-driven insights to senior leadership for strategic decision making.
* Recommend new partner models, initiatives, and channel development strategies.

### **7\. Cross\-functional Coordination**


* Collaborate with training, operations, underwriting, and marketing teams for partner support.
* Work with regional heads and zonal leadership to implement channel\-specific interventions.
### **Work Experience**


### **Skills Required**


* Channel relationship management.
* Business planning \& market expansion.
* Strong analytical \& problem‑solving skills.
* Excellent communication \& interpersonal capability.
* Ability to train and influence partners.
* Ownership, execution focus, and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
### **Essential Qualification**


* 4–8 years of experience in Life Insurance / BFSI sector.


* Strong experience in partner channel management (Agency, Corporate Agency, Brokers, Alliances).


* Exposure to field sales and partner development.


### **Preferred Skills**


**Key Metrics (KRAs/KPIs)**
---------------------------


* Partner channel business growth (ANP/Case Count).
* Number of active partners and partner productivity.
* Advisor/agent activation \& retention.
* Compliance score and quality metrics.
* Channel diversification and market expansion metrics.
* Month\-on\-month improvement in partner sales operational metrics.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company Description** **Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data\-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.


But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020\. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin\-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward\-thinking, innovative force in the market.


Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting\-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.


Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.


Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description** **Role Overview**


We are looking for a hands\-on Product Manager to build next\-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high\-impact products.


You will own the product end\-to\-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high\-performing, differentiated products.

 **What You’ll Do**

* **Discovery \& Strategy:** Engage deeply with customers to understand pain points and opportunities. Use qualitative and quantitative data to shape product vision and strategy
* **Roadmap \& Prioritization:** Own and refine the product roadmap and backlog. Prioritize work based on customer value, business impact, and strategic goals
* **Execution \& Delivery:** Work daily with Engineering, Architecture, Design, QE, and Cloud Ops in agile teams. Manage trade\-offs, dependencies, and timelines to ship high\-quality products
* **Adoption \& Outcomes:** Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post\-launch impact
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor performance, gather customer feedback, and analyze competition. Iterate to improve usability, performance, and business outcomes

**How You Think**

* You think in **products, not projects**
* You start with the **problem, not the feature**
* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are **data\-driven**, using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 4\+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL\-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end\-to\-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

 **Additional Information**


The recruitment process includes online assessments as a first step (logic \+ cultural fit) \- we will send them via e\-mail, please check also your SPAM folder

title: ERP Business Analyst
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
**As a Senior ERP Business Analyst, you will independently manage end\-to\-end business analysis workstreams within the SAP Sales and Distribution (SD / Market Plan to Cash) functional area. You will tackle complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, demonstrating a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical business domain, related enterprise technologies, and cross\-module interdependencies. In this role, you will apply advanced BA tools and techniques to translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans and solution designs. You will act as a trusted advisor to cross\-functional teams, shape stakeholder perspectives, and drive the design, validation, and delivery of scalable SAP solutions. Additionally, you will mentor junior analysts and actively contribute to the ERP Community of Practice (CoP).**
****Description of the Area****
**This role supports the Marketing Plan to Cash (MP2C) value stream and is aligned with the ASPIRE roadmap, a multi\-year global initiative aiming to define and develop functional ERP roadmaps that simplify, standardize, and automate core business processes leveraging SAP industry best practices. The team focuses on delivering high\-impact Order\-to\-Cash offerings and integrating SAP SD seamlessly across global enterprise platforms.**
****Job Responsibilities****
* Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manage end\-to\-end business analysis workstreams for the SAP SD (Market Plan to Cash) domain without guidance. Adapt and adhere to Roche standard frameworks, mentor junior and intermediate BAs, and drive/lead practices in end\-to\-end process design and optimization. Work in close partnership with business stakeholders to define, design, build, test, and deploy functional ERP solutions based on SAP ECC and S/4 HANA best practices.
* Accountability / Problem Solving: Perform root cause analysis on complex business issues and lead Key Design Decisions. Accountable for creating comprehensive documentation (functional and technical specifications, test plans) and configuring, building, testing, and deploying SAP SD solutions alongside implementation partners, as well as coordinating production changes and providing L3 support for live operational systems.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**The Job in short** 



* We are building a durable execution process engine – a platform that bridges enterprise workflow automation and intelligent agent orchestration. This is a zero\-to\-one product launch from concept to market.
* You will lead the product strategy and execution for one of three interconnected pillars in the platform (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents). Working alongside peer PMs and reporting to the Group PM, you'll own the complete customer journey: from defining what we build, to shipping it, to ensuring it lands with users.
* This role is for a PM who has shipped complex, multi\-layer platform products before and who thrives in the tension between technical ambition and customer reality.



  





**The Product Vision** 



* A durable execution engine that scales from developer laptops to enterprise clouds, bringing workflow automation, intelligent agents, and real\-time data integration into one coherent platform.
* Modern enterprises are stuck. Legacy workflow systems are rigid and don't integrate with AI. Code\-first pipelines (Airflow, Temporal) give developers freedom but leave business analysts behind. We're building the bridge.



  





**Our platform will:** 




 ● Work for multiple personas – Business analysts author visually, engineers deploy as code, operators observe in real time. No translation layer needed.
 



 ● Treat AI as native – Intelligent agents aren't bolted on; they're first\-class actors in the process execution model with full auditability and compliance guardrails.
 



 ● Connect everything – Data from any source (APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services) flows naturally through your processes without custom plumbing.
 



 ● Build toward Horizon's sophistication – Our long\-term ambition is to deliver agentic orchestration depth comparable to the best\-in\-class products in the market.
 



 The result: enterprises can automate complex work faster, with more control, and with confidence that their processes will execute reliably at scale.
 



  





**Meet the job** 




**Strategic ownership** 




 ● Define the product roadmap for Workflows \& Orchestration – what customers need, what moves the needle, what builds defensible value
 



 ● Make the hard calls: what ships in MVP, what is post\-launch, what never ships
 



 ● Own the competitive positioning – position durable processes as a first\-class pillar of an integrated platform, not a standalone point solution
 



 ● Shape both pro\-code and no\-code experiences – own SDKs, CLI, and visual editor consistency; documentation and learning paths across both personas
 



 Execution leadership
 



 ● Lead cross\-functional alignment (eng, design, marketing, sales) on priorities and milestones
 



 ● Conduct customer discovery: who are we building for, what problems do they have, what's blocking adoption
 



 ● Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, customer feedback, performance metrics all inform direction
 



 ● Unblock ambiguity: when technical direction isn't clear, you synthesize information and move forward decisively
 



 Partnership with peer PMs
 



 ● You're not alone – work collaboratively with two peer IC PMs who own the Data Connectors and AI Agents pillars
 



 ● Establish clear integration points and contract boundaries so all three pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents) work together seamlessly
 



 ● Escalate only real conflicts up to the Group PM; resolve most decisions at your level
 



  





**How about you** 



* Experience shipping one or more of the following:
* Complex infrastructure or platform products · Enterprise workflow or automation systems · Products that span multiple user personas (business analysts, developers, operators) · Products that required deep technical integration · Zero\-to\-one launches where you shaped initial product\-market fit.



  





**Core capabilities** 




 ● Technical fluency – You read code, understand architecture constraints, and can have a real conversation with engineers about feasibility and tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.
 



 ● Customer obsession with realism – You spend time with users, but you're not a feature\-request transcriber. You synthesize what they need from what they say.
 



 ● Decisiveness under ambiguity – You make calls with incomplete information. You're comfortable killing ideas you love if data suggests they won't work.
 



 ● Communication across layers – You talk to engineers about latency budgets, to customers about compliance, to executives about roadmap priorities. Different audiences, same honesty.
 



 ● Systems thinking – You see how pieces connect. Developer SDKs influence adoption patterns. Pricing models influence feature prioritization. You optimize for the system, not the local maximum.
 



 ● AI native – You’re using LLMs as part of your product workflow and can adapt to any tool easily. We currently use Claude Code and Cursor.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 ● 5\+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, with a strong focus on platform products.
 



 ● Exposure to workflow engines, BPM systems, or process orchestration platforms (Camunda, Zeebe, Airflow, Temporal).
 



 ● Experience with enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA) and how they shape product architecture.
 



 ● Understanding of multi\-tenant SaaS scaling challenges and tradeoffs
 



 ● Previous zero\-to\-one product launch where you defined the initial MVP and shaped early\-stage product\-market fit.
 



 ● Experience building features using LLMs (it can be a hobby project).

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.
   

  

 As a Product Manager in Business Banking Lending, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Defines the product strategy and vision for Pricing and Risk Decision capabilities within Lending, translating business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap of features and enhancements.
* Owns the discovery process for pricing and risk decisioning needs, including stakeholder interviews and workflow analysis, and converts insights into well\-defined epics, user stories, and measurable outcomes.

* Builds features that strengthen decision quality and operational efficiency, including requirements for decision logic, approval workflows, exception handling, and audit trails, and partners with engineering to implement durable solutions.

* 10\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a closely related domain.
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, including discovery, requirements definition, delivery planning, and value realization.
* Working knowledge of lending operations, credit risk assessment, and pricing methodologies sufficient to drive prioritization and informed trade\-offs with engineering, risk, and business partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams through ambiguity, align stakeholders on scope and sequencing, and deliver durable capabilities with clear adoption and outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Experience building and scaling capabilities for regulated financial services domains, including lending, credit, or risk, with an understanding of the operational and control expectations for decisioning systems used in underwriting, pricing, and approval processes.

We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

 The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands\-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands\-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. This is not a purely roadmap or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage credibly with clients, and get into the detail when needed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product definition and execution of enterprise AI applications, workflows, and features from discovery through release and adoption
* Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business problems, frame opportunities, and convert them into clear product requirements and delivery plans
* Shape AI\-first user experiences, including copilots, assistants, agentic workflows, decision\-support tools, and human\-in\-the\-loop enterprise applications

* Product requirements are crisp, actionable, and reduce ambiguity for delivery teams

* Experience supporting farming\-led account expansion, identifying opportunities within existing accounts, or helping grow strategic client relationships is a strong plus
* Background as a Software Engineer or strong technical foundation is preferred

Visit us at www.zaggle.in to know more about us!
 



  





 We believe “Innovation is the Key” and Zaggle has been instrumental with launching multiple successful products in the last 3 years in the Business Spend Management space. Today we are a 300\+ member strong team spread across Technology, Product, Sales, Implementation Services, Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal and Support functions with 7 office locations in India.
 



  





**About the job** 




 Own the client\-driven P2P roadmap for requests that affect implementation, renewals and existing accounts. Prioritise client requirements, work with engineering to deliver them, and confirm that each release solves the issue raised.
 



 This hands\-on product role works closely with implementation, customer success, support and engineering on an enterprise SaaS platform with contractual timelines.
 



  





**Responsibilities :** 




**Client requests and delivery** 



* Intake, triage and prioritisation of all requests from implementation, onboarding and existing clients.
* The backlog of existing\-client feature requests and enhancement asks — kept current, sized and defensible.
* A working partnership with customer success and support on the pain points blocking renewals or expansion.
* Acceptance criteria for client\-specific and client\-driven requirements, written so QA and engineering can act on them without a follow\-up meeting.
* Scoping and delivery timelines agreed with engineering, and the communication of those timelines to everyone waiting on them.
* SLA tracking for client and implementation commitments, including contract\-tied deadlines.
* Sprint delivery for client requests you own sprint completion rate and the scrum cadence for this track.
* Live issues, bug fixes and the technical debt that surfaces through client interactions.
* Status and timeline communication back to CS, implementation and support, without them having to chase you.
* Escalation of repeated requests upward as candidate roadmap items for the growth track.



**How success is measured** 



* Sprint completion rate on client requests; resolution time and SLA adherence
* Fewer implementation blockers; CSAT and NPS tied to responsiveness
* Churn risk mitigated through resolution of specific product gaps



**To succeed in the role** 




**Qualifications and experience** 



* This one is non\-negotiable: you must come from a P2P product background. The product you own today or owned most recently has to be a procure\-to\-pay product. We are not able to consider strong PMs from adjacent SaaS categories for this role.
* Minimum 3 years in product management, owning a product or module rather than only gathering requirements for one.
* Deep, current knowledge of the P2P industry: who the buyers are, how procurement and finance teams actually work, who you compete with and where each of you is weak.
* You can walk us through your product end to end the workflow, the edge cases, the trade\-offs you chose and why without a deck.
* Experience with enterprise clients, contractual SLAs and requirements that arrive mid\-implementation.
* Comfortable running a sprint with engineering: writing stories, defining acceptance criteria, sizing with the team, holding the cadence.
* Clear written communication. Most of this job is making a decision legible to people who were not in the room.



**P2P skills and know\-how** 



* Intake to procure: catalogue and non\-catalogue requisitions, approval matrices, budget checks, purchase requests, and the politics of an approval chain.
* PO lifecycle: PO creation and amendments, blanket and service POs, partial receipts, GRN, closures.
* Invoice to pay: invoice capture and OCR, two\-way and three\-way matching, exception and mismatch handling, credit and debit notes, payment runs.
* Vendor lifecycle: onboarding and KYC, bank account verification, vendor master data, vendor portals and self\-service.
* Compliance: GST and input credit, TDS, e\-invoicing and IRN, e\-way bill, audit trails and retention.
* Integrations: ERP and accounting sync SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Tally, Zoho through APIs or file\-based flows, and what breaks in the real world.
* Spend visibility: spend controls, budget consumption, and the reporting finance teams ask for after go\-live.



**Helpful experience** 



* Exposure to adjacent spend categories corporate cards, expense management, payables automation.
* Building configurable features on a multi\-tenant SaaS platform, where one client's request cannot become everyone's problem.
* Working fluency with Jira and SQL, enough to answer your own questions about usage and backlog health.
* Fintech or B2B payments experience in the Indian market.

title: AVP Data Product Owner–Data Integrity, Migration, & Experience Enablement Team (DIME)
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 LPL Financial is seeking a Consumption Data Product Owner to lead product ownership for consumption\-facing data capabilities. This role focuses on how enterprise data is discovered, understood, accessed, and used by downstream consumers across applications, analytics platforms, advisor experiences, operations, partners, and enterprise reporting.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, Consumer Enablement, and Data Analysis. The Consumption DPO is expected to operate as a true Product Manager, with the ability to look ahead, define a clear product strategy, build and maintain a roadmap, and align stakeholders around measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 The Consumption DPO helps translate consumer needs into data product capabilities by defining use cases, prioritizing demand, shaping data access patterns, and ensuring requirements are clear, testable, and aligned to enterprise data platform direction.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines product management discipline, strong analytical skills, data fluency, and stakeholder leadership. This person should be comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, data distribution capabilities, and downstream consumers to make data easier to consume, trust, and reuse.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership**
* Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned consumption\-facing data capabilities.
* Translate business outcomes, consumer needs, and enterprise data strategy into clear roadmap priorities.
* Develop multi\-quarter roadmaps that balance strategic platform investments, consumer demand, risk reduction, operational needs, and delivery capacity.
* Use prioritization frameworks and evidence\-based tradeoff analysis to determine what should be delivered, sequenced, delayed, or deprioritized.
* Define success measures, KPIs, and OKRs that demonstrate product value, adoption, reliability, usability, and consumer impact.
* Communicate product direction, roadmap decisions, tradeoffs, and outcomes to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Consumer Discovery \& Product Definition**
* Engage downstream consumers to understand use cases, pain points, data needs, adoption barriers, and desired business outcomes.
* Translate consumer needs into clear data product problem statements, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release objectives.
* Define consumption patterns for data access through feeds, APIs, shared services, extracts, reporting platforms, and other approved channels.
* Represent the voice of the consumer in roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, sprint reviews, and platform design discussions.
* Help simplify the consumer experience by promoting reusable data products, standardized access patterns, and clear documentation.


**Data Product Ownership \& Consumption Enablement**
* Own or support assigned data products and consumption capabilities from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with data consumers, platform teams, engineering, architecture, and domain data owners to define scalable and reusable data consumption patterns.
* Maintain traceability between business intent, consumer requirements, data products, and technical implementation.
* Support definition and refinement of data contracts, schemas, interfaces, semantic definitions, usage expectations, and dependency documentation.
* Ensure consumption requirements are specific, testable, and aligned to the intended business outcome and consumer experience.


**Advanced Data Analysis \& Decision Support**
* Perform hands\-on data analysis to understand consumer usage, source\-to\-target relationships, dependencies, issues, and impacts.
* Analyze data quality, lineage, semantic consistency, data availability, and downstream impacts that affect consumer trust and usability.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, API changes, platform migrations, system decommissions, or changes to upstream sources.
* Use SQL, reporting, and analytical techniques to support product decisions, validate requirements, and identify durable solutions.
* Provide evidence\-based insights to inform prioritization, roadmap planning, consumer readiness, and delivery decisions.


**Agile Execution \& Delivery**
* Prioritize the product backlog for assigned consumption capabilities.

title: Manager, Program Management, Brand Protection
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
   

  

 The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
   

  

 We are seeking a strategic, experienced Manager, Program Management to lead a team of program managers responsible for the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration of Brand Protection programs. This is a hybrid people\-leadership and program\-delivery role and you will own the performance, growth, and delivery output of your team while individually driving high\-impact programs that turn reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention, directly reducing brand abuse for rights owners globally.
   

  

 This role operates in ambiguous, cross\-functional environments where problem definition and strategy are not always predetermined. You will shape the direction of your team's work, define what success looks like, and build the organizational capability to deliver with senior leadership visibility.
   

  

 This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, setting clear expectations, providing direct and constructive feedback, and coaching each team member to operate at the top of their level.
* Build a high\-performing team culture centered on ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession fostering an environment where PgMs can tackle ambiguous, high\-stakes problems independently.
* Establish team\-level mechanisms (e.g., weekly business reviews, program health checks, retrospectives) that drive operational rigor and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges, owning the most critical and cross\-cutting programs.
* Analyze defect trends, abuse patterns, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs and strengthen Amazon's enforcement posture.
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities at scale.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space.
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations making trade\-off recommendations, surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions, and ensuring your team's programs are integrated into the broader Brand Protection strategy.
* Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross\-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
* Build and maintain deep team\-level expertise in brand abuse and enforcement strategy, ensuring the team can conduct rigorous deep dives to derive insights about emerging abuse vectors across Amazon's worldwide stores.


**About The Team**
 The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Master's degree
* Knowledge of SQL
