title: Head of Engineering
description:
Requirement
 
 As the
 **Head of Engineering** 
 , you will work closely with the Founders and CTO to execute the company’s technology strategy and take end\-to\-end ownership of engineering delivery across multiple fintech products. You will convert product requirements and architecture into clear execution plans, lead engineering teams, drive critical fintech integrations, institutionalise AI\-assisted development, and ensure high standards of security, scalability, reliability, auditability, and engineering quality.
 



  




 Core Responsibilities
 
  




 1\. Engineering Management \& Product Delivery
 * Convert the approved architecture, product roadmap, and detailed feature requirements into a clear month\-by\-month engineering execution plan with milestones, dependencies, and delivery checkpoints.
* Plan the technical roadmap with the Founders and CTO in alignment with business priorities.
* Own delivery across multiple products and ensure engineering teams meet agreed timelines, quality standards, and release goals.
* Run effective sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, definition\-of\-done, release management, and staged go\-lives.
* Lead phased product launches, including prioritised delivery of the Mutual Fund core platform.
* Identify technical, delivery, and resource risks early and drive them to resolution.
* Continuously improve engineering processes, productivity, predictability, and delivery quality.



  




 2\. Technology Strategy \& Architecture Execution
 * Understand and align with the broader business and technology vision set by the Founders and CTO.
* Work closely with the CTO and Architect to translate technology strategy and architecture into executable engineering plans.
* Ensure architecture, design principles, coding standards, and technical practices are implemented consistently across teams.
* Balance long\-term scalability and maintainability with short\-term product delivery.
* Act as a trusted engineering escalation point for the CTO and Architect.



  




 3\. Fintech Integrations
 * Own engineering delivery of integrations across the fintech ecosystem, including:
* Stock broking OMS/RMS and back\-office platforms such as Kambala, Omnisys, ODIN, RupeeSeed, or equivalent systems.
* Mutual Fund RTA feed engines.
* CAS parsing and portfolio ingestion.
* Accord Fintech or similar market\-data providers.
* SETU Account Aggregator.
* MF Central and related investment ecosystem platforms.
* Define reliable integration standards for APIs, authentication, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, error handling, monitoring, and support.
* Work with vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure integrations are delivered according to the overall roadmap.
* Support bought\-component and third\-party integration strategies without compromising security, reliability, or maintainability.



  




 4\. AI\-Assisted Engineering
 * Institutionalise AI\-assisted software development as a standard engineering practice.
* Drive AI adoption across coding, refactoring, code reviews, test generation, documentation, debugging, and reconciliation automation.
* Define and measure the productivity multiplier achieved through AI\-assisted engineering on a monthly basis.
* Ensure AI tools are used within appropriate security, confidentiality, and engineering\-quality standards.



  




 5\. Security, Reliability \& Multi\-Tenant Platform
 * Own engineering implementation of non\-functional requirements for the multi\-tenant white\-label platform.
* Ensure strong standards for security, data isolation, auditability, uptime, scalability, performance, reliability, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure appropriate tenant\-level isolation and access control across customer and transactional data.
* Support enterprise\-grade RBAC and/or ABAC implementation.
* Ensure systems support regulated\-domain controls such as:
* Audit trails
* Maker\-checker workflows
* Data retention
* Access logging
* Transaction traceability
* Reconciliation
* Collaborate with relevant teams to achieve required security certifications and maintain strong security practices across applications and integrations.



  




 6\. Engineering Quality \& Documentation
 * Establish and maintain strong coding, review, testing, deployment, and release standards.
* Ensure applications are scalable, secure, maintainable, testable, and production\-ready.
* Drive automation across testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and operational workflows.
* Lead code\-level and module\-level documentation by example.
* Ensure APIs, workflows, integrations, dependencies, and operational procedures are properly documented.
* Identify and manage technical debt in a structured manner.



  




 7\. People Management
 * Hire, mentor, develop, and retain a high\-performing engineering team.
* Lead and support a team of approximately 8–15 engineers across relevant engineering functions.
* Conduct regular 1:1s and provide clear feedback, coaching, and growth opportunities.
* Identify skill gaps and arrange appropriate mentoring, training, or hiring.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, learning, and engineering excellence.
* Act as the escalation point for major technical and delivery challenges.



  




 8\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 * Work closely with Product, Architecture, Design, Security, Operations, Data, Compliance, and Business teams.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, dependencies, and major technical decisions clearly to leadership.
* Ensure engineering execution remains aligned with business and product priorities.
* Support company\-wide policies and contribute to creating a productive and collaborative work environment.



  




 Expected Skills
 * Strong technical expertise in backend engineering, APIs, distributed systems, databases, and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with popular technology stacks; C\#, .Net Core, Micro Services, Redis, Rabbit/MSMQ, Kafka, MS SQL/PostgreSQL.
* Good understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably
 **AWS and/or GCP** 
 .
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, release management, and production operations.
* Working fluency with AI coding and testing tools as a team\-wide engineering practice.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and delivery\-management skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to plan strategically while executing aggressively in the short term.
* Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.



  




 Qualifications \& Background
 * **8–12 years of overall software engineering experience** 
 .
* **3\+ years of engineering management experience** 
 leading multiple developers or engineering teams.
* Proven experience delivering and operating at least one
 **multi\-module fintech, transactional B2B, or B2C platform end\-to\-end** 
 .
* Demonstrated delivery leadership of approximately
 **8–15 engineers** 
 under aggressive, staged timelines.
* Experience working in high\-growth startup environments.
* Experience working with regulated or control\-heavy platforms requiring security, auditability, data retention, and transaction traceability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



  




 Good to Have
 * Experience in wealth management, stock broking, mutual funds, investment platforms, or capital\-markets technology.
* Exposure to RTA feeds, CAS processing, exchange rails, OMS/RMS, back\-office systems, and reconciliation.

title: Senior Business Analyst MES Solutions
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 This role sits within the MES Solutions Team in the Supply Chain, Manufacturing \& Quality Technology organization and plays a key role in delivering the Digital Manufacturing Strategy. The position acts as a trusted advisor to the business, translating manufacturing process requirements into global MES solutions, leading small to medium system enhancements, and partnering with global Manufacturing and Technology stakeholders across areas such as Manufacturing Execution, Material Flow, Shopfloor Control, Efficiency, and Track \& Trace. The role also ensures MES operational processes and GxP documentation are in place and maintained.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Stay current with internal Technology systems, documentation standards, quality management, IT security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, leveraging reusable products and standard solutions wherever possible.
* Analyze complex business requirements, processes, and data to design, develop, and implement technology solutions supporting manufacturing operations and business execution.
* Lead the design and delivery of small to medium‑sized system changes, coordinating with internal stakeholders, manufacturing teams, and external vendors.
* Conduct end‑to‑end process and data assessments, including requirements gathering, workshops, interviews, and documentation of as‑is and to‑be business processes.
* Own and maintain Global MES user requirements, driving continuous improvement of MES applications in alignment with business needs and best practices.
* Ensure consistency and traceability across user requirements, functional specifications, testing, validation, and release documentation, in line with security and compliance policies.
* Act as a key technology partner to manufacturing leads during MES implementations or upgrades, supporting validation, deployment planning, training, and change management activities.
* Support the Director MES Solutions and manufacturing leadership in shaping the MES strategy, roadmap, and footprint based on performance data and evolving requirement


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Quality, timeliness, and cost effectiveness of project and change delivery
* Operational stability and uninterrupted manufacturing process flow
* Accuracy and completeness of Business Process Models (BPM) and related documentation
* Timely delivery of small and medium‑sized changes within agreed scope and budget
* Effectiveness of MES deployments, upgrades, and global roll‑outs
* Stakeholder satisfaction and adoption of MES solutions
* Compliance with validation, security, and quality standards
* Contribution to MES project execution through technical expertise and governance support


**Minimum Requirements**
 Education
   

  

* University degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline


**Experience \& Skills**
* 10\+ years of experience in the process industry, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing, within multinational environments
* 5\+ years of proven experience in IT/OT project delivery and execution
* 5\+ years of hands‑on experience with Computerized System Validation (CSV) in GxP‑regulated environments
* Strong expertise in Manufacturing Execution Systems, particularly Körber/WERUM PAS‑X (various generations)
* Solid understanding of Manufacturing IT ecosystems including OSI‑PI, SAP PP/PI, SAP MII, warehouse systems, Track \& Trace, and SCADA/Automation
* Advanced skills in business analysis, requirements management, process modeling, validation support, and stakeholder communication
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, work across organizational boundaries, and provide authoritative technical guidance
* Strong communication skills with experience presenting and translating complex technical concepts to diverse audiences


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us!

title: Technical & Creative Content Writer - B2B
description:
**Technical \& Creative Content Writer \- B2B**

**Location:** Hyderabad, Onsite  
**Experience:** 2 to 6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About The Smarketers**

The Smarketers is a B2B marketing agency that works with technology companies to help them build their brand, generate demand, and grow their business.

We work with clients across SaaS, IT Services, Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Telecom, Healthcare, ERP, FinTech, and other technology\-driven B2B industries.

Content is one of the key pillars of what we do. We create blogs, eBooks, whitepapers, case studies, website content, social media content, brochures, reports, video scripts, and other marketing and sales content.

**About the Role**

**Do you understand technology and have a flair for creative writing?Can you turn complex B2B technology and business topics into content that people want to read?**

If yes, that is what we are looking for.

As a **Technical \& Creative Content Writer \- B2B**, you will plan, research, create, and edit content for our B2B technology clients.

You will work across different industries and need to understand the client's business, products, technology, customers, industry, competitors, and positioning before creating content. You should be able to understand both the **technical and business side** of a product and turn complex topics into clear, engaging, and relevant content for B2B audiences.

You will create content for different stages of the B2B buyer journey, from building awareness and educating audiences to generating interest, supporting demand generation, and helping move prospects towards a buying decision.

The role also requires a good understanding of how B2B content is discovered and consumed through search engines, answer engines, and AI\-powered search.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand the client's business, products, services, technology, industry, customers, decision\-makers, competitors, positioning, and tone of voice.
* Research B2B industries, companies, technologies, and customer challenges to develop relevant content.
* Understand the client's target audience and create content around their business challenges, questions, pain points, and buying considerations.
* Write, edit, and manage technical and creative B2B content across different platforms and formats.
* Create blogs, website content, case studies, eBooks, whitepapers, reports, brochures, social media content, email content, video scripts, and other marketing and sales assets.
* Develop content ideas and recommendations based on business objectives, audience needs, industry trends, customer challenges, and search behaviour.
* Create content outlines and content plans for client and in\-house requirements.
* Develop thought leadership and research\-driven content for B2B technology audiences.
* Create content for different stages of the B2B buyer journey and support inbound marketing and demand generation campaigns.
* Adapt writing style, tone, messaging, and level of technical detail based on the client, industry, audience, and content format.
* Apply SEO best practices while developing content, including search intent, keyword usage, content structure, headings, internal linking, and long\-tail keywords.
* Understand AEO and how content can be structured to answer questions clearly and effectively.
* Understand how B2B audiences are increasingly discovering information through AI\-powered search and LLMs and apply relevant content practices.
* Review and improve existing content based on relevance, readability, search intent, and audience engagement.
* Edit, proofread, fact\-check, and quality check content before delivery.
* Work with subject matter experts, clients, Account Managers, SEO, Design, and other internal teams to develop the required content.
* Ensure content is original, well researched, factually accurate, and aligned with the client's business and marketing objectives.
* Use AI tools where appropriate to support research, brainstorming, information gathering, editing, and improving productivity and speed.
* Take ownership of content deliverables and ensure they are completed within agreed timelines.
* Stay updated on B2B industries, technology, content marketing, SEO, search trends, and new content formats.

**Requirements**

* 2 to 6 years of relevant experience in B2B content writing, technical writing, technology content, or a similar role.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to create both technical and creative B2B content.
* Ability to understand technology, business concepts, products, and services and explain them in simple, clear, and engaging language.
* Strong understanding of B2B audiences, decision\-makers, buying journeys, and business challenges.
* Strong research skills and the ability to quickly understand new industries, technologies, products, and businesses.
* Good understanding of B2B content marketing and inbound marketing.
* Good understanding of SEO, search intent, keyword research, and content optimization.
* Working knowledge of AEO and awareness of AI\-powered search and LLM\-based content discovery.
* Ability to create content that is optimized for search without compromising creativity, readability, or the reader's experience.
* Excellent grammar, editing, proofreading, and communication skills.
* Ability to write in different styles, from technical and informative to creative, conversational, and thought leadership content.
* Good command of US and British English.
* Ability to manage multiple client projects and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Self\-motivated, curious, and willing to learn new industries and technologies.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of work.
* Experience writing for SaaS, IT Services, Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Telecom, Healthcare, ERP, FinTech, or similar B2B industries is preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating technical, creative, B2B, or thought leadership content is preferred.

**Tools \& Platforms**

Familiarity with the following is preferred:

* **Content \& Research:** Google Search, Google Trends, keyword research and content research tools
* **SEO \& Content Optimization:** Semrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools
* **Content Management:** WordPress or other CMS platforms
* **AI Tools:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar tools for research, brainstorming, information gathering, editing, and improving productivity
* **Collaboration:** Google Docs, Google Sheets, and similar tools

AI tools should be used as a **supporting tool for research, speed, and efficiency**, not as a replacement for independent thinking, research, or writing. Strong writing ability, research skills, and subject understanding are essential.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who can **understand technology, think from a B2B customer's perspective, and write content that is both technically sound and creatively engaging.**

Someone who can take a complex product, understand why it matters to the customer's business, identify what the audience needs to know, and turn it into content that educates, engages, builds credibility, and supports the client's marketing goals.

**Salary:** Industry Standards

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

* How many years of experience do you have in B2B content writing?
* Do you have experience writing technical content for technology, SaaS, IT Services, or other B2B companies?
* Do you have hands\-on experience writing blogs, whitepapers, eBooks, case studies, website content, or other B2B marketing content?

description:
**About Navtech**

Navaratan Technologies (Navtech) is a B2B enterprise AI company founded in 2013\. It is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, with its delivery hub in Hyderabad, and serves 300\+ clients across 11 countries.

Navtech builds agentic AI platforms for banking and financial services. It is recognized as a Gartner Sample Vendor in the enterprise agentic AI landscape.

**Role summary**

You will build and run Navtech's demand generation engine for US mid\-market banks, credit unions, and financial services firms. You'll use Navtech's marketing collateral across email, LinkedIn, paid media, and events to generate qualified sales meetings and measurable pipeline for the banking sales team.

This is not a cold\-calling or closing role. You own the top of the funnel and hand qualified meetings to sales.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Targeting and segmentation.** Define and maintain the target account list, for example community and regional banks of roughly $1B–$20B in assets, credit unions, and specialty lenders. Map buying committees such as the CIO/CTO, COO, Chief Digital Officer, Head of Retail Banking, and Head of Risk.
* **Email campaigns.** Plan and run multi\-touch outbound and nurture sequences that hold up for a banking audience. Manage domain health, deliverability, and CAN\-SPAM compliance.
* **LinkedIn.** Run Navtech's company page content calendar for BFSI. Build thoughtleadership posts for leadership profiles. Run Sales Navigator\-driven outreach programs.
* **Paid media.** Plan, launch, and optimize LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads campaigns aimed at target accounts. Own budget, cost per lead, and cost per meeting.
* **Events.** Identify and plan participation in US banking events, such as ICBA Capital Summit, ABA conferences, BAI Beacon, Finovate, Money20/20, and state banking association meetings. Run webinars and virtual roundtables. Handle pre\-event outreach and post\-event follow\-up.
* **Collateral use.** Turn existing case studies, product pages, and decks into campaign assets like one\-pagers, email copy, ad creative briefs, and landing pages, working with the designer, content writer, and web developer.
* **Lead qualification and handoff.** Agree lead stages (MQL to SQL) with sales, qualify inbound and campaign responses, and book meetings for the banking sales team.
* **Reporting.** Track and report weekly on the funnel: reach, engagement, MQLs, meetings booked, sales\-accepted leads, pipeline value, and channel ROI.

**Success metrics (first 6–12 months)**

* Qualified meetings per month accepted by the banking sales team (target set jointly with sales)
* Pipeline value sourced by marketing
* Cost per qualified meeting, by channel
* Growth in engagement from target accounts, measured by account coverage and multi\-contact engagement

**Requirements**

* 5–8 years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, with at least 3 years targeting US buyers
* Hands\-on experience running email, LinkedIn (organic and paid), Google Ads, and event campaigns end to end
* Working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation tools (HubSpot or Salesforce), data tools (Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar), and LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Campaign Manager
* Strong written English suited to senior US financial services executives

title: Director, Segment Marketing
description:
Overview:

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
Our 1,300\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products \- ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **What We’re Looking For:**  

Role Type: High\-Impact Individual Contributor  

Target Experience: Former Top\-Tier Management Consultants (McKinsey, Bain, BCG / MBB). Worked for or in Manufacturing.  

Travel: International travel required (\~10%–15% to the US and Germany for key events, market immersion, and strategic sessions)  

Are you currently an Engagement Manager, Project Leader, or Case Team Leader at an MBB firm who loves strategic problem\-solving and wants to build and execute directly?  

  

This is not a traditional corporate marketing role, nor is it a high\-level advisory role where you hand off execution to others. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will lead segment marketing for our largest and most critical vertical across the United States and Germany.  

  

You will own strategy, message development, budget allocation, and full\-funnel execution. With a direct line to executive leadership and targeted on\-the\-ground presence in key markets, this role offers immersive, multi\-disciplinary exposure to every modern go\-to\-market lever, combining strategic ownership with hands\-on execution.
Principal Responsibilities:* Strategic Ownership: Function as the single point of accountability for growth, positioning, and pipeline creation in the US and German manufacturing segments, reporting performance directly to the CMO.
* Budget \& ROI: Define, allocate, and manage the segment marketing budget, optimizing for conversion rates, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and pipeline efficiency.
* Market \& Buyer Intelligence: Develop deep expertise in manufacturing buyer personas, supply chain complexities, and direct spend procurement dynamics.
* Messaging, Positioning \& Web Presence: Craft high\-converting value propositions, differentiation frameworks, and campaign messaging tailored to manufacturing executives in the US and Germany. Directly write, update, and optimize website landing pages and web copy (supported by central web/design teams for publishing).
* Hands\-On Campaign Execution \& Field Presence: Events \& Field Marketing: Evaluate, select, and manage presence at key US and European manufacturing industry events—including traveling on\-site (\~10%–15%) to represent JAGGAER and engage directly with prospects and customers. Email Campaigns: Strategy, copywriting, segmentation, and deployment of targeted email sequences. Webinars \& Content: Conceptualize, script, host, and drive audience acquisition for high\-value webinars. Paid Ads: Manage targeted digital ad campaigns across LinkedIn, search, and trade media.


While you will leverage central specialized resources (e.g., website managers pushing code live, creative design support), you retain full end\-to\-end ownership and accountability for execution. **Success in this Position:*** Strategic ownership for growth, positioning, and pipeline creation across the US and German manufacturing segments.
* Effective budget allocation and measurable ROI across full\-funnel marketing activities.
* Strong market and buyer insight translated into compelling messaging and hands\-on campaign execution.


Position Requirements:

Must Have:* Top\-Tier Consulting Background: 3\+ years at a top management consulting firm (McKinsey, Bain, BCG). You have proven problem\-solving horsepower, business acumen, and structured analytical skills.
* Manufacturing Experience: Experience working for, with, or advising organizations in Manufacturing.
* Global Mobility: Willingness and ability to travel internationally (\~10%–15%) to Germany and the United States for critical industry events, market immersion, team syncs, and field execution.

  

Nice to Have:* Strategic \& Operational Drive: Eager to trade high\-level strategic advisory work for direct execution ownership and real operational impact.
* Exceptional Communication \& Copywriting: Strong ability to translate complex software solutions into clear, compelling messaging for C\-level executives.
* Grit \& Ownership Mindset: Highly autonomous self\-starter who thrives on accountability and multi\-disciplinary execution.

 **What We Offer:**
  

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. **Our Values \- T.E.A.M:**  

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.  

  

* **Transparency** \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit** – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* **Accountability** – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* **Metrics\-Driven Results** – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. **Great Place to Work® Certified 2026 – JAGGAER**

We are proud to announce that **JAGGAER has been certified as a Great Place to Work® for 2026**, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high\-performing culture.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
Performance Marketing Executive — Meta \& Google Ads

About the role

Kritsnam builds smart water\-metering and management solutions. We are hiring a hands\-on Performance Marketing Executive to run Meta and Google Ads campaigns for our Dhaara products.

You will work directly with the founder, who provides marketing strategy, creative direction, audience inputs and budget approvals. Your responsibility is to execute accurately, monitor performance and turn campaign data into useful recommendations.

Set up and manage Meta and Google Ads campaigns using approved creatives, audiences and budgets.

Monitor daily spending, campaign delivery, ad approvals, landing\-page links and lead flow.

Manage audience lists, lookalike audiences and remarketing using approved customer data.

Review Google search terms and maintain relevant negative keywords.

Run structured tests of creatives, audiences and ad copy; document changes and results.

Maintain a clear dashboard connecting ad spend to leads, qualified enquiries, quotations and sales.

Coordinate with the sales team to understand lead quality and closure outcomes.

Recommend what to scale, pause or improve, with supporting data.

Check conversion tracking and flag technical issues promptly.

What we are looking for

Practical experience using Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads—not only social\-media posting or boosting posts.

Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and interpreting campaign performance.

Understands CPC, CTR, CPL, conversion rate and customer acquisition cost.

Basic familiarity with Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, UTM tracking and conversion events.

Strong attention to detail, numerical ability and disciplined follow\-through.

Willingness to learn the product and understand why leads do—or do not—become customers.

Experience with lead\-generation campaigns or physical products is a plus. Relevant internships and freelance campaign experience count.

How success will be measured

Accurate execution, controlled spending, reliable reporting, better\-qualified enquiries and contribution to sales—not simply more clicks or cheaper leads.

Pay: Up to ₹800,000\.00 per year

Experience:

* Google Ad Manager: 5 years (Required)
* Metadata: 5 years (Required)

description:

**Description**


Associate Director (Deal management products\- Salesforce/Oracle APEX)
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

* Manage Product Managers and UX Designers, onshore and offshore, including line management, performance management, professional development, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Own a discipline within the department and manage a global team.
* Lead creation of the overall product vision and roadmap in partnership with leadership.
* Establish a cohesive product strategy and roadmap across proposal, pricing, and contracting technologies, while directly owning one or more complex products.
* Translate and prioritize business needs into technical and analytical requirements, product requirements, user stories, and measurable outcomes.
* Oversee prioritization of product features, modifications, attributes, and backlogs, and communicate priorities to development teams.
* Partner with data scientists and engineers on requirements, statements of work, budget estimates, scope, timelines, and supplier line\-ups.
* Identify unresolved business needs with internal and external clients and use them to guide product strategy.
* Drive product strategy, discovery, business\-case development, delivery, adoption, and value realization.
* Lead process standardization and technology adoption across businesses, functions, and geographies.
* Manage vendors, implementation partners, budgets, contracts, and product evaluations.
* Build strong relationships across Sales, Proposal Management, Pricing, Legal, Finance, Operations, Data, Technology, and external partners.
* Coach and develop Product Managers, set objectives, review roadmaps, delegate effectively, and establish consistent product\-management standards.
* Clearly communicate technical concepts to non\-technical clients and stakeholders and facilitate collaboration across teams.

**Experience Requirements**
===========================

* 6\+ years of product management experience in deal\-management technology within an enterprise sales setting, including proposal, pricing, and contracting technologies.
* Preferred industry experience: pharmaceutical services, CRO, or equivalent.
* Experience managing enterprise products through strategy, discovery, business\-case development, delivery, adoption, and value realization.
* People\-management experience including coaching Product Managers, setting objectives, reviewing roadmaps, performance management, and talent development. The base JD specifies 1\-2 years; the additional role notes call for 2\+ years.
* Experience owning a portfolio of interconnected products while directly managing one or more complex products.
* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end deal lifecycle: opportunity qualification, proposal/RFP development, solutioning, pricing, approvals, contracting, negotiation, signature, and handoff.
* Experience integrating proposal, pricing, and contracting products with CRM, finance, legal, data, and delivery systems.
* Demonstrated success improving deal velocity, proposal quality, pricing discipline, contract cycle time, win rate, margin, or user productivity.
* Experience leading process standardization and technology adoption across multiple businesses, functions, or geographies.
* Experience managing vendors, implementation partners, budgets, contracts, and product evaluations.
* Experience in a complex or regulated professional\-services environment is preferred.

**Relevant Enterprise Platforms**
---------------------------------

* Proposal and RFP management tools such as Qvidian or QorusDocs.
* Pricing, CPQ, or deal\-desk solutions; experience with a custom/homegrown pricing solution is preferred.
* Contract lifecycle management and electronic\-signature platforms; Adobe Sign preferred.
* Salesforce or another enterprise CRM.
* Document generation, content repositories, workflow, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Roadmap, issue, and backlog management systems such as Azure DevOps.
* Design tools such as Figma.

**Skills \& Capabilities**
==========================

* Ability to balance portfolio leadership, people management, and direct ownership of critical products.
* Strong product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, and value\-measurement capabilities.
* Strong people leadership including coaching, delegation, performance management, and development of product\-management capabilities.
* Strong understanding of deal\-management processes, approval controls, commercial risk, pricing governance, and contract compliance.
* Technical fluency in enterprise architecture, integrations, APIs, data models, document automation, workflow automation, analytics, and generative AI.
* Understanding of business intelligence strategy and/or data science and engineering workflows, database concepts and architecture, and common analytic languages such as Python, R, Scala, or Java.
* Ability to evaluate configuration, custom development, automation, and vendor\-product options.
* Strong business\-case development, financial analysis, benefits measurement, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership skills.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong change\-management skills covering communications, training, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Sound judgment regarding confidential deal information, access controls, privacy, responsible AI, and regulatory requirements.

**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Summary**


The Technology \& Data Solutions (TDS) business unit is the Syneos Health accelerator for life sciences innovation. TDS houses advanced technology acquisitions, homegrown products and applications, actively participates in new M\&A and partnership activities, delivers critical insights as part of our integrated strategy for customers, and drives enterprise\-wide adoption and change management for innovative technology and data solutions. Our work supports getting meaningful new medicines to patients faster, with greater positive impact. The Associate Director, Product Management supports business goals by partnering with engineers and developers to develop repeatable, production\-level tools for customers and their needs. For this position, the leader will combine portfolio and product ownership across deal\-management technologies with direct people leadership.

title: Lead Technology Business Systems Consultant
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Technology Business System Consultant  



  

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead complex initiatives to provide technological solutions with broad impact for cross functional businesses and technology teams
* Act as a key participant in providing strategic business solutions to companywide technology initiatives
* Evaluate highly complex business problems and provide subject matter knowledge proficiency for technology initiatives
* Define and lead detailed research on business and technology requests to develop efficient and accurate functional requirements
* Make decisions in highly complex and multifaceted situations requiring solid understanding of domain and technology applications, and which influence companywide technology solutions
* Lead project or systems documentation, and monitor and manage project schedules and deliverables
* Collaborate and consult with business and technology teams to provide comprehensive technological solutions for complex business problems
* Ensure communication and information flow between business and technology teams

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Business Systems Data and Business Systems Designing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Required Qualifications for Europe, Middle East \& Africa only:**

* Experience in Business Systems Data and Business Systems Designing, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* **Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy \& Ownership**
	+ Define, manage, and execute the nCino/Salesforce Integration product roadmap aligned with business and transformation objectives.
	+ Lead product discovery, requirements elicitation, and business process analysis to identify opportunities for platform enhancement and operational efficiency.
	+ Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into product capabilities and actionable delivery plans.
	+ Drive product decisions, prioritization, and trade\-off discussions to maximize business value.
* **Requirements \& Solution Management**
	+ Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, process flows, and solution specifications.
	+ Translate business needs into well\-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized product backlogs.
	+ Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and vendor teams to design scalable and sustainable integration solutions.
* **Integration \& Data Management**
	+ Lead analysis and delivery of integrations across nCino, Salesforce, Risk, CRM, and other enterprise platforms.
	+ Perform data profiling, analysis, and validation activities across legacy and upstream systems.
	+ Define and validate Source\-to\-Target Mapping (STM) requirements to support integration and data migration initiatives.
	+ Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with enterprise governance standards.
* **Agile Delivery Leadership**
	+ Own backlog management, sprint planning, release planning, and product prioritization activities.
	+ Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and stakeholder demonstrations.
	+ Manage risks, dependencies, and impediments to ensure timely delivery against roadmap commitments.
	+ Coordinate cross\-functional teams to drive successful execution of product initiatives.
* **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, and external integration partners.
	+ Build strong stakeholder relationships and ensure alignment on priorities, scope, and delivery expectations.
	+ Communicate roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership and key stakeholders.
* **Testing, Release \& Adoption**
	+ Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including test planning, business validation, defect triage, and issue resolution.
	+ Support release planning, production deployment, and post\-implementation stabilization activities.
	+ Partner with business teams to drive user adoption and ensure successful realization of business outcomes.
* **Analytics \& Continuous Improvement**
	+ Utilize SQL and SOQL to perform data analysis, validation, and reporting.
	+ Develop insights and reporting solutions to support data\-driven decision\-making.
	+ Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, operational effectiveness, and data quality.
	+ Leverage AI\-enabled tools responsibly to enhance analysis, documentation, reporting, and productivity.

 **Job Expectations:**

* Proven experience working on nCino and Salesforce platform implementation, integration, and transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Senior Business Analyst within Agile delivery environments.
* Deep understanding of Commercial Lending, Risk Management, CRM, and Banking Operations.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, data migration, and Source\-to\-Target Mapping methodologies.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and SOQL for data analysis and validation.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and influence outcomes across cross\-functional teams.

**Required AI Skills \& Competencies**

* + Ability to effectively leverage AI tools for research, analysis, documentation, reporting, and productivity enhancement.
	+ Strong critical\-thinking skills with the ability to validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy and business relevance.
	+ Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, governance, and ethical use.
	+ Continuous learning mindset with the ability to adopt emerging technologies and innovative ways of working.

**Desired Qualifications**

* + nCino and/or Salesforce certifications.
	+ Agile certifications such as CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, or equivalent.
	+ Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation and modernization programs.
	+ Strong background in integration platforms, API\-enabled ecosystems, and enterprise product delivery.
	+ Experience with reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives.
	+ Experience supporting UAT, release management, and production deployment activities.
	+ Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Draw.io.
	+ Strong attention to detail with a focus on data quality and operational excellence.
	+ Ability to communicate complex business and technical concepts to diverse stakeholder groups.
* **Success Measures**
	+ Successful delivery of nCino Integration and CRM Transformation roadmap commitments.
	+ Effective backlog management and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Posting End Date:**


29 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.


Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

title: Business Development Manager - Catering & Events
description:
CraftMyPlate is Hyderabad's go\-to platform for food experiences for micro\-events—house parties, birthdays, office celebrations, festive gatherings, and more. We are building the operating system for how India discovers, customises, and orders food for smaller events.

Started in Hyderabad and backed by established founders and investors, **CraftMyPlate is a funded, fast\-growing startup working at the intersection of food, technology, and consumer experience**. You will work closely with a sharp cross\-functional team across growth, product, operations, supply chain, and customer experience—and have a direct role in shaping how the business scales.

**Your Role**  
This is not a conventional banquet\-sales or "quotation\-and\-follow\-up" role. We're looking for someone who has run the sales and the operational side of catering or banquets at scale—someone who knows what it takes to close a booking, and equally, what it takes to execute a flawless event on the ground. You'll bring that dual lens to CraftMyPlate as we scale beyond micro\-events into larger catering and corporate/community occasions, and help us become the default choice for every event in Hyderabad, big or small.

**What You'll Own**

* Own high\-value and large\-scale catering conversations end\-to\-end—understanding occasion, guest count, budget, menu preferences, and timelines, and translating that into the right CraftMyPlate experience.
* Convert inbound and self\-sourced leads into confirmed bookings through sharp consultation, timely follow\-through, and confident closing—not just sending menus and waiting.
* Take ownership of execution readiness for larger events: coordinating with kitchen, catering ops, and on\-ground teams to make sure what's sold gets delivered without surprises.
* Build and manage a disciplined pipeline across corporate, community, RWA, and repeat/referral catering opportunities—no missed follow\-ups, no leads without context.
* Bring your hospitality and banquet background into the room—identify what corporate and large\-event clients actually expect, and push CraftMyPlate's offering to match and exceed those standards.
* Feed real customer and on\-ground insights back to founders, product, and ops teams—what large clients ask for, where deals stall, what makes an event succeed or fail operationally.
* Explore new channels for larger bookings: corporate tie\-ups, event planners, banquet/venue partnerships, and community networks.
* Own your numbers: pipeline value, conversion rate, average order value, repeat and referral rate, and revenue contribution from larger accounts.

**What We're Looking For**

* Someone who has actually run banquet or large\-scale catering sales and operations—not someone who has only sold, or only executed, but someone who has done both and understands how the two connect.
* A person who is sharp and street\-smart in conversations, builds client trust quickly, and can read a room—whether it's a corporate client, an event planner, or a family hosting a large celebration.
* Someone who has outgrown the structure of a traditional hotel or banquet hall and is actively looking for a bigger, less bounded role with more ownership and faster growth.
* A strong sense of ownership—if a large event has a gap, a client has a concern, or an opportunity needs chasing, you take it to closure without waiting to be told.
* Someone comfortable with targets, ambiguity, and the pace of an early\-stage startup—this is a very different environment from a hotel banquet department, and we want someone who's ready for that shift, not intimidated by it.
* A person who wants to build a long\-term career in business, growth, or hospitality\-meets\-consumer\-tech, and sees this as a launchpad rather than a lateral move.

**Skills \& Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in banquet sales, catering sales, hotel operations, or event/hospitality management, with clear exposure to both closing business and executing on\-ground.
* A degree in Hotel Management or Hospitality is required; prior experience working in hotels, banquet halls, or large catering operations is a must.
* Proven track record of handling large\-scale catering or banquet operations—guest counts, vendor coordination, event\-day execution—not just small or one\-off orders.
* Fluency in Telugu is mandatory for this role. Excellent spoken and written English \& Hindi are strong advantages.
* Comfortable speaking with clients over phone, WhatsApp, and in person, including site visits and on\-ground event coordination when required.
* Experience using a CRM or managing structured lead and event pipelines is preferred.
* Ability to read basic sales and ops data and sharpen your own performance through disciplined execution.
* Based in Hyderabad or willing to work from Hyderabad.

**What This Role Is Not**

* It is not a traditional banquet\-hall or hotel sales role with fixed scripts, fixed packages, and slow\-moving approvals.
* It is not a role limited to sending menus and quotations and waiting for a client to decide.
* It is not suitable for someone who needs daily instructions to manage priorities, follow\-ups, or event execution.
* It is not a narrowly defined, hierarchy\-heavy corporate hospitality role.

At CraftMyPlate, you will learn directly from people building a category\-defining company, work with talented teams across functions, and see a clear, fast connection between your work and the company's growth.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* What is your current/most\-recent CTC Annually?(In Lakhs)

Experience:

* Sales: 4 years (Required)
* Catering/Banquet Sales: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* Telugu (Required)

Location:

* Hyderabad, Telangana (Required)

 We are hiring a growth\-focused ecommerce leader for a premium fashion brand scaling aggressively in the US market.
 



 This is not a traditional digital marketing role. We are looking for a commercially minded operator who understands how to build and scale high\-AOV D2C brands by integrating performance marketing, retention, ecommerce, CRO, brand storytelling, and customer experience into one cohesive growth engine.
 



 You will work directly with founders and leadership to drive revenue growth, improve customer acquisition efficiency, strengthen retention systems, and scale the brand internationally.

* Shopify / Shopify Plus ecosystem management
* Email \& SMS lifecycle programs through platforms like Klaviyo
* Attribution, analytics, and growth reporting

* Scaling the brand across US and international markets

* Experience managing Meta and Google Ads at meaningful scale
* Strong lifecycle and retention marketing experience (email, SMS, CRM)
* Deep understanding of MER, CAC, LTV, attribution, and profitability metrics

title: Zonal Analyst
description:
**OVERALL PURPOSE OF THE JOB** 




  





 Contribute to business growth of the zone through accurate business and financial analysis, pricing strategy, budgeting and performance reporting. Formulate a robust business plan and strategy achieving the operational effectiveness and business objectives of the zone
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





 Strategy Formulation
 


* Contribute towards formulation of business plan and sales strategy for the zone in line with company’s vision and stated objectives.
* Manage the annual budgeting and forecasting exercise for each market in the Zone and ensure the budget is in line with strategic plan in terms of volume, market share and segment size
* Develop financial intelligence metrics to monitor and measure the qualitative aspects of the company’s operations.
* Conduct profitability analysis, route to market analysis and projections, implement cost saving initiatives etc; consolidate and analyze results, prepare and present results to the Zonal Head. Use the analysis to define and drive actions/initiatives to improve Sales performance from a Zonal perspective
* Help the Zonal Head take strategic decisions by conducting deep dive business analysis on competitor strategies, changes in competitor pricing, market segmentation and trends. Suggest effective counter measures and evaluate pricing scenarios for each market, keeping in mind the market dynamics as well as the local \[and if applicable, interstate] duty structures.
* Dynamically assess and advise the course correction required in execution of strategy when business is impacted by price change, taxation change, competition brand launches, supply bottlenecks and other market variables.



  





 Pricing and policies
 


* Define pricing strategies by analyzing market opportunities in line with projected segment growth in brand volumes as well as profit.
* identify opportunities across markets \- Markets with higher margins, shift to SKUs with higher margins, launch of additional SKUs for specific brands, launch new products, etc. to achieve strategic / annual deliverables
* Work closely with the regional teams in developing a comprehensive understanding of the local excise and sales tax policy framework for each of the markets in the Zone, ensure the compliance of the PRIPL brand pricing with the local state laws
* To evaluate proposed cost cards for each brand and ensure all cost cards for the Zone are prepared, updated and approved by HO Planning
* Compile a comprehensive and updated database of brand ECP / EDP for all the markets \[with competition pricing] in the Zone and use the same as a base for pricing decisions. Also ensure accurate and adequate MIS on any change in competition price positioning or sourcing



  





 Operational Excellence
 


* Proactively provide valid business data to sales team to ensure they understand the financial impact of their decision making and thereby impact operational excellence. Provide information and analysis of operational metrics, develop improvement goals to influence and direct focus towards operational targets that drive value orientation.



  





 Dashboards and Business Performance reporting
 


* Develop and own performance management matrix and dashboards on trends, gaps, shortfalls etc to help support Sales team on an ongoing basis for effective business focus. Share best practices been zones to ensure consistency of approach.
* Review and analyze the brand volumes, market share and P\&L as well as the expenses in all markets in the Zone, on a monthly basis; forecast likely issues or concerns and suggest course corrections
* To consolidate the LEs for all regions in the Zone and get the same validated by the Zonal Head prior to submission to HO Planning.



  





 Stewardship
 


* To be a key contributor in the overall Zonal effectiveness on corporate governance. Assist in creating the IT road map of the organization.



  





**KEY INTERFACE** 




  





 INTERNAL
 



 Sales and Marketing Team Finance Team Planning Team
 



  





 KEY PERFORMANCE INDEX \-
 



  





 Planning
 


* Annual budget evaluations for every market in the zone
* Segment size and targeted market share projections
* Review volumes and market share and project risks



  





 Pricing and policy
 


* Define pricing strategy
* Identify new SKU opportunities



  





 Analysis and Reporting
 



  




* Analysis of P\&L and variance
* Analyze monthly volume, market share and segment size and reporting thereof.
* NPD pricing and market share analysis
* analyze stock in trade and suggest optimum level thereof.



  





**JOB REQUIREMENTS** 




  





 QUALIFICATIONS:
 



 MBA (Finance), CA/ CS
 



  





 EXPERIENCE
 



  




* 8\-10 years of total experience within the FMCG industry with sizable amount of experience in a large sized multinational company
* At least 5 years experience in business and financial analysis with ability to forecast market trends, analyze market data and see the bigger picture
* Hands\-on experience on MS\- Office advance tools, SQL Server 2005 and Research databases
* A result oriented business professional with a successful track record in the areas of business and financial analysis, financial support to Operations and strategic support to sales and marketing.
* High levels of accuracy and attention to detail, ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines

title: Marketing Manager (Product Owner-Web Experience)
description:
Our Senior Product Owner is a lead role within our Web Experience team, as the primary owner of our website development strategy across a growing group of sites including HERE.com, plus our Japan and Legal sites. Within our multi\-discipline team, you’ll be responsible for defining and executing our site experience roadmap that will solve our user’s needs, create a pathway to HERE platform sign\-ups and deliver against our core website KPIs. You will work closely with colleagues across Infrastructure, User Experience and Content, as well as stakeholders in the Marketing, Product and Technology organizations, with a key focus on cross\-functional collaboration to deliver against aligned strategic business goals.
 



  





 In addition, you’ll be responsible for planning and overseeing our in\-house team’s resource allocation and quality of output to ensure delivery of a a competitive and effective product as our flagship website. From research to product development, you’ll build consensus, solicit feedback, manage ticketed progress and negotiate priorities with all levels of stakeholders as you plan and execute for best practice digital experience.
 



  





 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
 


* Oversee the development and delivery of our annual strategic roadmap to achieve our vision for growth as a multi\-audience destination website that helps visitors understand who HERE is, the problems HERE solves and experience easy access to our GTM strategy options from sales engagement to self\-service.
* Use your in\-depth expertise to build improved understanding of the here.com roadmap by being the lead communicator of key delivered milestones that reflect optimized experience, and improved engagement and conversion, from multiple target audiences. This includes supporting growth in discovery, lead generation, platform sign\-ups and thought leadership engagement.
* Define, prioritize, and oversee the execution of Web Experience roadmap. Manage sprint planning and ticket creation, sprint demos, BDD (Behavior\-Driven Development) workflows, UAT, and releases in conjunction with internal developers using Jira and GitLab.
* Oversee sprint planning \& management (including sprint demos, UAT, releases) by engaging with Web Experience colleagues before planning work in Jira and running regular check\-ins.
* Identify, understand and communicate user’s pain points, translating them into roadmapped activities that improve user experience, site performance and achieve agreed here.com KPIs.
* Ensure consistency, quality, and scalability of our global website CMS, Contentful. Demonstrable in\-depth experience with Contentful CMS is required to steer the ongoing development of our composable web architecture. You also need strong conceptual understanding of modern front\-end frameworks (React, Next.js) and cloud deployments (Vercel, AWS).
* Deep knowledge of Agile/Scrum principles and Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) is required. Expert in using JIRA and Confluence to create, manage, and triage complex backlogs.
* work with Performance and in\-house development colleagues to utilize analytics, research and digital best\-practice approaches to simplify core user journeys.
* work with Web Infrastructure colleagues to identify opportunities to utilize the Martech stack to improve experience and gain customer insight – i.e. website personalization, A/B testing, etc.
* direct a data\-led approach (utilizing reporting and insights) to optimize user journeys and site experience by channel source (SEO, PPC, Paid Media).
* Solid understanding of enterprise MarTech stacks, specifically Adobe Analytics, Tealium Tag Management, Marketo, and enterprise search solutions (e.g., Algolia) and how they contribute to a data\-driven experience.
* Solve unique problems from a web experience perspective including development, workflow and technical considerations, anchored by a thorough understanding of the broad impact on related disciplines and business performance.
* Develop com product strategy for project execution, managing notable risk and complexity with foresight and your digital expertise.
* Anticipate business, regulatory and performance issues; recommending product, process or service improvements

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable identifying conversion opportunities through data, improving the customer journey, managing Shopify operations, and working with creative, marketing and development teams to execute changes.

The objective of the role is simple: continuously improve the website experience while driving conversion, revenue, average order value and customer lifetime value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Shopify \& Website Management**

* Identify and resolve website, checkout, navigation and UX issues.
* Work with developers and external partners on theme improvements, integrations and technical requirements.
* Evaluate Shopify apps and integrations, ensuring they add measurable value without compromising site performance.

**E\-commerce Growth \& Conversion Optimisation**

* Develop and execute a continuous CRO roadmap across the website.

* Identify friction points and opportunities to improve conversion.

* Optimise PDPs, collection pages, navigation, search, cart and checkout experience.

* Revenue
* Conversion Rate
* Average Order Value
* Revenue per Visitor
* Add\-to\-Cart Rate
* Checkout Conversion
* Customer Acquisition Cost
* Customer Lifetime Value
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* Use Shopify analytics, GA4 and other reporting tools to identify trends and opportunities.

* Analyse performance by geography, channel, product, collection and customer segment.

**Digital Merchandising**

**Job Title: Senior Product Manager**





 This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2\-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.
   

  






**About SailPoint**





 SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less. Built on a foundation of AI and ML, our Identity Security Cloud Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time—matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud\-oriented, modern enterprise.
   

  






**About the role**

As a Senior Product Manager on our newly formed shared services team, you will play a vital role in shaping the future of our platform by contributing directly to SailPoint's vision for shared capabilities. Your day\-to\-day will involve shepherding innovative micro\-services and SaaS platform connectivity technologies from discovery to release. You will act as the strategic link between Product Management, Design, and Engineering to conceptualize, design, and deliver high\-quality, scalable foundational services that directly power the entire SailPoint product portfolio in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

We partner with internal and external stakeholders to uncover real challenges, ideate alongside cross\-functional partners, and deliver elegant solutions that make a meaningful impact. title: Customer Experience Process Expert 1
description:
**Shape the Future with Us.**
 At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.
   

  

 As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact \- on your career, your community, and the world around you.
   

  

 The Global Business Process Expert (BPX) is accountable for designing, standardizing, and evolving the end\-to\-end Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) event\-driven operating model. This role plays a critical part in a multi\-year transformation to shift from traditional order entry to a proactive, exception\-based customer service model enabled by automation, advanced workflows, and AI\-driven insights.
   

  

 The Global BPE partners closely with the Global Process Owner to define new ways of working that fundamentally change how work is performed, introducing event orchestration, touchless order processing, and real\-time intervention capabilities. This includes designing global standards, governance frameworks, and scalable process models that drive consistency across regions while improving service reliability, speed, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 To ensure these standards remain relevant and effective, the Global BPX actively incorporates feedback from Regional BPXs into the evolution of global standards. This role combines process design, transformation execution, and technology enablement, ensuring that future\-state processes are not only well\-defined but also practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Process Design \& Transformation**
* Design and document future\-state O2C processes, emphasizing event\-driven orchestration and exception\-based execution.
* Embed new ways of working that shift teams from transactional processing to proactive event management.
* Set global standards for touchless order processing, intelligent exception handling, and consistent customer outcomes.


**Event \& Exception Framework**
* Develop and maintain a global event taxonomy (e.g., order failures, credit blocks, supply and delivery risks).
* Define event triggers, thresholds, prioritization logic, and escalation paths to enable timely intervention.
* Create standardized response playbooks to ensure consistent issue handling and resolution across regions.


**Technology \& Digital Enablement**
* Partner with IT and transformation teams to enable processes through ERP, CRM, and workflow platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Dynamics 365\).
* Support the implementation of case management, automated workflows, and real\-time alerting to manage exceptions at scale.
* Contribute to AI and analytics use cases that improve visibility, predict risk, and enable proactive issue resolution.


**Governance \& Global Alignment**
* Establish governance frameworks that drive adherence to global process standards and controls.
* Align Regional BPEs to common methodologies, artifacts, and practices to ensure consistent execution across regions.
* Serve as a central point of expertise for process design decisions, trade\-offs, and standard interpretations.


**Performance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define global KPIs (e.g., touchless rate, event resolution time, cycle time, cost\-to\-serve) and standard reporting definitions.
* Analyze cross\-regional performance trends to identify systemic issues, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase automation, reduce manual effort, and improve service reliability.


**Change \& Adoption Support**
* Support development of training materials, playbooks, and communications to enable adoption of new processes and tools.
* Partner with regional teams to drive readiness, deployment, and sustained adoption of standardized ways of working.
* Reinforce a culture of standardization, accountability, and continuous improvement across the O2C community.


**Requirements**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years Customer Experience, Order to Cash, or related roles, with global or multi\-region process leadership.
* 5\+ years of experience leading or coordinating global process improvement or governance initiatives.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with SAP Order\-to\-Cash modules in a global context.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong project management and process governance skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
* Ability to drive global standardization and harmonization.
* Analytical mindset with expertise in continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI).


**Considered a Plus**
* Knowledge of Lubrizol’s global product portfolio and international regulatory environments.
* Experience working in a highly matrixed, multinational organization.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or APICS certification.


**Travel**
