title: Product Development Lead, Grids of the Future
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 About the Global Energy Alliance
   

  

 The Global Energy Alliance (the Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

 Grids of the Future is GEA's programme for delivering abundant, reliable, and clean electricity across the Global South. In many emerging economies, the utilities that supply most electricity are held back by aging infrastructure, underinvestment, and a lack of reliable data. Efforts to modernize often remain stuck in isolated pilots rather than reaching the whole grid. The programme works in close partnership with utilities, governments, regulators, and innovators. It supports grid digitalization, the integration of renewables and battery storage, greater demand flexibility, and a stronger network of local innovators. Together, these help emerging economies move from aging, fossil fuel dependent grids to modern grids that are ready for renewable energy. The programme brings together the policy, regulatory, and delivery work that this transition depends on.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 The Product Development Lead will lead the full end to end Product lifecycle for the Open Source solutions/products being developed by Global Energy Alliance with its Alliance partners to ensure that the valuable work being carried out by GEA and other partners in the clean energy ecosystem is supported with the right technology tools.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The position leads the end to end development including clearly defining requirements, holding the schematics, managing the vendors and delivering to internal and external stakeholders. This is a critical role to manage the delivery of the technological infrastructure supporting GEA's global Grids of the Future programme.
   

  

 It supports the Grids of the Future teams across GEA's priority markets, including India, Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Africa. The work helps low\-and\-middle\-income countries modernize their grids and integrate large volumes of low\-cost renewable energy in a reliable and financially sustainable way. The role draws on product management experience in the technology field along with strong project management skills.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
**Lead End\-to\-End Product Lifecycle \& Technology Delivery**
* Lead the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of Grids of the Future (GOTF) digital and technological infrastructure products, translating programme goals into actionable product roadmaps, clear requirements, schematics, and functional specifications, feature releases.
* Oversee the development, testing, and deployment of technology tools, incorporating AI\-powered development, tools, and rollouts to ensure digital solutions meet rigorous standards for Utility and partner deployment. Must be fluent with Open Source Software development.
* Design product requirement documents in conjunction with the GOTF architecture team


**Vendor Management, Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Manage technology vendors and external development partners throughout the project lifecycle, enforcing strict quality control, version control, risk management, and service\-level agreements.
* Oversee technical schematics, architectural frameworks, and project documentation to ensure software and digital tools are scalable, secure, interoperable, and aligned with utility operating environments.
* Maintain comprehensive project management governance, proactively managing project timelines, budgets, multi\-stakeholder dependencies, and technical deliverables.


**Regional Execution, Stakeholder Alignment \& Utility Integration**
* Partner closely with regional and country\-level GOTF teams across GEAPP priority markets (India, Southeast Asia, Latin America \& the Caribbean, and Africa) to tailor product offerings to local grid contexts, regulatory frameworks, and market conditions.
* Hire Design Partners for deployment of the products and nurture relationships with the necessary stakeholders at the Design Partner sites.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners—including distribution utilities, system operators, regulators, and clean energy ecosystem innovators—to ensure digital products address operational pain points and enable demand flexibility.
* Provide technical guidance, training, and change management support to internal teams and utility counterparts to accelerate the adoption and institutionalisation of new digital grid solutions.


**Knowledge Sharing \& Continuous Product Innovation**
* Track emerging technological advancements, AI tools, and digital grid innovations across advanced and emerging power markets, channelling actionable insights to refine GEAPP's product portfolio.
* Establish product performance metrics and impact indicators to evaluate tool adoption, operational efficacy, and contribution to clean energy access and emissions reduction goals.


**Product release and evangelization**
* Lead Product release planning and execution with the communications team. Work as the single point of contact for the feature release calendar.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience**
 The ideal candidate would be a self\-starter and be willing to “roll up their sleeves” to adapt to working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
   

  

**Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience Include**
* At least 8 years of work experience as a Product Manager, developing for Power Sector.
* A minimum bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as technology, product design, business management; an engineering or renewable energy qualification will be a strong plus.
* FOSS development experience is a priority. Candidates with already committed projects will be preferred. Understanding of AI (LLMs, inference and coding tools) is a must have.
* Strong network and relationships with power sector stakeholders across one or more of GEA's priority markets; experience spanning both Global North and Global South power systems will be a strong advantage.
* Direct experience of working with AI powered development and roll out.
* Demonstrated commitment to working to improve the lives of others and to working in the impact sector.
* Willingness to travel internationally across GEA's priority markets for project execution, if required.


**Behavioural Competencies**
 The ideal candidate should be able to demonstrate the following:
   

  

* Sector knowledge: understanding of FOSS, AI tooling and delivering technology solutions to rigorous client standards. Experience with grid modernization, renewable energy integration, distribution and transmission systems, grid flexibility, and storage in the context of global south electricity sectors, including India is a plus.
* Experience of working with utilities: good understanding of utility operations, planning, and working mechanisms, including the institutional and political complexities of state\-owned distribution companies.
* Vendor management: a track record of delivering technology projects through vendors. High levels of attention to detail, version control, risk management and clear mapping of roles and responsibilities.
* Communication \& Presentation: excellent interpersonal abilities and listening skills; strong writing and presentation skills; able to present ideas to a range of stakeholders in a clear and compelling way.
* Project Execution: strong project management skills; meets deadlines; sense of urgency and responsibility; ability to multi\-task and work under pressure; detail oriented.


*We operate from a strong commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in everything we do. It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.*

To this end, the organization ensures equal opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, lawful alien status, physical, mental, and medical disability, veteran status, or liability for service in the United States Armed Forces.*

title: Lead Software Engineer - (Web Platform)
description:
**Lead Software Engineer (Web Platform)**



Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" – we continue to offer a full\-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise\-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog.



As a Senior II and Tech Lead for our Web Platform team, you will be responsible for leading the technical direction and supporting the engineering effort of a team focused on building and maintaining the core web application tooling and client services that support all of our web\-based clients. This includes our web application, Electron\-based desktop client, browser extension, and CLI, as well as other clients and additional Products in the future. You will be expected to own and understand the entirety of the team's domain, and be able to support the other engineers on the team as well as engage in well\-reasoned discussions with other technical leaders in the organization.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Update and maintain Bitwarden's web monorepo tooling, including our nx monorepo packaging infrastructure, our webpack build pipelines, and our npm package management systems.
* Drive repo\-wide modernization initiatives, such as migrating to Vite and pnpm or adopting nx, including any coordination with other teams within the organization.
* Work closely with your manager to maintain the technical roadmap for the team, ensuring that core platform dependencies are up to date and emerging technologies are considered for potential adoption.
* Unblock and support other engineers on the team.
* Collaborate with other Tech Leads to ensure that cross\-team technical direction is aligned when initiatives span team boundaries.
* Serve as a representative of the team in technical discussions and be able to speak authoritatively about your domain.
* Set the example for thorough code reviews, using them to spread knowledge on the team and ensure high standards for code quality.
* Occasionally review \& approve bug fixes submitted by the user community


**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**


* Expertise in modern web application build and packaging pipelines, including strong demonstrated experience with managing and updating nx, webpack, Vite, npm, and pnpm.
* Extensive experience with cross\-platform web application development \- understanding how to work within and support Electron environments and browser extensions and the limitations and nuances of their APIs.
* A bias for long\-horizon thinking, ensuring that decisions made today build stable and maintainable tooling for the future.
* Experience on a Platform team, where other teams are your customers, and you are responsible for ensuring that their feature development can be done with tooling as a support and not a hindrance.
* Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
* Collaborative and adaptable mindset
* Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution


**WHY WORK WITH US**


* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development.
* At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self\-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**



We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Senior Product Manager - Credit
description:
**The Impact You’ll Drive**
 We are seeking a
 *Senior Product Manager* 
 to own critical areas of our credit and banking platform. You will work across product strategy, customer discovery, platform design, and execution to build scalable financial infrastructure for banks, NBFCs, fintechs, and enterprises.
   

  

*The Hats You Will Wear*
* Own product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for one or more areas of the platform.
* Build and evolve products across Credit Cards, Credit Lines, BNPL, Lending, Embedded Credit, Payments, and Banking Infrastructure.
* Design configurable workflows across onboarding, underwriting, decisioning, billing, repayments, collections, reconciliation, and settlement.
* Work directly with banks, NBFCs, fintechs, and enterprise customers to understand requirements and translate them into scalable platform capabilities.
* Partner with engineering, design, risk, compliance, operations, and implementation teams to take products from discovery to production and scale.
* Define APIs, workflows, rules, configurations, integrations, and data models in collaboration with engineering.
* Identify common customer requirements and turn them into reusable platform capabilities rather than bespoke solutions.
* Define product metrics and use customer feedback and data to drive continuous improvement.
* Make product trade\-offs across customer needs, business impact, technical complexity, scalability, and regulatory requirements.


**The Perfect Fit**
* 5\+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in fintech, banking, lending, payments, or B2B SaaS.
* Hands\-on experience building products in credit, lending, banking infrastructure, payments, or financial services.
* Strong understanding of financial product lifecycles and operational workflows.
* Experience working with banks, NBFCs, fintechs, or financial institutions.
* Experience building configurable products or platforms serving multiple customers.
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, system architecture, and data flows.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, scalable product solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Comfortable operating independently in fast\-moving environments.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive problems from definition to execution and outcomes.


*Your Edge Over The Rest*
* Experience with LOS/LMS, underwriting, decision engines, KYC, bureau, payments, ledger, or collections.
* Understanding of RBI regulations relevant to lending, credit, payments, and KYC.
* Experience building APIs, configurable workflows, or platform products.
* Experience taking products from 0→1 and 1→N.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring PMs or influencing product direction across teams.


**The Problem We’re Solving**
 Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 At the same time, customer expectations have changed \- speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
   

  

 This is where we come in.
   

  

 At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control \- helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
   

  

**The Opportunity Ahead**
* Build and scale products powering the future of digital lending for banks and NBFCs
* Work at the intersection of fintech innovation and regulated banking infrastructure
* High ownership role with end\-to\-end product responsibility
* Opportunity to solve complex, real\-world problems in credit, underwriting, and onboarding
* Collaborate closely with experienced leaders across product, banking, and fintech ecosystems
* Fast\-paced, execution\-driven culture where your work directly impacts business outcomes
* Be part of a growing fintech shaping next\-gen credit infrastructure in India

title: Senior Associate -Digital Product Management
description:
**Job Description**
 Enterprise Data Platforms (EDP) enables the enterprise with trusted, governed, and actionable data through modern digital products and platforms. The team transforms enterprise warehouse data into intuitive, scalable experiences that help users discover, access, analyze, and derive insights from data.
   

  

 As an Sr. Associate Product Owner – Digital Data Products, you will support the development and delivery of enterprise data products built on modern cloud and data platforms, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will work closely with business, data, technology, and design teams to translate user needs and complex data capabilities into simple, high\-value digital experiences.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an interest in product management, data, cloud technologies, and AI/GenAI\-enabled digital experiences.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support the product roadmap, backlog, and delivery of enterprise digital data products and platform capabilities.
* Understand enterprise user journeys and help identify opportunities to simplify how users discover, access, consume, and derive insights from warehouse data through best\-in\-class digital products.
* Identify and evaluate AI/GenAI opportunities across digital product journeys, including potential business benefits, productivity improvements, adoption, and success measures.
* Translate business and user needs into well\-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Participate in product discovery, requirements gathering, backlog refinement, prioritization, solution\-design discussions, sprint planning, testing, and product releases.
* Collaborate with UX/design, engineering, architecture, data analytics, governance, and business teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and reliable data products.
* Support the definition and tracking of product KPIs, adoption, user experience, and business outcomes, and use data and user feedback to identify opportunities for product enhancement.
* Assist in ensuring data security, privacy, governance, entitlement, and compliance requirements are incorporated into product features and user journeys.
* Identify and track product dependencies, risks, issues, and delivery milestones, escalating where appropriate and supporting timely resolution.
* Create product documentation, stakeholder communications, demonstrations, release readiness, and adoption activities.
* Develop an understanding of emerging capabilities across cloud, data, analytics, AI, and GenAI and contribute ideas for product innovation and improved user experiences.
* Contribute to a customer\-centric and outcome\-driven product culture by bringing user insights, data, and structured problem\-solving into product decisions.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Business/MBA, or a related discipline.
* 3\+ years of relevant experience in digital products, data products, business analysis, product ownership/management, technology delivery, data analytics, or related roles.
* Proven Product Management/Product Ownership experience, including product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, requirements, and end\-to\-end delivery.
* Exposure to products or solutions that enable users to discover, access, analyze, or derive insights from data.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud and data ecosystems; exposure to GCP, BigQuery, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, APIs, or big\-data technologies is preferred.
* Working knowledge of one or more of the following: data warehousing, databases, SQL, data integration/pipelines, APIs, analytics, BI/reporting, and digital UI concepts.
* Experience translating complex data and technology capabilities into intuitive user experiences and measurable business value.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments; familiarity with SAFe is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across business and technology teams, manage multiple priorities, and operate in a complex enterprise environment.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop expertise across product management, cloud, data, analytics, AI, and GenAI.
* Experience or exposure to enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, data marketplaces, self\-service analytics, data governance, cloud\-based data products, or AI/GenAI\-enabled experiences is highly desirable.

 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. title: Associate Manager Product Growth
description:

 We are looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented
 **Associate** 
**Manager** 
**Product Growth,** 
 to drive the strategy, development, positioning, launch, and lifecycle management of products and learning solutions for the
 **Higher Education market.**
 The role will be responsible for translating market, faculty, student, and institutional needs into compelling product propositions, while partnering closely with Editorial, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Customer Success, and Global Product teams.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to combine
 **product thinking, market understanding, commercial acumen, digital fluency, and strong execution capability** 
 to build products that drive adoption, revenue, engagement, and long\-term customer value.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
**Product Lifecycle \& Adoption**
* Create structured plans for product launch, adoption, renewal, and lifecycle management.
* Monitor adoption at institutions, faculty, course, and student levels.
* Develop intervention plans for products with low adoption or declining usage.
* Recommend product revision, repositioning, bundling, migration, or discontinuation based on performance.


**Revenue \& Commercial Management**
* Own and contribute to product\-level revenue and margin targets.
* Develop annual product business plans and revenue forecasts.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing, discounting, commercial models, and profitability.
* Monitor product performance against budget and forecast.
* Identify corrective actions for underperforming products


 Identify opportunities for:
   

  

* 
+ 
- Institutional contracts
- Digital subscriptions
- Bundling
- Custom publishing
- Licensing
- Institutional solutions
- E\-commerce
- Cross\-sell and upsell


**Internal Positioning \& Messaging**
* Defining and communicating the product’s unique value proposition, positioning, and key differentiators, translating product capabilities into clear, compelling messages that resonate with target audiences.
* Develop product positioning frameworks that clearly articulate the customer problem, product solution, key benefits, differentiators, and business value.
* Translate complex product features, content, and technology into simple, customer\-centric benefits and outcomes.
* Develop competitor positioning and differentiation statements to help Sales teams communicate the product’s strengths effectively.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure consistency of product messaging across campaigns, websites, email, social media, webinars, events, and sales collateral.
* Equip Sales and KAM teams with product messaging toolkits, battlecards, pitch decks, talking points, and competitive response guides.
* Ensure that internal stakeholders have a clear understanding of “What the product is, Who it is for, Why it matters, and Why customers should choose it.”


**List Management \& Product Data Governance**
* Own and maintain the master list of active products, ensuring completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely updates.
* Maintain accurate product information including product name, ISBN/SKU, edition, discipline, segment, pricing, status, format, digital availability, and other relevant attributes.
* Establish strong data hygiene and governance processes for product and campaign\-related databases.
* Ensure product lists are campaign\-ready and sales\-ready for Marketing, Sales Enablement, e\-commerce, reporting, and business operations.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure new products, revisions, discontinued products, pricing changes, and product status updates are reflected accurately and on time.
* Maintain appropriate product lists for marketing campaigns, sales collateral, CRM, e\-commerce, reporting, compliance, and management reviews.


**Sales Enablement \& Planning**
* Enable Sales and KAM teams to effectively communicate product value, articulate differentiation, handle objections, and drive customer adoption.
* Develop and maintain sales enablement tools, including product decks, battlecards, pitch documents, FAQs, competitive guides, product comparison sheets, and objection\-handling guides.
* Conduct regular product training and sales enablement sessions to ensure teams understand product features, positioning, target customers, use cases, and value propositions.
* Partner with Sales leadership to identify sales process gaps, productivity opportunities, and adoption barriers.
* Support the effective use and optimization of CRM and sales technology platforms to improve sales visibility, productivity, and execution.
* Develop and maintain sales reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and performance tracking to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Support territory planning, account prioritization, opportunity management, and pipeline planning in collaboration with Sales and KAM teams.
* Ensure CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, and governance across relevant product and customer records.
* Analyze sales and customer data to identify product trends, whitespace opportunities, adoption gaps, and revenue opportunities.


**We are looking for someone with:**
**Product Management Expertise**
* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management \- ideation, development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Ability to develop product strategy, roadmap, positioning, and value proposition.
* Strong understanding of market research, customer insights, competitor analysis, and portfolio management.
* Ability to translate customer and market needs into product requirements and actionable product initiatives.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, pricing, margins, adoption, and profitability.


**Sales Enablement**
* Ability to translate product features into sales propositions and customer benefits.
* Experience developing sales decks, product brochures, battlecards, FAQs, competitor comparisons, objection\-handling guides, and product demos.
* Strong understanding of sales processes, pipeline management, account prioritization, and opportunity management.
* Ability to conduct product training and enablement sessions for Sales and KAM teams.
* Strong collaboration skills to bridge Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.


**CRM, Marketing Automation \& Technology**
* Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce/SFDC.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* Understanding of CRM data management, lead management, campaign workflows, and reporting.
* Ability to leverage technology to streamline processes and improve sales and marketing efficiency.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys is desirable.


**Data \& Analytics Expertise**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret sales, marketing, customer, product, and campaign data and convert insights into actions.
* Experience with dashboards, reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking.
* Knowledge of GA4 or similar digital analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of marketing and product KPIs including conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, pipeline, and revenue.
* Advanced MS Excel skills; familiarity with Power BI or other visualization tools is an advantage.


**Communication \& Stakeholder Management**
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex product concepts in a simple, compelling, customer\-focused manner.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, Marketing, Editorial, Technology, Finance, Operations, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for internal and external audiences.


**Strategic \& Commercial Thinking**
* Strong business acumen and commercial orientation.
* Ability to connect product decisions with revenue, margin, customer value, and business objectives.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands\-on execution mindset
* Strong understanding of competitive dynamics and ability to develop data\-backed recommendations.


**Education / Domain Knowledge**
* Preferred Educational Background: MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Product Management, Business Strategy, or related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.


**Preferred Industry Experience:**
* Higher Education Publishing
* EdTech / Digital Learning
* SaaS / Technology
* Education Services
* Academic Content / Learning Solutions


**Why Work for us?**
 The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As a leading education partner for millions of educators, learners, and professionals, we are expanding the possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world.
   

  

 This position offers a strong foundation and a clear growth path toward product management for the right candidate. You will gain broad exposure to product, commercial, and operational functions within a globally recognized education business working with real data, real products, and real business decisions from day one.

title: Brand Category Manager
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Business Consultant
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard\-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
   

  

**We are looking for Business Consultant**
 As a business consultant, you will guide our clients in modeling their business processes in our industry\-leading Software as a Service (SaaS) product. Do you believe you can help our clients to thrive in their business by configuring state\-of\-the\-art software to fulfill continuously evolving passenger needs? Then this role may be something for you!
   

  

 Integrating the SaaS product for a rail operator is no easy task. It concerns mission critical business processes that need to be modelled in a functionally rich and flexible SaaS product. Variations are endless, requiring deep analytical skills and good understanding of business processes, functionality and context of our clients. In addition, there is a portion in the larger IT ecosystem of our clients that typically requires custom integration. Your expertise and experience matter to successfully integrate the SaaS product in the IT landscape of our clients. As a business consultant, you are responsible for functionally solutionising the integration of existing systems with the SaaS product, both upstream (B2C, B2B and B2E frontend channels) and downstream (e.g. F\&A, CRM, RM, DWH).
   

  

 We have a global client base, ranging from North America to a strong client base in Europe. With a global go\-to\-market strategy, we are committed to expand our footprint to Asia, in particular in Indonesia. You will be a crucial element to our growth strategy in Indonesia and the wider Asia Pacific region, to deliver successful implementations with interactive workshops, consulting and training clients onsite at their offices, both within Indonesia and beyond.
   

  

 We are looking for mature consultants with hands\-on experience helping clients by defining sustainable solutions for complex challenges. You understand market and consumer trends in public transport and build a deep understanding of our clients’ business as well as our SaaS product. You can challenge the status quo and create solutions. We are open to welcoming colleagues with a background in development and/or information/ business analysis.
   

  

**You’ll make a difference by**
* Quick and adequate answering of functional and technical questions from our customers and consultants
* A low sense of hierarchy, which comes with a lot of responsibility and visibility
* Working in a multi\-cultural and international team, with colleagues from Indonesia, Netherlands, Germany and Singapore.
* An open yet challenging environment of ambitious professionals with different backgrounds


**Desired Skills:**
* Bachelor’s degree
* Strong analytical thinking skills
* You have a university degree and are willing to travel overseas
* International experience and ambition are a plus
* You can interpret difficult problems and facilitate clients towards sustainable solutions
* You are fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both verbal and in writing and can communicate in a client\-centric way
* Any additional language is a benefit
* Experience with working in an agile environment is a plus
* Demonstrable experience in translating business objectives into IT needs
* Experience working in public transportation or rail industry is a major plus
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience as a consultant or information analyst in IT
* You like having different responsibilities, working in small teams on challenging assignments.


**Join us and be yourself!**
 We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
 This role is based in Gurugram. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting \- and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

 Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers.

 Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy \& Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end\-to\-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI\-native / agentic service operating models.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 The Accenture Song practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services – Customer Service team, you will help the world’s leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost\-driven function into an intelligence\-led, AI\-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem — driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C\-suite executives, shape AI\-native service operating models, and lead end\-to\-end transformation for the world’s leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end\-to\-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future\-ready retail service solutions.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Service Strategy \& Advisory**
* Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
* Shape AI\-native service vision, target operating models and multi\-year transformation roadmaps.
* Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value\-realization frameworks.
* Advise boards and C\-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise\-scale change.


**Experience Design**

* Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
* Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock\-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
* Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.


**Operating Model \& Process Transformation**
* Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store \& workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
* Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact\-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
* Establish governance frameworks — policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.


**Technology \& AI Transformation**
* Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
* Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
* Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) — intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
* Integrate across order, store and supply\-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS\-enabled field and delivery tracking.
* Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root\-cause analysis capability.


**Human \+ Agentic Operations**
* Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
* Design agents for high\-volume service capabilities — order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
* Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
* Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.


**Enterprise Transformation Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
* Orchestrate multi\-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
* Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.


**Practice Building**
* Develop market\-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
* Coach and mentor consulting teams.
* Support business development and strategic pursuits — collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Song’s Consulting, Technology and Data \& AI teams for delivery.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end\-to\-end value chain — merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in\-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last\-mile fulfilment — and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
* First\-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory\-only) — having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
* Proven track record across service strategy \& advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology \& AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
* Hands\-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery\-exception handling; substitutions, out\-of\-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse\-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi\-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
* Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase\-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score\-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account\-management workflows.
* Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in\-store fulfilment; store\-to\-contact\-centre escalation and case hand\-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
* Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed\-delivery, missed\-slot and delivery\-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns\-to\-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last\-mile SLAs, on\-time performance and partner score\-carding.
* Working knowledge of core retail service processes — order\-to\-delivery, returns \& refunds, complaint \& case management, store\-to\-contact\-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution — with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end\-to\-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
* Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM \& CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge \& case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS\-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root\-cause analytics).

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Backdrop**
 AVIZVA is a Healthcare Technology Organization that harnesses technology to simplify, accelerate, \& optimize the way healthcare enterprises deliver care. Established in 2011, we have served as strategic enablers for healthcare enterprises, helping them enhance their overall care delivery.
   

  

 With over 15 years of expertise, we have engineered more than 150 tailored products for leading Medical Health Plans, Dental and Vision Plan Providers, PBMs, Medicare Plan Providers, TPAs, and more.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 As a Scrum Master at AVIZVA, you will be the proud skipper of project\-level Scrum Ceremonies. You will act as a bridge of dialogue between the Scrum Team and other important stakeholders. You will not just spot and voice the potential hiccups in your team’s progress, but you will build solid safeguards by joining forces both within and beyond the team
   

  

 As an ambassador of Scrum principles and values, you will coach your team to be a devoted Scrum follower. You will master the project scope curriculum and learn the program goal basics. You will team\-up with the Product Owner and make sure that the product backlog is always up to the minute. You will be the face of your Scrum team in cross\-team dependency reviews.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Acquire a holistic overview of all ongoing projects and initiatives within the allocated program to develop a thorough understanding of the assigned project, its objectives, scope, and alignment with the overall business strategy.
* Consolidate broader program\-level knowledge with deeper project\-level insights to identify significant cross\-team dependencies.
* Act as the primary custodian of Scrum practices and processes for the team.
* Lead the Scrum process by driving a series of Scrum ceremonies, such as Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective, ensuring their effectiveness and alignment with the team's goals.
* Mentor the team by helping them understand Agile practices, Scrum principles, product vision, and scope, empowering them to develop a shared sense of ownership and a continuous drive toward improvement.
* Monitor the project's progress and provide timely feedback to ensure on\-time deliverables, driving clear and transparent communication within the team and with all external stakeholders.
* Identify technical and people\-centered roadblocks and risks that might hinder the team's progress towards deliverables, collaborating with team members and stakeholders to define targeted risk mitigation strategies and proactively eliminate risks.
* Estimate story points and assist the Product Owner in refining and maintaining the product backlog using project management tools, ensuring visibility and transparency for all stakeholders.
* Represent the team in the weekly Scrum of Scrums meeting, presenting a detailed report on the team's progress, achievements in the previous sprint, and alignment with the defined project goals.
* Attend the Program Increment (PI) Planning event and drive clear communication on workflow alignment and dependencies with multiple stakeholders of the Agile Release Train.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* 2 to 5 years of hands\-on experience as a Scrum Master or in an Agile project management role.
* Experience in facilitating Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective).
* Extensive hands\-on expertise in utilizing Agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) for comprehensive planning, tracking, and execution of Agile projects.
* Knowledge of Agile automation, Kanban practices, and Lean principles.
* Familiarity with Agile estimation techniques (e.g., Story Pointing, Planning Poker).
* Analytical and proactive approach to problem\-solving, risk mitigation, and task prioritization, with excellent communication and transparency skills.
* Ability to take ownership of tasks and drive quick, well\-informed decision\-making through a solutions\-oriented mindset.


**Good To Have**
* Expertise in project scheduling tools such as Advanced Roadmap and PI Planning tools.
* Working knowledge of SAFe.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
* Positive and enthusiastic approach to learning and adapting to new methodologies.

description:

Pluang is Indonesia’s leading multi\-asset investment platform, offering products such as Crypto, US Stocks, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure—so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $110M\+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we’re one of Indonesia’s fastest\-growing fintechs.


**Role Overview**


We are hiring a Senior Product Manager based in **Gurgaon** to own Pluang’s Funnel \& Growth (FnG) charter across the full lifecycle: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, and Conversion. You will set the growth product strategy, build scalable growth systems (journey optimization, instrumentation, experimentation, lifecycle management), and lead cross\-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Data, Design, and Marketing. This is a high\-impact leadership role with direct influence on revenue, transaction volume, and user growth.

  

  

**What You Will Do**


**1\) Own growth strategy \& operating cadence across Acquisition, Activation, Retention, and Conversion (AI as a capability)**

**3\) Improve funnel conversion via instrumentation, experimentation, and personalization**

* Run a high\-velocity experimentation program with strong rigor (test design, guardrails, interpretation, and rollout).
  
* Ship personalization that compounds: targeted journeys, contextual nudges, dynamic offers—grounded in measurable lift.
  

**4\) Build cohorting \+ lifecycle systems that scale engagement and retention**

  

* Define and evolve cohorting (intent/value/behavior/asset affinity) that drives targeted experiences and prioritization.
  
* Build lifecycle journeys that reduce drop\-offs and increase habit formation (e.g., education, alerts, portfolio habits).
  
* Partner with Data/Eng to ensure the lifecycle engine is measurable, reliable, and operationally scalable.
  

**5\) Scale referral \+ influencer growth routes with sustainable economics and controls**

  

* Own referral product mechanics end\-to\-end: incentives, UX, fraud/risk controls, and inviter/invitee economics.
  
* Build tooling that enables influencer programs to scale (tracking, attribution, reward logic, performance insights).
  

  

**6\) Lead cross\-functional execution and raise the growth bar**

  

* Drive alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Compliance to ship impactful growth initiatives.
  
* Mentor PM(s) and standardize best practices in experimentation quality, analytics hygiene, and execution cadence.
  
* Translate strategy into shippable roadmaps and ensure outcomes are realized (not just launched).
  

  

**What You Will Need**


**Qualifications**

  

* **4\+ years** of Product Management experience, with meaningful ownership in growth / funnel / lifecycle.
  
* Demonstrated impact on acquisition, activation, retention, and conversion metrics at scale.
  
* Fintech, trading, or consumer financial products experience is strongly preferred.
  
* Marketing or Product Marketing experience (preferred)—especially performance marketing collaboration, lifecycle, GTM, or positioning.
  

**Skills \& Competencies**

  

* Strong analytical and experimentation depth (cohort analysis, incrementality, A/B testing rigor).

**Mindset**

title: Storyteller & Script Writer
description:
Storyteller \& Script Writer

**Company:** HypeSquad Digital Solutions  
**Position:** Storyteller \& Script Writer  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Delhi NCR / Work From Office  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Department:** Content \& Creative

About HypeSquad

HypeSquad Digital Solutions is a Digital Growth Systems Agency helping businesses build brands, generate leads, create content, and build scalable digital growth systems.

We are looking for a **creative Storyteller \& Script Writer** who understands how to turn an idea, product, service, or insight into content that people actually want to watch.

This is not a traditional blog\-writing role.

We need someone who understands **attention, storytelling, hooks, emotions, pacing, and audience psychology** — especially for short\-form video.

Role Overview

As a Storyteller \& Script Writer, you will work closely with our creative, marketing, and performance teams to develop scripts and content concepts for:

* Instagram Reels
* YouTube Shorts
* Facebook
* LinkedIn
* Paid advertisements
* Brand videos
* Founder\-led content
* Educational content
* Product/service videos
* Social media campaigns

Your job will be to take a **raw idea and turn it into a compelling story.**

The basic thinking should be:

**Hook → Problem → Story → Insight → Solution → CTA**

But you should also know when to break the formula.

Key Responsibilities1\. Short\-Form Video Scripts

Write engaging scripts for:

* Instagram Reels
* YouTube Shorts
* Facebook videos
* LinkedIn videos
* Talking\-head videos
* Educational videos
* Story\-based videos
* Promotional videos
* Brand awareness content
* Lead\-generation content

Scripts should be designed around **retention and engagement**, not just information delivery.

2\. Storytelling

Convert ordinary information into interesting stories.

For example:

Instead of:

"Businesses need a website."

You should be able to develop:

"A client came to us after spending ₹2 lakh on ads. The ads weren't the problem. The website was."

The candidate should understand how to create:

* Curiosity
* Suspense
* Emotional connection
* Relatability
* Pattern interruption
* Open loops
* Strong payoffs

3\. Hooks

Develop multiple hooks for the same idea.

Examples:

* Curiosity\-based hooks
* Problem\-based hooks
* Contrarian hooks
* Emotional hooks
* Data\-driven hooks
* Story hooks
* Question hooks
* Pattern\-interrupt hooks

You should understand that **the first 2–3 seconds can determine whether someone keeps watching.**

4\. Research \& Content Discovery

Research:

* Trending topics
* Industry news
* Competitor content
* Social media trends
* Viral formats
* Audience pain points
* Consumer behaviour
* Relevant case studies

Turn research into original content ideas rather than simply copying existing content.

5\. Content Ideation

Generate content ideas for different brands and industries.

You should be comfortable moving between:

**Marketing → Business → Technology → Education → Lifestyle → Products → Services**

and quickly understanding the audience and communication style required for each.

6\. Ad Scripts

Create scripts specifically designed for performance marketing.

This includes:

* Meta video ads
* YouTube ads
* Lead\-generation ads
* Product/service ads
* Retargeting creatives
* UGC\-style ads
* Founder\-led ads

You should understand the difference between a **content reel** and a **conversion\-focused ad.**

7\. Brand Storytelling

Help develop:

* Brand stories
* Founder stories
* Customer stories
* Case studies
* Testimonials
* Brand campaigns
* Launch campaigns

The objective is to make brands **memorable, relatable, and differentiated.**

8\. Collaboration

Work closely with:

* Performance Marketers
* Graphic Designers
* Video Editors
* Social Media Managers
* Website Developers
* Founders / Clients

You will need to convert creative ideas into scripts that are practical to shoot and edit.

What We Are Looking ForMandatory Skills

* 2–3 years of relevant experience
* Strong storytelling ability
* Excellent Hindi and English communication
* Strong script\-writing skills
* Understanding of short\-form content
* Strong research skills
* Understanding of social media content
* Ability to write strong hooks
* Ability to understand different audiences
* Ability to write conversational scripts

Preferred Experience

Experience with:

* Digital marketing agencies
* Social media agencies
* Content creators
* Personal brands
* D2C brands
* Startups
* Performance marketing
* Advertising
* YouTube/Instagram content

is a plus.

What Makes You a Good Fit?

You should be someone who naturally asks:

**"Why would someone care about this?"**

before asking:

**"What should I write?"**

You should be able to take:

**One idea → 5 hooks → 3 angles → 2 scripts → multiple pieces of content.**

You should also be comfortable rewriting a script based on performance data.

For example:

Low retention at 5 seconds → improve hook.High retention but low CTA response → improve offer/CTA.High views but low leads → improve intent and conversion angle.Daily Responsibilities

Your typical day may include:

* Researching content trends
* Finding interesting stories and topics
* Creating content ideas
* Writing short\-form scripts
* Writing ad scripts
* Developing hooks
* Reviewing competitor content
* Working with the video team
* Improving existing scripts
* Participating in creative brainstorming
* Supporting campaign content development

Expected Output

The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced content environment with multiple scripts and concepts being developed every week.

Quality is more important than simply producing a high number of scripts.

We want **ideas that people remember.**

Candidate Evaluation

During the hiring process, candidates may be asked to complete a short practical assignment.

Example:

**Topic:** "Why most businesses waste money on digital marketing."

Create:

* 5 hooks
* 1 × 45\-second Reel script
* 1 × 30\-second ad script
* 1 × storytelling angle
* CTA

Candidates may also be asked to rewrite an existing script to improve its hook and retention.

Required Qualities

* Creative thinker
* Curious
* Strong communicator
* Good observer
* Research\-oriented
* Audience\-focused
* Comfortable experimenting
* Open to feedback
* Deadline\-oriented
* Strong attention to detail
* Understands internet culture and social media
* Can think beyond conventional content formats

Compensation

**₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month**

Final compensation will depend on:

* Experience
* Writing quality
* Storytelling ability
* Portfolio
* Industry exposure
* Practical assignment performance

How to Apply

Please share:

* Updated CV
* Writing portfolio
* Previous scripts
* Links to reels/videos you have scripted, if available
* Relevant social media/content work
* Notice period
* Current compensation
* Expected compensation

**Subject:** Application — Storyteller \& Script Writer

Important

**We are not looking for a content writer who simply fills a content calendar.**

We are looking for a **storyteller who can turn ideas into content people want to watch, remember, and share.**

Senior Performance Marketing Manager — Meta \& Google Ads

**Company:** HypeSquad Digital Solutions

About HypeSquad

HypeSquad Digital Solutions is a Digital Growth Systems Agency helping businesses build stronger brands, generate qualified leads, acquire customers, and scale through performance marketing, websites, automation, and data\-driven growth systems.

We are looking for a **highly experienced, numbers\-driven Performance Marketing Manager** who can independently manage and scale Meta and Google Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is a **hands\-on ownership role** for someone who understands that performance marketing is not just about running ads — it is about managing budgets, improving ROAS, controlling CAC/CPA, understanding funnels, testing creatives, and driving measurable business growth.

The Candidate We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone with:

* **3–4 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience**
* Proven experience managing **₹15–20 Lakhs\+ monthly advertising budgets**
* Experience handling **₹4–5 Crore\+ cumulative advertising spend**
* Demonstrable experience achieving and maintaining **ROAS in the 6X–10X range** on relevant campaigns/accounts
* Strong hands\-on expertise in both **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
* Experience managing multiple campaigns/accounts simultaneously
* Strong analytical and commercial understanding of paid acquisition
* Ability to independently take ownership of campaign strategy, execution, optimization and scaling

**Important:** Candidates should be able to substantiate their claimed budget and ROAS experience with actual campaign/account examples during the interview.

Key Responsibilities1\. Meta Ads Management

* Plan, build, launch and optimize Meta campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage Sales, Leads, Conversion, Remarketing and other relevant campaign objectives.
* Develop campaign structures for prospecting, retargeting and customer audiences.
* Manage Advantage\+ campaigns and other relevant Meta campaign formats.
* Optimize budgets, audiences, placements, bidding and campaign structures.
* Identify creative fatigue and coordinate with the creative team for new concepts.
* Conduct structured testing of:
* Creatives
* Hooks
* Copy
* Offers
* Audiences
* Landing pages
* Campaign structures
* Analyze campaign\-level and account\-level performance to identify scaling opportunities.

2\. Google Ads Management

Hands\-on experience with:

* Google Search Ads
* Performance Max
* Shopping Ads
* Display Ads
* YouTube Ads
* Remarketing
* Keyword research and search\-term analysis
* Bidding and budget optimization
* Negative keyword management
* Feed/product optimization where applicable

The candidate should understand how to allocate budgets between Meta and Google based on business objectives and performance.

3\. Budget \& ROAS Ownership

You will be responsible for managing significant paid\-media budgets and making data\-driven allocation decisions.

**Expected experience:**

* Monthly ad spend: **₹15–20 Lakhs\+**
* Cumulative spend handled: **₹4–5 Crore\+**
* Proven exposure to campaigns/accounts achieving **6X–10X ROAS**
* Ability to scale spend without blindly compromising efficiency

The candidate should understand the relationship between:

**Ad Spend → CAC/CPA → Conversion Rate → AOV → Revenue → ROAS → Profitability**

4\. Tracking \& Analytics

Strong understanding of:

* Meta Pixel
* Meta Conversions API
* Google Ads Conversion Tracking
* GA4
* Google Tag Manager
* UTM tracking
* Conversion events
* Attribution
* Looker Studio / reporting dashboards
* Google Sheets / Excel

Google's own documentation emphasizes accurate conversion values and tracking as a foundation for value\-based bidding and Target ROAS optimization.

5\. Funnel \& CRO

The candidate should not look at ads in isolation.

You will analyze the complete funnel:

**Ad → Landing Page → Lead/Product Page → Checkout/Form → Conversion → Revenue**

Responsibilities include:

* Identifying funnel drop\-offs
* Improving landing\-page conversion rates
* Suggesting CRO experiments
* Evaluating lead quality
* Working with the website/development team
* Improving offer positioning
* Identifying reasons behind high CPA or low ROAS

6\. Creative Strategy

Work closely with:

* Graphic Designers
* Video Editors
* Content Strategists
* Copywriters
* Web Developers

You will translate campaign data into creative requirements.

For example:

"This hook is generating a higher CTR but lower conversion rate.""This audience is converting, but frequency is increasing.""UGC creatives are producing a lower CPA than static creatives."

The candidate should be able to explain **what creative should be produced and why**, rather than simply asking the creative team for "more ads."

Prepare regular:

* Daily performance monitoring
* Weekly performance reports
* Monthly performance reports
* Budget utilization reports
* ROAS/CAC/CPA analysis
* Campaign scaling recommendations
* Testing roadmaps

Reports should answer:

**What happened? → Why did it happen? → What are we changing? → What should we scale?**

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**OneMetric \| Full\-time \| Gurgaon**


We're not hiring for a marketing manager. We're hiring for a product manager who can go deeper into a problem statement, understand what the customer actually needs, shape that into a clear offer and message, and then get it in front of buyers — through the website, collateral, and email — with a defined outcome of 35–50 MQLs/SQLs a month.


OneMetric is a software\-plus\-service company — service\-heavy, but with real software and product components underneath (like CoverageAI and Suprdense). That mix is exactly why this role needs a product manager's instincts, not a marketer's. A product manager doesn't start with the copy — they start by going deep into the problem: talking to customers, understanding what they actually need, and shaping that understanding into an offer worth buying. That's the job here, whether what we're packaging is closer to a service engagement or closer to a software tool. You're not documenting what OneMetric already says about itself. You're figuring out what the market needs, shaping how we package and present a solution for it, and making sure that story is airtight everywhere a buyer encounters us — website, one\-pagers, email, sales decks.

* **The offer itself.** Working with delivery and leadership, you help define and sharpen what a given service or solution actually is, who it's for, and why it beats the alternative — not just repeat what's already being said.
* **Positioning and messaging.** The language that makes a business leader say "that's exactly my problem" — built from real research, not assumption.
* **Go\-to\-market activation.** Once an offer and message exist, you're the one who gets it live — on the website, in collateral, in email sequences — working closely with the marketing team to push it out everywhere it needs to be.
* **The website as a shopfront.** Structure, page inventory, and how our offers are presented and found — including how the site earns visibility through SEO and AEO.
* **The MQL/SQL number.** 35–50 MQLs/SQLs a month, generated organically from the website and the motions around it, is your number. A sharp offer and message that nobody sees doesn't count — this has to convert into real pipeline.
* Talk to customers, prospects, sales, and delivery to understand the real problems being solved and what language actually resonates — not guess at it from a template.
* Take those insights and shape them into a defined, sellable offer: what it is, who it's for, what makes it different.
* Write the core positioning and messaging for that offer — the story that has to hold up whether it's read by a founder or a VP of Sales.
* Build and ship the pages, one\-pagers, case studies, and email sequences that carry that message into the market.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with the marketing team to get each offer pushed out across the right channels, not just parked on one page.
* Apply SEO and AEO thinking so offers are actually discoverable — both in Google and by AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma to move fast — quick mockups, drafts, and iterations instead of waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* Track what's converting and what's landing with the market, and keep sharpening the offer and message rather than treating either as fixed.
* **Product\-marketing instinct, applied to services.** You think in terms of "what's the offer, who's it for, why do they buy" — not just "what copy goes on this page." Prior experience as a PMM, or in a role that required this kind of offer/positioning thinking, is exactly what we're after.
* **Deep research ability.** You get to the real problem by talking to customers and internal teams yourself, not by working off a brief someone else wrote.
* **Strong writing that carries conviction.** You can turn a well\-understood problem into messaging a business leader believes, not generic B2B copy.
* **A working understanding of SEO and AEO.** You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search and gets cited by AI answer engines.
* **Website and CRO fluency.** Comfortable with WordPress and HubSpot CMS, and you understand what converts on a page and what doesn't.
* **A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design**, and the ability to work with a designer (or Figma yourself) to turn an idea into a real, live example fast.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** We're a services business — our offers evolve by market and segment. You're comfortable shaping something that isn't fully defined yet, not just executing a fixed spec.
* 4–5 years of experience, ideally including time in product marketing, or in a B2B services/agency/consultancy environment where you had to build the story for a solution, not just market one that already existed.
* **Ownership, not a task list.** We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then shaping the offer, the message, and the page is yours to run with.
* **A performance\-driven culture.** Speed and results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the market, and that's what gets rewarded.
* **Access to the top of the market.** The offers and pages you build speak directly to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes positioning work, not busywork nobody reads.


Within a quarter: the offers you've shaped are the ones sales reaches for first because the message actually lands, MQLs/SQLs from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, and our positioning stops sounding like generic services\-company language and starts sounding like something a buyer would repeat back to us.


Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales and delivery leads to source real offer insight, and partners with the marketing team and a designer (in\-house or external) to take each offer from idea to a live, converting presence across the website, collateral, and email.
