### **Introduction – the ‘why’**



Oxford University Press is looking for a Senior Campaign Executive, Digital Advertising to support the delivery of impactful digital advertising campaigns across our Academic Marketing division. This is an exciting opportunity for a marketing professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking, creativity, and technical expertise to deliver measurable campaign results.



In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing paid digital advertising campaigns that support strategic marketing goals. Working closely with marketers and digital advertising specialists, you will have the opportunity to influence campaign performance, drive engagement, and contribute to the continued growth of OUP's global academic publishing business.



The position offers exposure to a wide range of digital advertising platforms, campaign formats, and optimisation techniques, while providing opportunities for continuous learning and development within a collaborative and supportive marketing environment.

  


### **Opportunity – the ‘what’**



As a Senior Campaign Executive, Digital Advertising, you will develop tactical campaign plans and execute PPC and digital advertising activities that support marketing objectives and maximise return on investment.



Key responsibilities include:


* Developing tactical plans for digital advertising activity to achieve marketing goals.
* Executing digital marketing campaigns across key advertising platforms using a variety of ad formats and campaign types.


• Continuously monitoring, analysing, and optimising campaigns to improve engagement, conversion rates, and ROI. • Collaborating closely with marketers across Academic Marketing teams to provide campaign feedback, recommendations, and optimisation opportunities.

* Delivering campaigns accurately, efficiently, and within agreed service levels and timelines.
* Maintaining effective stakeholder communication by providing clear updates, reporting, and campaign insights.
* Developing a strong understanding of digital advertising KPIs and optimising campaigns to improve metrics such as cost per click, click\-through rates, website traffic, user engagement, submissions, and database acquisition.


**Impact of the role**



This role plays an important part in ensuring that digital advertising campaigns support business and marketing objectives across the Academic division. By delivering high\-quality campaigns, optimising performance, and collaborating effectively with stakeholders, you will help maximise campaign impact, improve audience engagement, and drive measurable results.



Success in this role will be demonstrated through:


* Successful execution of campaigns to brief and to a consistently high standard.
* Strong stakeholder communication and delivery of actionable campaign insights.


• Consistent implementation of digital advertising best practices. • Delivery of campaigns within established timelines and deadlines.  

* Achievement and optimisation of key digital advertising metrics and campaign KPIs.

### **Essential Criteria**


* Understanding of digital advertising platforms and the various advertising options available to maximise ROI.
* Experience executing effective marketing campaigns against a defined brief.


• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders while providing clear campaign updates. • Strong time management, organisational, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.  

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to high\-quality campaign execution.

* Experience working within publishing or a related industry.

title: Vice President, AI Solutions
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago\-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle\-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
   

  

 The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround \& Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution\-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
   

  

 Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high\-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.\-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long\-term growth in a high\-performance environment.
   

  

 The Vice President, AI Solutions role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to lead the end\-to\-end design, development and delivery of AI\-driven solutions that redefine how the firm operates and serves its clients. This Vice President will own discrete AI product workstreams, guide junior team members, report to the Director of AI Solutions and collaborate with senior stakeholders to bring scalable agentic AI platforms to life. This person will bridge technical depth and business acumen, translating complex consulting frameworks into production\-ready AI workflows. If you are a technically strong leader who thrives in high\-performance environments and wants to drive the future of AI in consulting, this is the right role for you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development and delivery of agentic AI solutions and automation workflows that encode Portage Point’s financial and operational advisory methodologies into scalable, reliable platforms
* Own end\-to\-end AI product workstreams from requirements gathering and prototyping through deployment, monitoring and iteration
* Apply AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) to drive rapid, high\-quality development and establish engineering best practices for the AI Solutions team
* Collaborate with Practice Line Leaders, Delivery Enablement teams and domain experts to translate business requirements into AI\-powered product features and workflows
* Manage and mentor junior team members, providing technical guidance, code reviews and professional development support
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tools, LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks, recommending and implementing the most impactful technologies
* Define and enforce AI governance standards including prompt safety, data privacy, bias mitigation and responsible AI practices across all workstreams
* Drive measurable impact by tracking solution performance, adoption metrics and ROI, and iterating based on stakeholder feedback
* Lead internal knowledge sharing sessions, training and documentation efforts to scale AI capability across the firm
* Support business development efforts by contributing to AI\-related proposals, client presentations and solution demonstrations
* Support talent acquisition and firm\-building initiatives
* Contribute to a high\-performing, inclusive and values\-driven culture


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related technical field from a top undergraduate program; MBA or advanced degree preferred
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Ability to collaborate across global time zones, including US\-based teams
* Five to nine years of progressive experience in AI/ML development, software engineering or a related technical discipline; management consulting or professional services experience is a plus
* Proven track record of building and delivering LLM\-powered applications, agentic AI solutions and automation workflows at scale
* Expert\-level proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and strong development skills in Python or JavaScript
* Deep experience with AI/ML frameworks, APIs and orchestration platforms including tools such as OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, N8N, Zapier or similar
* Strong understanding of data engineering, model evaluation, MLOps and modern software development practices
* Demonstrated ability to embed responsible AI principles, including bias detection, explainability and data privacy, into production AI systems
* Proven ability to manage and mentor junior team members and drive delivery across cross\-functional teams
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast\-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high\-pressure environments
* Ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

title: Historian & IT-OT Functional Manager (Manufacturing Function – IT)
description:
We are looking for a Historian \& IT\-OT Functional Manager who will serve as the
 **voice of manufacturing within the IT organization** 
 . The role is the bridge between plant operations and technology.
 



  





**Job Description:** 




**Role: Historian \& IT\-OT Functional Manager (Manufacturing Function – IT)** 




**Designation: Manager** 




**Experience:** 
 12–18 years total, with at least 6 years in pharmaceutical manufacturing operations or manufacturing IT/OT, and at least 4 years in a functional lead or manager role
 



**Education:** 
 B. Pharm, M. Pharm/ B. E, M.E / B. Tech, M.Tech \- Chemical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines.
 



**Location** 
 : Ahmedabad (The position follows plant operating schedules and a 6\-day working week.)
 



  





**Role Summary:** 
 The ideal candidate has
 **worked in or closely with pharma manufacturing** 
 , understands unit operations, batch lifecycle, equipment, and shop\-floor workflows, and also understands how historians, automation, MES, LIMS, and ERP integrate. The individual will own the functional side of historian and IT\-OT solutions from requirement to go\-live and beyond, working with architects, developers, system integrators, and site teams. Also, will understand how the plant runs, translate manufacturing and quality needs into clear IT and OT requirements, and lead implementation through to adoption and measurable business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Manufacturing Business Partnering** 



* Act as the primary IT point of contact for Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams at plant and corporate levels.
* Understand plant priorities such as throughput, yield, right\-first\-time, batch cycle time, deviation reduction, compliance, and cost, and align IT\-OT initiatives to them.
* Spend regular time on the shop floor to observe processes, identify pain points, and uncover digital opportunities.
* Build trusted relationships with plant heads, production managers, QA heads, and engineering leads.
* Maintain a prioritized demand backlog and business\-aligned roadmap for historian and IT\-OT solutions.



**2\. Business\-to\-IT Requirement Translation** 



* Lead requirement workshops with manufacturing and quality stakeholders to capture business needs, current\-state (as\-is) processes, and desired future state (to\-be).
* Map manufacturing processes end to end, for example process order release, material dispensing, batch execution, in\-process checks, equipment cleaning and status, batch record review, and batch release.
* Translate business needs into structured deliverables:
 **business requirements, User Requirement Specifications (URS), functional specifications (FS), use cases, user stories, process flows, data mapping, and acceptance criteria** 
 .
* Conduct fit\-gap analysis against standard product capabilities and recommend configuration over customization wherever possible.
* Define which process parameters, alarms, events, and batch context need to be captured, contextualized, and reported, and why they matter to the business.
* Clearly explain technical constraints, options, and trade\-offs back to business users in plain language.



**3\. Historian Functional Ownership** 



* Own the functional design of the process historian (e.g., AVEVA PI System, AspenTech IP.21, Honeywell PHD, Proficy) across sites.
* Define with process and engineering teams which tags, critical process parameters (CPPs), critical quality attributes (CQAs), and utilities data must be collected.
* Drive the design of asset hierarchies, templates, batch and event frames, and calculations based on actual equipment and process structure (ISA\-88 / ISA\-95\).
* Specify dashboards, trends, reports, and alerts for production, QA, engineering, and management users.
* Enable business use cases such as:
* Batch trending and golden batch comparison
* Continued Process Verification (CPV) and Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) data support
* Deviation and investigation support with process data
* OEE, downtime, and equipment performance
* Environmental monitoring (HVAC, cleanrooms, differential pressure, temperature, humidity)
* Utilities and energy monitoring (WFI, purified water, steam, compressed air, HVAC)
* Cold chain and storage condition monitoring



**4\. IT\-OT Integration Functional Leadership** 



* Define functional requirements for integration between shop\-floor systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA, BMS, EMS, standalone equipment) and enterprise systems (MES, LIMS, ERP/SAP, QMS, CMMS, WMS).
* Specify business data flows, for example process order download from SAP to MES, material consumption and goods movement back to ERP, equipment status to MES, process data to eBR, and results from LIMS to batch release.
* Work with the IT\-OT Integration Architect and Historian Architect to confirm that technical designs meet business needs.
* Ensure consistent master data and naming across equipment, materials, recipes, and sites.
* Support Pharma 4\.0 initiatives including analytics, AI/ML use cases, digital twins, and predictive maintenance by clearly defining business context and data needs.



**5\. Implementation and Delivery Ownership** 



* Lead the functional workstream of historian and IT\-OT projects from initiation through design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Plan functional activities, milestones, resources, and dependencies in coordination with project managers, architects, and system integrators.
* Guide developers and integrators on business logic, configuration, and process understanding.
* Lead
 **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** 
 : prepare test scenarios with business users, coordinate execution, and track defects to closure.
* Prepare cutover and go\-live plans with site teams, carefully planning around production schedules, campaigns, and shutdowns.
* Provide hypercare support after go\-live and ensure smooth handover to support teams.
* Manage scope changes through a structured change request process.



**6\. GxP Compliance, Validation and Data Integrity** 



* Ensure all solutions meet
 **21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, and ALCOA\+** 
 requirements.
* Author or own functional validation documents: URS, FS, functional risk assessments, requirements traceability matrix, UAT/PQ protocols, and validation summary inputs.
* Work closely with QA and CSV teams on validation strategy, including CSA risk\-based approaches.
* Ensure changes follow site change control, impact assessment, and periodic review processes.
* Represent historian and IT\-OT systems during regulatory inspections and audits (USFDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO\-GMP, and local authorities), explaining business use and data flows.



**7\. Change Management, Training and Adoption** 



* Drive user adoption through training programs, SOP updates, work instructions, and user guides.
* Identify and develop super\-users and site champions.
* Collect user feedback after go\-live and drive continuous improvements.
* Track and report business benefits and value realization, such as reduced investigation time, improved OEE, and reduced manual data collection.



**8\. Operations and Continuous Improvement** 



* Act as the functional escalation point for historian and IT\-OT application issues.
* Work with support teams on incident, problem, and change management, and help define business\-aligned SLAs.
* Periodically review system usage and data quality with site teams.
* Standardize solutions and templates across sites to support faster, consistent rollouts.



**9\. Team and Vendor Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor functional analysts and business analysts within the manufacturing IT team.
* Manage system integrators and vendors on functional scope, quality, and timelines.
* Coordinate with global and site IT, OT, automation, cybersecurity, and quality teams.



  





**Required Manufacturing Knowledge** 




 The candidate must have solid, practical understanding of:
 


* **Pharma manufacturing types:** 
 API (chemical synthesis), oral solid dosage (OSD), sterile/injectables, and/or biologics.
* **Unit operations and equipment** 
 , for example dispensing, granulation (RMG, FBD), blending, compression, coating, capsule filling, packaging, reactors, centrifuges, dryers, distillation, filtration, fermentation, chromatography, lyophilization, and aseptic filling, depending on site type.
* **Batch lifecycle:** 
 process order, recipe, BMR/BPR and eBR, in\-process controls, equipment cleaning and status logs, yield reconciliation, batch record review, and batch release.
* **Plant utilities and environment:** 
 HVAC, cleanroom classification, WFI/PW systems, clean steam, compressed air, and environmental monitoring.
* **Quality processes:** 
 deviations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT, APQR, and CPV.
* **Maintenance and engineering processes:** 
 calibration, preventive maintenance, equipment qualification, and breakdown management.
* **Manufacturing KPIs:** 
 OEE, yield, cycle time, right\-first\-time, downtime, and batch throughput.



  





**Required Technical and Functional Skills** 



* Strong functional knowledge of process historians, preferably
 **AVEVA PI System** 
 (PI AF, Event Frames, PI Vision).
* Working understanding of automation systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA) such as Emerson DeltaV, Siemens PCS 7/WinCC, Rockwell, or ABB.
* Functional understanding of
 **MES** 
 (Körber PAS\-X, Emerson Syncade, Siemens Opcenter),
 **LIMS** 
 (LabWare, LabVantage, Empower),
 **SAP** 
 (PP\-PI, QM, PM, MM), and QMS platforms (e.g., TrackWise, Veeva QMS).
* Knowledge of ISA\-95, ISA\-88, and basic integration concepts (OPC UA/DA, interfaces, APIs, data flows).
* Strong business analysis skills: process mapping (BPMN/Visio), requirement elicitation, fit\-gap analysis, user stories, and UAT management.
* Hands\-on experience delivering and validating GxP computerized systems.
* Familiarity with project delivery methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, hybrid) and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or HP ALM.
* Basic data skills (Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar) to analyze and validate manufacturing data.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in
 **Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation, or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering** 
 ; an MBA or IT qualification is a plus.
* Prior experience working
 **in a plant role** 
 (production, engineering, automation, or QA) before moving into IT is highly valued.
* Certifications such as AVEVA/OSIsoft PI, CBAP/PMI\-PBA, PMP/PRINCE2, ITIL, Six Sigma, or Lean.
* Experience with multi\-site or global rollouts and Pharma 4\.0 or digital manufacturing programs.

title: Senior Manager, Application Development
description:
**Job Description**
* Execute CSV activities for SAP implementation, enhancement, upgrade, integration, and support projects.
* Participate in validation planning and determine validation requirements based on system criticality, intended use, GxP impact, and risk.
* Support preparation, review, and approval of validation deliverables such as:
+ Validation Plan / Master Validation Plan inputs.
+ GxP and system impact assessments.
+ Computerized System Risk Assessments.
+ User Requirements Specifications (URS).
+ Functional and Design Specifications, where applicable.
+ Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
+ Test plans, test scripts, test protocols, and test evidence.
+ Installation, Operational, and Performance Qualification documentation, where applicable.
+ Validation Summary Reports.
+ Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions.

* Review SAP business and functional requirements to ensure applicable GxP, quality, regulatory, and data integrity requirements are adequately addressed.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, traceable, and appropriately linked to business and regulatory risks.
* Support risk\-based validation and testing strategies to avoid unnecessary testing while ensuring adequate control of GxP\-critical functionality.
* Review SAP configuration, custom developments, workflows, reports, forms, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and integrations from a CSV/GxP perspective.
* Participate in SAP testing activities including:
+ Functional testing.
+ System Integration Testing (SIT).
+ User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
+ Regression testing.
+ GxP/validation testing.

* Review executed test evidence for completeness, accuracy, traceability, objective evidence, and compliance with validation procedures.
* Ensure test deviations, incidents, and defects are documented, investigated, resolved, and appropriately assessed for GxP impact.
* Support validation of SAP interfaces with external or third\-party applications and ensure appropriate controls for data transfer, reconciliation, error handling, and audit trail.
* Assess and document data integrity controls including ALCOA\+ principles, audit trails, electronic records, electronic signatures, access controls, and record retention.
* Support evaluation of SAP roles, authorization controls, segregation of duties, and privileged access where relevant to GxP processes.
* Participate in SAP data migration validation including source\-to\-target mapping, data verification, reconciliation, completeness, and accuracy checks.
* Support assessment and validation of SAP master data and transactional data impacting regulated business processes.
* Participate in validation of applicable SAP modules/processes such as:
+ Materials Management (MM).
+ Production Planning (PP).
+ Quality Management (QM).
+ Plant Maintenance / Asset Management (PM/EAM).
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).
+ Finance and Controlling where GxP relevance exists.
+ SAP Fiori applications and workflows.
+ SAP integrations and interfaces.

* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to ensure validation requirements are embedded throughout the system development lifecycle.
* Support change controls and perform GxP/validation impact assessments for SAP enhancements, configuration changes, patches, upgrades, and releases.
* Support periodic reviews of validated SAP systems to confirm continued validated state.
* Support incident, problem, deviation, CAPA, and change\-management processes affecting validated systems.
* Assist in maintaining validation documentation throughout the system lifecycle and ensure controlled documentation is current and audit ready.
* Support system decommissioning and archival activities where required.
* Participate in internal audits, regulatory inspections, customer audits, and supplier audits involving computerized systems.
* Provide validation documentation and evidence during inspections and respond to auditor/inspector queries as required.
* Ensure validation activities comply with organizational SOPs, Quality Management System requirements, and approved project methodology.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance for review and approval of validation documents and resolution of compliance observations.
* Support qualification and assessment of SAP vendors, System Integrators, cloud/service providers, and third\-party technology suppliers where applicable.
* Promote standardized CSV practices and consistent validation methodology across SAP projects and geographical locations.
* Identify validation risks early and escalate gaps that may impact regulatory compliance, data integrity, testing, or project go\-live readiness.


**Qualifications**
* Any bachelor's or master's degree from a recognized institution.
* SAP certification in any relevant functional or technical area is preferred but not mandatory.
* CSV, GAMP 5, Quality, ISPE, or regulatory compliance certification is advantageous.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, particularly Cloud Private Edition or large\-scale global SAP transformation programs, is preferred.
* Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, warehouse, supply chain, laboratory, or regulated business processes is desirable.

title: Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
**Job Position: Marketplace Growth Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Peelamedu locality, Coimbatore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 3–4\+ years
 



  





**About Nap Chief** 





 Nap Chief is a fast\-growing D2C kidswear brand. We sell through our own website (napchief.com) and all
 **major marketplaces including Myntra, FirstCry, and Amazon** 
 . At Nap Chief, we're redefining kids' wear for a new generation of parents. We craft premium, super\-soft clothing that kids love to wear and parents trust. Our mission is to empower the young generation and we are looking for you to join forces with us to conquer this mission.
 



  





**About the Role** 





 You will own Nap Chief's entire marketplace business — revenue and profitability across every platform, the catalogue on each, pricing and event strategy, platform advertising, inventory sell\-through, and platform relationships. The mandate is to grow marketplace revenue while keeping contribution margin (CM2\) intact — growth that loses money at the SKU level does not count.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




***P\&L ownership per platform:***



* Own revenue and CM2 targets for each marketplace: Myntra, FirstCry, Amazon, and any platform we operate on
* Maintain SKU\-level P\&L visibility: selling price, discounts, platform commissions and fees, returns, ad spend, and resulting contribution margin — per platform, per month
* Report weekly on platform performance, drivers, and actions in the business review



***Catalog and content:***



* Own listing quality on every platform: product titles, descriptions, keywords, imagery, size charts, and A\+/enhanced content where available
* Own catalog completeness and hygiene: new products listed on time, correct attribution, active selection maximized, and ratings/reviews monitored with corrective action on recurring complaints



***Pricing, discounting, and events:***



* Own platform\-level pricing and discount strategy, including price parity decisions across channels
* Own sale\-event participation decisions — Myntra EORS, Amazon sale events, FirstCry sales, and category\-level promotions — evaluated with margin math before committing, and planned end\-to\-end (stock, pricing, visibility) when we participate



***Platform advertising:***



* Own marketplace ad budgets and execution: Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products/Brands), Myntra PLA, and equivalent programs on other platforms
* Manage ad efficiency at the SKU and category level as part of overall CM2, not as a separate silo



***Inventory and operations:***



* Plan sell\-through with the fashion buyer: demand forecasts by SKU and platform, stock allocation across platforms and fulfilment models, replenishment for winners, and clearance paths for slow movers
* Monitor and control returns and RTO rates; diagnose causes (sizing, quality, expectation mismatch) and fix them with the relevant team
* Own account health on each platform: fill rates, SLA compliance, penalties, claims, and payment reconciliation



***Portfolio and expansion:***



* Make SKU\-level portfolio calls each season: which styles to scale, fix, or delist
* Evaluate and recommend new platform entries (Ajio, Hopscotch, Nykaa Kids, quick commerce) with a clear business case, and own the launch when approved



***Relationships and team:***



* Own relationships with category managers and platform POCs — visibility slots, event access, and issue resolution
* Manage two marketplace associates: weekly plans, execution review, and development



  





**KPIs you own:** 



* Marketplace revenue vs plan, with CM2 held at target
* Sell\-through rate and inventory health
* Returns/RTO rate
* Ad efficiency (platform ACOS/ROAS within CM2 targets)



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3–4\+ years managing marketplace or category P\&Ls — at a marketplace itself (Myntra, Amazon, FirstCry category teams) or at a brand selling at scale on them
* **MBA required** 
 , with a demonstrably sharp, analytical mindset — this role needs someone who can move fast and think clearly under ambiguity
* Strong data analysis: comfortable in spreadsheets with SKU\-level data, able to compute and act on contribution margin in real time
* Working knowledge of seller platforms and tooling: Amazon Seller Central, Myntra Partner Portal or equivalents, and marketplace advertising consoles
* Demonstrated results: revenue or profitability improvements personally driven, with numbers
* Experience coordinating inventory with buying/planning teams
* Adaptability to a fast\-moving assortment: many styles, seasonal drops, and a growing brand's pace

title: Project Manager
company: SGBI INC - Sastra Global Business Innovations
description:
**Location:** 
 Cochin, Kerala (Primarily in\-office, with occasional travel)
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About SGBI Inc (Sastra Robotics)** 




 SGBI Inc is a Silicon Valley\-based robotics and AI company operating across the USA, UK and India. We are building next\-generation Physical AI systems that combine AI, robotics, computer vision and intelligent software to automate quality assurance of both software and hardware in smart devices.
 



 Our flagship platform, QUACO (Quality Assurance Companion), enables AI\-driven, robot\-aided testing of Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), bridging the gap between digital intelligence and real\-world systems.
 



 We work with global enterprise customers across industries such as retail, banking, automotive, consumer electronics, avionics and medical, helping them accelerate product validation for complex, hardware\-dependent software and physical products.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a high\-ownership Project Manager to run delivery across our full project portfolio: new product development, software releases, customer deployments and hardware production.
 



 You will be the single point of truth on what is being delivered, by whom and by when. You will plan the work, run the review rhythm, keep our project tools accurate, track and report delivery KPIs, and hold teams and vendors to their commitments, flagging risks to leadership before they become problems.
 



 You will work closely with the founders, engineering leads and our customers and integration partners in the UK, US and Middle East.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Portfolio Management** 



* Own the portfolio of active projects across R\&D, software, customer engineering and production.
* Maintain accurate phase, status, priority, milestones, ETAs, dependencies and next actions for every project.
* Publish a clear weekly portfolio view to leadership, with RAG status and the decisions needed.



  





**2\. KPI Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Define and maintain delivery KPIs such as on\-time milestone delivery, schedule variance, overdue task ageing, change request volume, customer issue resolution time, production cycle time and FQC first\-pass yield.
* Build and maintain live KPI dashboards in ClickUp and Excel / Google Sheets, with data that is accurate and up to date.
* Produce weekly and monthly reports for leadership, concise summaries suitable for board and investor updates, and status reports for customers.
* Analyse trends, identify root causes of delays or recurring issues, and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide objective delivery data to support team performance reviews, working with HR.
* Use AI tools such as Claude, Google Gemini or ChatGPT to research, analyse data and prepare clear, well\-structured reports and presentations for stakeholders.



  





**3\. Planning \& Execution** 



* Plan projects from requirement to release using a phase\-gated lifecycle, with defined owners, milestones and deliverables at each stage.
* Maintain the project document checklist for each phase and ensure documents are produced and approved on time.
* Manage scope and change requests, assessing impact on timelines, cost and resources before they are accepted.



  





**4\. Resource \& Capacity Management** 



* Know who is working on what, their next assignment and their expected availability.
* Plan capacity across concurrent projects that share people, test units and equipment, and resolve conflicts early.
* Raise resourcing gaps to leadership with clear options and trade\-offs.



  





**5\. Review \& Governance Rhythm** 



* Run the daily, weekly and monthly review cadence across teams.
* Follow up on overdue tasks and blockers persistently until they are closed.
* Record decisions, actions and owners, and make sure they are carried through.



  





**6\. ClickUp Governance** 



* Own ClickUp as the single source of truth for project work: spaces and lists, task structure, custom fields, status flows, bugs, due dates, dashboards and access.
* Set and enforce usage standards so that status in the tool always reflects reality, including handling of overdue items.
* Build dashboards that give leadership an at\-a\-glance view of delivery health.



  





**7\. Customer Governance** 



* Manage delivery commitments to enterprise customers and integration partners: contacts, milestones, pending actions, change requests and issues.
* Maintain the evidence and communication trail and document trackers for each customer engagement.
* Prepare customer status updates and coordinate deployments, installations and site visits, including international logistics.



  





**8\. Production Coordination** 



* Track the production plan for robot units end to end: materials, procurement, stock, assembly, final quality check (FQC) and shipment.
* Work with Procurement, Stores, QA and Assembly to keep builds on schedule, and manage vendor and lead\-time risks.
* Maintain a production dependency checklist and flag shortages or delays early.



  





**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months** 



* Every active project is visible in ClickUp with accurate status, owners and dates.
* A KPI dashboard is live and reported monthly, and leadership uses it to make decisions.
* The daily, weekly and monthly review rhythm runs consistently, with overdue items actively followed up.
* Every customer commitment is tracked with an owner and a date, and customers receive regular, reliable updates.
* Production builds are tracked from materials to shipment, with risks raised before they cause delays.
* Leadership has fewer surprises: delays and conflicts are flagged early, with options.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 6\+ years of project management experience, including delivery of technology products that combine hardware and software.
* Proven experience running multiple concurrent projects with shared resources.
* Experience managing delivery for enterprise customers, including change requests and escalations.
* Strong working knowledge of project tools such as ClickUp, Jira or Asana (ClickUp preferred), and of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Hands\-on experience defining KPIs and building dashboards and reports: advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and project tool dashboards.
* Able to turn data into clear, concise insight for senior leadership, not just raw numbers.
* Proficiency in AI tools (essential): confident, day\-to\-day use of tools such as Claude, Google Gemini or ChatGPT for research, analysis, drafting and building stakeholder presentations. This will be assessed during the interview.
* Understanding of hardware production: procurement, lead times, stock, assembly and quality checks.
* Excellent written and verbal English; able to write clear status reports for leadership and customers.
* Firm, persistent follow\-up; comfortable holding senior engineers and vendors to commitments.
* Willingness to take occasional calls outside Indian working hours with UK and US teams, and a valid passport for occasional travel.
* Engineering degree (BE / B.Tech) preferred.



  





**What Will Make You Stand Out** 



* **Experience in robotics, automation, embedded or electromechanical product companies.**
* **Experience with phase\-gated (stage\-gate) new product development.**
* **Having set up project governance or tooling from scratch in a startup.**
* **Experience working with system integrators or channel partners.**
* **Exposure to ERP systems such as Odoo for stock and procurement.**
* **Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio or Power BI.**
* **PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile / Scrum certification.**



  





**Important Note** 




 This role is suited for someone who
 **drives delivery** 
 , not someone who only tracks it. You will be expected to chase, challenge and escalate, and to own outcomes across teams. If you are looking for a purely coordination or administrative role, this may not be the right fit.
 



 Practical proficiency with AI tools is a
 **core requirement for every role at SGBI** 
 . Candidates without it will not be considered.

 The Reporting and Data Analytics sub\-function is a leading\-edge organization providing powerful analytical solutions to evolve our ability to provide insights to the business. The R\&DA ensures that EY is keeping pace with the many analytical and technological changes taking place in the business world, evolving our tools and the way we consume information, to best support the client serving as well as corporate responsibilities in a rapidly changing business world.

description:

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Project Manager, Professional Services to join our team. This is a Bengaluru (Hybrid) role, reporting to the Manager, Professional Services in the Professional Services department. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Professional Services organization, leading the successful delivery of customer\-facing projects. This role is responsible for managing complex engagements from initiation through closure, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to a high standard of quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in professional services delivery, experience managing cybersecurity\-related projects, and a practical understanding of how AI technologies can support service delivery, automation, analytics, and customer outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**
* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Professional Services projects, including planning, execution, governance, risk management, and closure
* Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements involving cybersecurity implementations, transformations, assessments, or optimization services
* Build and maintain detailed project plans, status reporting, RAID logs, resource plans, and stakeholder communications
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including technical consultants, solution architects, support teams, sales, and customer leadership
* Drive effective governance through regular steering meetings, status reviews, and executive updates


**Who You Are (Success Profile)**
* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

title: Project Manager || Bangalore || upto 30 LPA
description:
**About the Role**




 You will own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of our AI\-powered inspection projects — from technical scoping through installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and handover. You will lead a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers, and you will be the person our Fortune 500 customers rely on to get their line running. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will be in the detail on project plans, SLAs, and escalations, and you will also be building the systems and standards that let us scale from 30 parallel projects to many more without adding chaos. You will work closely with the Head of Operations, Product and Engineering, and the Sales team.
 



  





**Project Delivery \& Execution** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of projects — scoping, timelines, installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and customer handover.
 



 • Deliver projects on time and within budget, and hold the team to the same standard.
 



 • Track and manage timelines and deliverables across technical verticals; anticipate slippage before it happens rather than reporting it afterwards.
 



 • Own Response and Resolution SLAs across queues coming in from Product, Sales, and customers, and ensure optimal work distribution.
 



 • Run root\-cause analysis on delays and rework, and close the loop so the same failure does not repeat.
 



  





**Technical Excellence** 




 • Translate new requirements from Account Executives and customers into clear scope, technical requirements, and realistic timelines.
 



 • Drive delivery of deep\-tech projects (AI / ML / Computer Vision) with a hardware and software footprint on live production lines.
 



 • Represent Operations in project discussions and client calls — identify the exact technical deliverable, communicate it clearly to the technical team, and drive it to completion.
 



 • Continuously improve efficiency metrics: productivity, quality, first\-time\-right installation, and SLA adherence.
 



 • Partner with Product and Engineering to feed structured field learnings back into the roadmap.
 



  





**Customer Delight** 




 • Own the relationship with client SPOCs through proactive communication and disciplined review cadence.
 



 • Make sure what was agreed during the sales process is exactly what gets delivered — and that we consistently over\-deliver.
 



 • Align with the customer's own KPIs and drive improvement initiatives after the system goes live.
 



 • Handle escalations and outages calmly and decisively — with the customer, and on the customer's behalf with third\-party vendors.
 



 • Communicate credibly with plant leadership and senior stakeholders at Fortune 500 manufacturers.
 



  





**Planning \& Resource Management** 




 • Manage day\-to\-day planning, allocation, and problem\-solving across a distributed field team.
 



 • Own resource planning: who goes where, when, and for how long — balancing project urgency against team wellbeing.
 



 • Track work hours and utilisation, and make the case for additional capacity with data when it is genuinely needed.
 



 • Manage project costs, travel, and hardware logistics in coordination with Finance and Supply Chain
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers.
 



 • Hire FAEs as our project count and geographic footprint expand — we look for technically stellar and deeply empathetic people.
 



 • Build a high\-performance environment that people want to stay in; our Operations team is one of the most driven teams at SwitchOn and keeping it that way is part of the job.
 



 • Run regular one\-on\-ones and team meetings, surface issues early, and resolve conflict directly and fairly.
 



 • Present team performance honestly to the Head of Operations and senior leadership — including what is not working.
 



  





**Systems, Data \& Reporting** 




 • Maintain accurate records of execution time, delays, and root causes so that leadership can make data\-driven decisions.
 



 • Own operational hygiene in our tooling (JIRA / Asana / Zoho) as a source of truth, not an afterthought.
 



 • Build and improve the SOPs, checklists, and playbooks that let a new FAE deliver to standard from their first site visit.

title: Technical Program Manager, Speech Data
description:
About the role
 



 You will plan and run our speech data projects from start to finish. You will design each corpus, write its specifications, set up the collection and annotation pipeline, and check data quality using scripts and automated checks. You will also find and manage the people who produce the data, including speakers, annotators, linguists, and vendors, and you will run collection so that each dataset is delivered on time, on budget, and with proper consent.
 



  





 You should understand how speech models are trained, so that the data you design and deliver works well in a buyer's training pipeline.
 



  





 You do not need to be an expert in every language or country. You need solid experience in a few languages and the ability to apply what you know to new ones, working with native\-speaker linguists and local partners.
 



  





 Work Policy: Onsite
 



 Location: Bangalore
 



  





 What you will do
 



  





**Corpus design and program planning** 



* Design each corpus based on how the data will be used in training. This includes deciding what speakers should say (scripts, prompts, topics, or conversation scenarios), the speaker mix by language, dialect, age, gender, and region, and the recording conditions, such as studio, home, phone, or noisy environments.
* For text\-to\-speech data, make sure scripts give good coverage of the sounds and sentence types in each language.
* Turn corpus designs into clear specifications, including audio quality, file formats, metadata, and delivery format.
* Plan each project, including timeline, budget, staffing, and cost per usable hour of audio.
* Identify risks early, such as low speaker supply for a dialect or weak tools for a language, and plan around them.



**Collection pipeline and tooling** 



* Set up the collection and annotation workflow, including recording apps, annotation tools, storage, and review steps.
* Find and recruit speakers who match each corpus design, directly or through vendors and local partners.
* Run contributor onboarding, payments, and support, and prevent fraud such as the same person recording under several accounts.
* Make sure every contributor gives proper consent, and that each recording can be traced to its contributor and consent record.
* Recruit, train, and manage annotators and linguists, and work with linguists to write transcription guidelines for each language.
* Use speech models to speed up work, for example by pre\-transcribing audio for human correction.



**Quality and measurement** 



* Run automated quality checks on audio and transcripts, and review samples by hand.
* Analyse data with scripts to track quality, speaker coverage, rejection rates, and progress against the plan.
* Run small pilot batches before full collection, and revise the corpus design, specifications, or guidelines based on the results.
* Prepare training, validation, and test splits that avoid problems such as the same speaker appearing in both training and test data.
* Where useful, run simple training or fine\-tuning experiments to check that the data improves model performance.



**Delivery and coordination** 



* Prepare datasets for delivery, including file formats, metadata, and documentation that describes how the data was collected.
* Coordinate speakers, annotators, linguists, vendors, and engineers so that each project stays on schedule and on budget.
* Join technical conversations with AI labs alongside our founders, and handle their feedback on delivered data.



 What you must have
 


* At least 1 year working on speech or audio data. This can be data collection, annotation, transcription, or speech model development.
* Experience designing a speech corpus or dataset, including deciding what content to record and which speakers to include.
* Clear understanding of how ASR and TTS models are trained, including how data is cleaned, segmented, aligned, split, and used in training and evaluation.
* Experience running at least one data collection or annotation project from planning to delivery.
* Experience with speech data in at least two languages.
* Experience recruiting and managing contributors, annotators, or field workers at scale, and managing external vendors.
* Experience writing or applying transcription or annotation guidelines.
* Understanding of how audio quality is measured and why it matters for model training.
* Basic Python or similar scripting skills, enough to analyse data, run simple audio checks, and work with engineers.



 What will help your application
 


* Experience at a speech AI company, a speech research lab, or a data vendor that sells speech data.
* Hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning a speech model.
* Experience with Indian languages, or with languages in other regions such as Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, or Latin America.
* Experience with text\-to\-speech data or conversational speech.
* Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio.
* Knowledge of consent and privacy rules for voice data.



  





**About Wiingy AI** 




  





 Wiingy AI provides human data and AI evaluation services to AI labs and AI companies. We supply expert human judgment where automated methods are not good enough, including evaluating model outputs, producing feedback data for model training, and building curated datasets.
 



  





 Wiingy AI is part of Wiingy, the established tutoring platform whose network of 5,000\+ credentialed, vetted subject\-matter experts musicians with formal training, language and STEM educators, domain specialists already delivers expert instruction at scale. Wiingy AI turns that network into the judgment layer of AI training.
 



  





 This role sits with Wiingy AI, a distinct business from the Wiingy tutoring platform, powered by the same expert network.

title: RnD Program Management
description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 A product/technology begins from the mind and the mind is the product of the environment it is in. The mind thinks with what it experiences from its environment. An organization is the converging environment for such wide variety of minds to come together and contribute their ideas.
 



  





 Yet every organization underestimates the amount of Facilitation and Organizing that is needed to ensure a conducive flow of Ideasbetween minds.
 



  





 We are looking for an Engineering/Technical Program Manager who will own the engineering delivery system and the people performance diagnostic layer across CynLr’s multi\-disciplinary engineering organization. This is not a project management role that runs Agile ceremonies. This is a role for someone who can design engineering processes from first principles, build objective performance assessment frameworks, diagnose systemic bottlenecks across hardware\-software\-research workflows, and drive alignment across teams with genuine interpersonal skill.
 



  





 You will design \& execute the processes, frameworks, and diagnostics that allow CynLr’s engineering teams to deliver with clarity, speed, and accountability across every stream.
 



  





**Your Primary Contributions** 




  





*1\. Engineering Process Design \& Delivery* 



* Design and own the end\-to\-end product delivery process from concept through design, development, testing, and release across hardware, firmware, software, and research streams.
* Map inter\-stream dependencies, tool workflows, and external/internal bottlenecks and resolve them before they become blockers.
* Set up milestones with built\-in assessment checkpoints for product development, projects, and design work.
* Design and manage the tool workflow for product delivery (Asana and engineering management tools), driving adoption and discipline across teams.
* Build a distinct R\&D management workflow for research and exploratory projects separate from routine software development processes.



  





*2\. Engineering Review Process* 



* Design the engineering review process for Design, Development, and Research across all engineering streams.
* Define review metrics, assess process effectiveness, and refine iteratively.
* Organize and conduct review sessions where engineering leads assess the work. You will design, structure, and run the process.



  





*3\. Performance Diagnostics \& Assessment* 



* Design an analytics\-driven continuous assessment process by weaving diagnostic probes into engineering workflows making performance reviews objective rather than subjective.
* Structure performance assessment across three dimensions: Individual, Team, and Process ensuring root causes are diagnosable across all three.
* Diagnose performance issues to their root: Process gap? Tooling gap? Motivation? Skill gap? Design specific remedies for each.
* Formulate monthly performance reports and conduct quarterly assessment programs in collaboration with HR.



  





*4\. Resource \& Project Planning* 



* Maintain resource maps, skill maps, and performance grades and use them actively for project planning and allocation decisions.
* Organize individual engineers’ calendars with categorized task blocks and drive adherence.
* Manage project timelines, dependencies, and delivery commitments across streams.



  





 5\.
 *Team Alignment \& People Skills* 



* Drive alignment across engineering teams not through authority, but through clarity, negotiation, and building shared understanding.
* Handle individual negotiations, identify morale bottlenecks, and resolve conflicts across teams.
* Build team cohesion and soft\-skill development as a deliberate practice, not a cultural afterthought.



  





**What Will You Do?** 




 You will augment Founder's Vision and make CynLr’s engineering organization legible to itself, to leadership, and to the people inside it.
 



 You will:
 


* Translate ambiguity into structure without losing the nuance that makes deep\-tech hard.
* Surface bottlenecks before they surface themselves as missed deadlines.
* Build systems that make good engineering behavior the path of least resistance.
* Diagnose performance problems at their root and not just at their symptom.
* Hold the delivery system together across hardware, firmware, software, and research without becoming a bottleneck yourself.



 You are not expected to be a domain expert in every engineering stream. You are expected to understand how they interlock and to design \& execute accordingly.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not an Agile/Scrum Master role. We do not use template frameworks. You will design processes from first principles based on what the engineering organization actually needs.
* Not a passive PMO. You will not track Gantt charts from the sidelines. You will actively diagnose, intervene, and drive systemic improvements.
* Not a pure HR role. While you will collaborate with HR on performance programs, your primary orientation is engineering operations and process design.



  





**What Will You Need to Do This Role Well** 



* At least 3–5 years of owning engineering processes end\-to\-end — not just participating in them.
* Strong understanding of multiple engineering streams (hardware, firmware, software, research) and their interlinkings dependency patterns, bottleneck dynamics, and cross\-stream risk.
* Demonstrated experience designing delivery processes, milestone frameworks, and assessment systems from scratch
* Hands\-on experience with engineering program management tools (Asana strongly preferred).
* Analytical mindset with the ability to design diagnostic probes and data\-driven assessment frameworks.
* Strong interpersonal skills: conflict resolution, individual negotiation, team alignment.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Engineering degree with a technical career foundation before moving into program or process roles.
* Experience in deep\-tech, robotics, embedded systems, automotive, aerospace/defense, industrial automation, medical devices, or semiconductor equipment
* Experience in organizations with 30–150 engineers where process had to be built, not just followed.
* Comfort operating in a founder\-driven environment with high ownership expectations and minimal bureaucratic scaffolding.
* Background in a product company that ships integrated hardware\-software products.



  





**How Will You Do It?** 




 This role resists templating by design. When we build a new industry from Scratch, we can't do by borrowing tools from other professions/industries.
 



  





 You will operate by:
 



 • Studying the engineering organization as a system before intervening in it.
 



 • Asking sharp clarifying questions before designing solutions.
 



 • Building your own frameworks for tracking, diagnostics, and follow\-through.
 



 • Knowing when to enforce structure and when structure itself is the bottleneck.
 



 • Learning from feedback quickly and evolving your approach as the organization grows.
 



*Success here comes from systems thinking, engineering understanding, and the discipline to build things that outlast your direct involvement.* 




  





**Team Structure** 




 The Technical Program Manager operates within the Founder’s Office, embedded directly into the engineering organization.
 



 While the TPM works closely with the founder(s), the role interfaces continuously with:
 



 • Engineering leads
 



 • HR and Talent, for performance programs and people\-related interventions
 



 • Finance and Operations, for resource planning and project budgeting
 



 • External vendors and tooling partners, where applicable
 



 The TPM owns process design and delivery hygiene across all engineering streams — acting as the connective layer that keeps multi\-disciplinary teams aligned without creating dependency on a single coordination point.
 



  





**About CynLr** 




 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).
 



  





 From fitting a screw to removing object out of its the plastic wrapper to automating the assembly of a car/gadget \- every such object handling task that involves "adapting on the fly" is not prior trainable \& thereby remains non\-automatable across the industries. CynLr builds a stack of Micro RL blocks called Sensing \& Action Primitives, using which a High Level Task can be composed.
 



  





 CynLr's OI enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
 *modular LEGO\-like* 
 Universal\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



  





 CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



  





 We are a deep\-tech robotics company at the intersection of computer vision, real\-time control systems, and precision hardware, headquartered in Bengaluru with a Swiss entity. Our engineering spans optics, embedded systems, firmware, real\-time software, mechanical design, and applied research.

title: Transition Project Management Coordinator
description:
**Location:** Bangalore, India
  
**Function:** Operations
  
**Department:** Transition
  
**Level:** Coordinator / Associate Project Management
  
About the Role
  
Cigna Healthcare is seeking a highly organized and detail\-orientedTransition Project Management Coordinator to support the successful execution of business process transitions, operational migrations, and transformation initiatives. This role will partner with Transition Managers, Operations Leaders, Training, Quality, HR, IT, and Compliance teams to coordinate project activities, maintain governance structures, track deliverables, and ensure seamless transition execution from planning through stabilization.
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong project coordination capabilities, excellent stakeholder communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast\-paced environment.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Project Coordination Planning
  
  

* Support end\-to\-end transition and migration projects from initiation through go\-live and stabilization.
* Coordinate project plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple workstreams.
* Maintain project schedules, action trackers, RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) logs, and status reports.
* Track project progress against established timelines and escalate risks or delays appropriately.


Governance Reporting
  
  

* Organize governance meetings, steering committees, project reviews, and stakeholder forums.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action logs, and follow\-up communications.
* Develop dashboards and project reporting packs for leadership review.
* Ensure timely closure of action items and maintenance of project documentation.


Transition Execution Support
  
  

* Coordinate knowledge transfer (KT), training, shadowing, reverse\-shadowing, and operational readiness activities.
* Track completion of transition tollgates, sign\-offs, and readiness assessments.
* Partner with operations leaders to monitor ramp\-up, productivity, quality, and stabilization activities.
* Support cutover planning and post\-go\-live hypercare tracking.


Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as a central coordination point between Operations, HR, Training, Workforce Management, IT, Quality, Compliance, and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate communication across teams to ensure alignment on project objectives and timelines.
* Escalate issues proactively and facilitate resolution with relevant stakeholders.


Risk Compliance Management
  
  

* Maintain project risk registers and mitigation plans.
* Support compliance with internal governance, regulatory, and operational requirements.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals, audit trails, and process controls are maintained throughout project execution.


Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve transition methodologies, reporting, governance, and project management practices.
* Support post\-implementation reviews and lessons\-learned sessions.
* Assist in standardizing templates, trackers, and best practices across projects.


Required Qualifications
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelors Degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Project Management, Engineering, Healthcare Management, or related field.


Experience
  
  

* 2 to 5 years of experience in:
* Project Coordination
* PMO Support
* Business Process Transitions
* Operations Excellence
* Shared Services / BPO / Healthcare Operations


Preferred Experience
  
  

* Healthcare operations environment.
* Global delivery or shared services organizations.
* Transition, migration, outsourcing, or transformation programs.


Key Skills
  
Project Management
  
  

* Project planning and coordination
* Risk and issue management
* Stakeholder management
* Governance management
* Documentation and reporting
* Resource coordination


Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel
* PowerPoint
* Microsoft Project / Smartsheet (preferred)
* Power BI (preferred)
* SharePoint
* Microsoft Teams


Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong organizational skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Attention to detail
* Analytical thinking
* Problem\-solving capability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Strong relationship\-building skills


Success Measures
  
  

**The successful candidate will be measured on:**  

* On\-time completion of transition milestones
* Accuracy and timeliness of project reporting
* Effective management of action items and governance processes
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Risk identification and mitigation effectiveness
* Quality of project documentation and transition artifacts
* Successful support of go\-live and stabilization activities


What We Offer
  
At Cigna Healthcare, you will work on strategic global transition programs that impact operational excellence and business transformation. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams across regions while developing project management, leadership, and healthcare operations expertise in a dynamic and growing organization.
  
  

About The Cigna Group
  
  

Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

 CareerArc Code

 BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

 We are hiring a Senior Digital Analytics Manager to own how web and digital behavior connects to our broader data infrastructure and revenue motion. This is a strategic and hands\-on role where you will provide direction and governance over our Adobe Analytics platform as assessment and implementation work progresses, architect the web\-to\-warehouse data pipeline, define how we measure performance in an era of AI\-driven search, and serve as the connective tissue between digital strategy, Marketing Ops/GTM, demand marketing, and the Core Data team.
   

  

**Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**
**Adobe Analytics Platform Ownership**
 Own the strategy, standards, and governance for our Adobe Analytics implementation. Assessment and implementation work is already underway with an external partner — your role is to direct that work, shape decisions, and ensure what gets built reflects our measurement architecture and long\-term needs. Establish and maintain standards for event taxonomy, naming conventions, data layer design, and documentation. Own ongoing platform health and QA.
   

  

**Web\-to\-Warehouse Data Architecture**
 Design and maintain the pipeline from web data capture through to our data warehouse. Identify integration gaps, redundancies, and points of failure across web → core → downstream systems. Partner with data engineering to build clean, durable pipelines — using tools like Snowflake, dbt, or equivalent — so web data is trusted, documented, and joinable with CRM and campaign data.
   

  

**Attribution and Revenue\-Linked Measurement**
 Build and maintain the KPIs and dashboards that connect web performance to pipeline and revenue — not vanity metrics. Define and implement multi\-touch attribution logic that works across the marketing stack. Partner with Sales Ops and the Core Data team to align on a single source of truth.
   

  

**Web Traffic Analysis and Optimization**
 Analyze traffic, behavior, and conversion paths to surface where we're winning, leaking, and underinvesting. Translate findings into prioritized, testable recommendations. Raise the analytics fluency of digital and demand partners — bring people along rather than operating as a black box.
   

  

**Reimagining Measurement for AI\-Driven Search**
 Rethink the analytics model end to end, accounting for the shift toward AI\-driven search and zero\-click discovery. Define how we measure visibility, attribution, and intent when traditional referral and session signals erode. Build a forward\-looking framework that keeps us ahead of changes in how buyers find and engage with us.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Partnership**

Wealth and Personal Banking serves more than 50 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and protect and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer\-centric propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Wealth and Personal Banking\-Overseas Indian team.

The VP \& Branch Head, IWPB is responsible for directing and managing the growth of HSBC's International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) business in one of the branches. Situated in a prime location, the branch offers immense business potential. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long\-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches.


The role involves overseeing branch operations, ensuring service standards, and maintaining a high\-quality customer portfolio. IWPB is looking for a customer\-facing role to service primarily walk\-in customers and manage and fulfill their requirements to their satisfaction. The Branch Head plays a crucial role in achieving targets as per the Strategic Plan/AOP and enhancing the branch's sales and service culture.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow the IWPB business, achieving targets as outlined in the Strategic Plan/AOP.
* Exercise strict control over branch operations and costs while maintaining service standards.
* Continuously review and improve service, sales, and operations strategies.
* Ensure quality of portfolio acquisition aligns with Sales Quality norms and guidelines.
* Work closely with INM, Regional Head, and HR to ensure the right person is in the right job, considering diverse market sensitivities.
* Grow the deposit base and identify opportunities to reduce the branch cost\-income ratio.
* Foster a compliance culture within the team, managing compliance risk and ensuring necessary training is completed.
* Optimize relations with regulators and maintain HSBC internal control standards.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Postgraduate (Masters)
* 5 to 10 years of experience in a similar or leadership role
* Proven ability in team leadership and management.
* Expertise in financial planning and related systems and processes.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Proven ability in Retail distribution and relationship management in the Retail sector.
* Demonstrate behaviors consistent with HSBC Values.
* Proven adherence to controls and compliance with no significant breaches.
* Strong marketing, sales, management planning, financial, leadership, project management, and communication skills.
* Good knowledge and control of risk.
* Progressive management experience in Wealth and Retail.
* High degree of management planning, lateral thinking skills, interpersonal skills, and change management.

**Skills**

* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a strong focus on inspiring, influencing, and negotiating.
* Proficiency in coaching sales techniques and implementing best practices in sales management, both in team settings and one\-on\-one.
* Strong planning and organizational abilities.
* Advanced analytical skills.
* Effective problem\-solving capabilities.

**Regulatory Certifications**

* Obtain relevant professional and regulatory qualifications as mandated by the local market.
* Meet all internal standards required by the market.

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. **Job Description: Historian Technical Architect (Pharma Manufacturing)**


**Role:** Historian Technical Architect – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
  

**Experience:** 7\-10 years total, with at least 6 years in process historian architecture
  

**Domain:** Pharma / Biotech / Life Sciences Manufacturing (GxP\-regulated)
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time


**Role Summary**


We are looking for a Historian Technical Architect to design, implement, and govern enterprise process data historian solutions across our pharmaceutical manufacturing sites. You will own the end\-to\-end architecture for collecting, contextualizing, storing, and serving time\-series manufacturing data from shop\-floor systems to enterprise and analytics platforms. Every solution must stay compliant with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11\.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Architecture and Design**


* Define the enterprise historian architecture, including site\-level and enterprise\-level historians, tiered or federated topologies, high availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery.
* Design data collection strategies from DCS, PLC, SCADA, and standalone equipment using OPC DA/UA, interfaces, and connectors.
* Build asset hierarchies and data models, such as PI Asset Framework templates, aligned with ISA\-95 and ISA\-88 batch structures.
* Define standards for tag naming, data compression and exception settings, event frames, and batch context.
* Architect integrations with MES (e.g., Körber PAS\-X, Emerson Syncade), LIMS, ERP (SAP), QMS, and cloud or analytics platforms.

**Implementation and Delivery**


* Lead historian deployments, upgrades, migrations, and site rollouts across multiple manufacturing plants.
* Configure and optimize interfaces, buffering, collectives, AF, notifications, and visualization tools (PI Vision, dashboards).
* Guide development teams and system integrators, and review designs, configurations, and code.
* Troubleshoot performance, data loss, latency, and scalability issues.

**GxP Compliance and Validation**


* Ensure solutions meet 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, and ALCOA\+ data integrity principles.
* Author or review validation deliverables: URS, FS, DS, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ, and traceability matrices.

**Qualifications**
**About you**
* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and have at least 2 years of experience delivering AI projects from concept to production.
* You possess strong technical expertise in AI, machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, cloud computing, big data analytics, web and mobile technologies, and IoT.

**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
   

  

 Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
   

  

 We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

 We are seeking a Senior Techno Functional Analyst with strong hands on experience in Model N Revenue Manager and Oracle Database to support and enhance critical Revenue Management processes, including Chargebacks, Rebates, Managed Care, Government Pricing, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.

* Collaborate with functional, business, and vendor teams to produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation and define preventive actions.


**Essential Requirements**

+ Chargebacks

+ Managed Care

* Exposure to EDI transactions and pharmaceutical gross‑to‑net data flows.
* Familiarity with IT governance, change management, and validation methodologies (SIT/UAT).
